title.zh: 卷25 本紀二十五 宣统皇帝本紀
title.raw: 卷25 本紀二十五 宣统皇帝本紀

sentences.zh: 宣統皇帝名溥儀，宣宗之曾孫，醇賢親王奕譞之孫，監國攝政王載灃之子也，於德宗為本生弟子。

translations.literal: The Xuantong Emperor was named Puyi, a great-grandson of the Xuanzong Emperor, a grandson of the Pure and Worthy Prince Yixuan, and a son of the Regent Prince Zaifeng; to the Dezong Emperor he was a nephew from his own line.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuantong, named Puyi, was Xuanzong's great-grandson, Prince Yixuan's grandson, Regent Zaifeng's son, and Dezong's biological nephew.

sentences.zh: 母攝政王嫡福晉蘇完瓜爾佳氏。

translations.literal: His mother was the Regent Prince's principal consort of the Suwan Guwalgiya clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Regent Zaifeng's principal consort, a Suwan Guwalgiya woman.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年春正月十四日，誕於醇邸。

translations.literal: On the fourteenth day of the first month of spring in Guangxu year 32 he was born at the Pure Prince's residence.
translations.idiomatic: He was born at the Pure Prince's house on day 14 of spring, month 1, Guangxu year 32.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十四年 三十四年冬十月壬申，德宗疾大漸，太皇太后命教養宮內。

translations.literal: Guangxu year 34 — On day renshen in the tenth month of winter in year 34, the Dezong Emperor's illness grew grave; the Grand Empress Dowager ordered him reared within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxu year 34, winter, month 10, renshen day: Dezong fell critically ill and the Grand Empress Dowager had Puyi brought up inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，德宗崩，奉太皇太后懿旨，入承大統，為嗣皇帝，嗣穆宗，兼承大行皇帝之祧，時年三歲。

translations.literal: On day guiyou the Dezong Emperor died; following the Grand Empress Dowager's edict he entered to receive the Great Succession as successor emperor, succeeding the Muzong Emperor and also carrying on the late emperor's ancestral line; he was three years old.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Dezong died; by the Grand Empress Dowager's order Puyi took the throne as successor for Muzong and the late emperor's line, aged three.

sentences.zh: 攝政王載灃奉太皇太后懿旨監國。

translations.literal: The Regent Prince Zaifeng, by the Grand Empress Dowager's edict, supervised the realm as regent.
translations.idiomatic: Regent Zaifeng governed the realm by the Grand Empress Dowager's order.

sentences.zh: 軍國機務，中外章奏，悉取攝政王處分，稱詔行之，大事並請皇太后懿旨。

translations.literal: Military and state affairs and all domestic and foreign memorials were entirely disposed of by the Regent Prince, issued as edicts, and great affairs also required the Empress Dowager's rescript.
translations.idiomatic: War, government, and all memorials went to the Regent Prince as edicts; major matters also needed the Empress Dowager's approval.

sentences.zh: 詔行三年喪。

translations.literal: An edict ordered a three-year mourning period.
translations.idiomatic: The court proclaimed three years of mourning.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，尊聖祖母慈禧端佑康頤昭豫莊誠壽恭欽獻崇熙皇太后為太皇太后，兼祧母后皇后為皇太后。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu the Sacred Grandmother, Empress Dowager Cixi of the full honorific title, was honored as Grand Empress Dowager, and the empress who was both line mother and empress was honored as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Cixi became Grand Empress Dowager and the empress who carried both lines became Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 先是，太皇太后並亦違豫。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Grand Empress Dowager had also fallen ill.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Empress Dowager had been ill as well.

sentences.zh: 是日，崩。

translations.literal: On that day she died.
translations.idiomatic: That same day she died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，申嚴門禁。

translations.literal: On day yihai the palace gates were strictly guarded.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day palace security was tightened.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，尊封文宗祺貴妃為祺皇貴太妃，穆宗瑜貴妃為瑜皇貴妃，珣貴妃為珣皇貴妃，晉妃為晉貴妃，大行皇帝瑾妃為瑾貴妃。

translations.literal: On day dingyou the Wen Zong Emperor's Honored Consort was raised to Honored Imperial Noble Consort, the Muzong Emperor's Yu Consort to Imperial Noble Consort Yu, the Xun Consort to Imperial Noble Consort Xun, the Jin Consort to Imperial Noble Consort Jin, and the late emperor's Jin Consort to Imperial Noble Consort Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day several late emperors' consorts received higher noble consort ranks.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，停各省進方物。

translations.literal: On day wuyin the provinces were ordered to stop presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day tribute goods from the provinces were halted.

sentences.zh: 己卯，誥誡群臣，詔曰：「軍國政事，由監國攝政王裁定，為大行太皇太后懿旨。

translations.literal: On day jimao the court admonished the officials; an edict said: 「Military and state affairs shall be adjudicated by the Regent Prince supervising the realm, as the late Grand Empress Dowager's edict.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day officials were warned by edict: military and state affairs belong to the Regent Prince, as the late Grand Empress Dowager ordered.

sentences.zh: 自朕以下，一體服從。

translations.literal: From Us downward, all shall obey as one.
translations.idiomatic: From the throne downward, all must obey.

sentences.zh: 嗣后王公百官，儻有觀望玩違，或越禮犯分，變更典章，淆亂國是，定即治以國法，庶無負大行太皇太后委寄之重，而慰天下臣民之望。

translations.literal: Thereafter princes, dukes, and all officials — if any should watch and play at defiance, overstep ritual and violate rank, alter statutes, or confuse the national policy — shall at once be punished under state law, so as not to fail the late Grand Empress Dowager's weighty trust and to satisfy the hopes of the realm's officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: Any prince or official who defies orders, breaks ritual, or confuses policy will be punished at once, to honor the late Grand Empress Dowager's trust and the people's hopes.

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，頒大行皇帝遺詔。

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.) On day gengchen the late emperor's testamentary edict was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed. On gengchen day the late emperor's final edict was issued.

sentences.zh: 安慶兵變，剿定之。

translations.literal: Soldiers mutinied at Anqing and were suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: An Anqing mutiny was put down.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，頒大行太皇太后遺誥。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiyou: the late Grand Empress Dowager's testamentary rescript was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, yiyou day, the late Grand Empress Dowager's death rescript was issued.

sentences.zh: 詔四時祭饗祝版，醇賢親王稱曰「本生祖考醇賢親王」，嫡福晉稱曰「本生祖妣醇賢親王嫡福晉」。

translations.literal: An edict fixed the seasonal sacrifice prayer boards: the Pure and Worthy Prince was styled "biological forefather the Pure and Worthy Prince," and his principal consort "biological foremother the Pure and Worthy Prince's principal consort."
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice boards were ordered to name Prince Yixuan and his principal consort as Puyi's biological forebears.

sentences.zh: 賑湖南澧州等屬水災。

translations.literal: Flood victims in Lizhou and other districts of Hunan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan's Lizhou flood victims were fed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，皇太后懿旨，皇帝萬壽節，俟釋服後，改於每年正月十三日舉行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, by Empress Dowager rescript, the emperor's birthday celebrations were to wait until mourning ended and thereafter be held every year on the thirteenth day of the first month.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Empress Dowager moved the emperor's birthday rites to the 13th of month 1 after mourning ended.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以即位前期告祭天地、宗廟、社稷、先師孔子，告祭大行太皇太后、大行皇帝几筵。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, before the accession period, sacrifices were announced to Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temple, the altar of soil and grain, and the sage Confucius, and to the late Grand Empress Dowager and late emperor at their mourning couches.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the court announced sacrifices to Heaven, Earth, temples, Confucius, and the late rulers' mourning couches before enthronement.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，帝即位於太和殿，以明年為宣統元年。

translations.literal: On day xinmao the emperor took the throne in the Hall of Supreme Harmony; the next year was fixed as the first year of Xuantong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Puyi was enthroned in the Hall of Supreme Harmony and the next year became Xuantong 1.

sentences.zh: 頒詔天下，罪非常所不原者咸赦除之。

translations.literal: An edict was issued to the realm; crimes not normally pardoned were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: A realm-wide amnesty forgave all but the gravest crimes.

sentences.zh: 詔遵大行太皇太后懿旨，仍定於第九年內，宣統八年頒布憲法，召集議員。

translations.literal: An edict followed the late Grand Empress Dowager's edict, still fixing promulgation of a constitution in the ninth year — Xuantong year 8 — and convocation of delegates.
translations.idiomatic: By the late Grand Empress Dowager's plan, a constitution would be issued in year 9 (Xuantong 8) and delegates summoned.

sentences.zh: 鑄宣統錢。

translations.literal: Xuantong coinage was cast.
translations.idiomatic: Xuantong coins were minted.

sentences.zh: 己亥，頒「中和位育」扁額於文廟。

translations.literal: On day jihai the plaque "Central Harmony and Nurturing Growth" was issued to the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the "Central Harmony and Nurturing Growth" plaque went to the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，內閣等衙門會奏監國攝政王禮節總目，詔宣布之。

translations.literal: On day renyin the Grand Council and other offices jointly memorialized the general regulations for the Regent Prince's ritual; an edict proclaimed them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Regent Prince's ritual code was submitted and promulgated.

sentences.zh: 定守衛門禁章程，命貝勒載濤、毓朗、尚書鐵良總司稽察。

translations.literal: Regulations for guarding the gates were fixed, and Princes Zaitao and Yulang and Minister Tie Liang were ordered to oversee inspection in chief.
translations.idiomatic: Gate-guard rules were set and Zaitao, Yulang, and Tie Liang were put in charge of inspection.

sentences.zh: 以副都統昆源管理察哈爾牧群。

translations.literal: Vice Commander Kun Yuan was appointed to manage the Chahar herds.
translations.idiomatic: Kun Yuan was made vice commander over Chahar herds.

sentences.zh: 定軍機處領班章京為從三品官，幫領班章京為從四品官。

translations.literal: The Grand Council leading clerks were fixed as third-rank officials and assistant leading clerks as fourth-rank officials.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Council lead clerks became third-rank posts and assistants fourth-rank.

sentences.zh: 福建龍溪、南靖等縣水災，發帑銀四萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: Floods in Longxi, Nanjing, and other counties of Fujian: forty thousand taels from the treasury were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Forty thousand taels relieved flood victims in Fujian's Longxi and Nanjing counties.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔各省督撫督率司道考察屬吏，秉公甄別。

translations.literal: On day yisi an edict ordered each provincial governor-general and governor to lead circuit intendants in examining subordinate officials and fairly distinguishing merit.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day governors were told to rate their subordinates fairly.

sentences.zh: 不肖守令罔恤民瘼者，重治之。

translations.literal: Unworthy magistrates who ignored the people's suffering were to be severely punished.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates who ignored public suffering faced harsh punishment.

sentences.zh: 立變通旗制處，命貝子溥倫、鎮國公載澤、那桐、寶熙、熙彥、達壽總其事。

translations.literal: An office to reform the banner system was established; Princes Pulun and Zaize, Natong, Baoxi, Xiyan, and Dashou were ordered to direct it.
translations.idiomatic: A banner-reform office was set up under Pulun, Zaize, Natong, Baoxi, Xiyan, and Dashou.

sentences.zh: 諭內外臣工尚節儉，戒浮華。

translations.literal: Officials at court and in the provinces were instructed to value frugality and shun display.
translations.idiomatic: The court urged frugality and warned against extravagance.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣官告祭孔子闕里、歷代帝王陵寢、五嶽、四瀆。

translations.literal: On day bingwu envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at Confucius's home temple, the tombs of successive emperors, the Five Sacred Peaks, and the Four Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day sacrifices were sent to Qufu, imperial tombs, the Five Peaks, and the Four Rivers.

sentences.zh: 戊申，皇太后懿旨，罷頤和園臨幸。

translations.literal: On day wushen, by Empress Dowager rescript, visits to the Summer Palace were stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Empress Dowager ended Summer Palace visits.

sentences.zh: 加恩慶親王奕劻以親王世襲罔替，貝勒載洵、載濤加郡王銜，皇太后父公桂祥食雙俸，大學士以次，錫賚有差。

translations.literal: Prince Qing Yikuang was further ennobled with perpetual hereditary prince rank; Princes Zaixun and Zaitao received acting grand-prince titles; the Empress Dowager's father Duke Guixiang received double stipend; and from grand secretaries downward rewards were graded.
translations.idiomatic: Yikuang became a perpetual hereditary prince; Zaixun and Zaitao gained acting grand-prince titles; Guixiang got double pay; officials were rewarded by rank.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，冬至，祀天於圜丘，莊親王載功代行禮，自是壇廟大祀皆攝。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, winter solstice, Heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound; Prince Zhuang Zaigong performed the rites by proxy — thereafter major altar and temple sacrifices were all performed by proxy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, winter solstice, Zaigong sacrificed to Heaven at the Circular Mound; major rites were henceforth performed by proxy.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子朔，加上穆宗毅皇帝、孝靜成皇后、孝德顯皇后、孝貞顯皇后、孝哲毅皇后尊謚。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day renzi: posthumous honorific titles were added for the Muzong Yi Emperor, Empress Xiaojingcheng, and Empresses Xiaode, Xiaozhen, and Xiaozhe.
translations.idiomatic: Month 12, renzi new moon: posthumous titles were added for Muzong and several empresses.

sentences.zh: 頒宣統元年時憲書。

translations.literal: The Xuantong year 1 calendar was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuantong 1 calendar was issued.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，立禁衛軍，命貝勒載濤、毓朗、尚書鐵良專司訓練。

translations.literal: On day jiayin the Forbidden Guards Army was established; Princes Zaitao and Yulang and Minister Tie Liang were ordered to train it exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Forbidden Guards were founded under Zaitao, Yulang, and Tie Liang.

sentences.zh: 裁湖南鎮溪營遊擊、乾州協守備，減留乾州協各營兵。

translations.literal: The Zhenxi battalion brigade commander and Qianzhou garrison deputy commander in Hunan were cut, and Qianzhou garrison troops were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan military posts at Zhenxi and Qianzhou were cut and garrison troops reduced.

sentences.zh: 旌殉節故直隸提督馬玉昆妾於氏。

translations.literal: The concubine Yu of the late Zhili Governor Ma Yugun, who died for her lord, was honored.
translations.idiomatic: Yu, concubine of the martyred Ma Yugun of Zhili, was honored.

sentences.zh: 賑黑龍江、墨爾根、布特哈、黑水、大賚等城廳水災。

translations.literal: Floods in Heilongjiang, Mergen, Buteha, Heishui, Dazhai, and other cities and departments were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Floods in Heilongjiang, Mergen, Buteha, Heishui, and Dazhai were relieved.

sentences.zh: 免直隸河間等八州縣被災地畝糧租。

translations.literal: Grain land tax in eight disaster counties of Hejian prefecture, Zhili, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Grain tax was forgiven in eight flooded Hejian counties, Zhili.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，祈雪。

translations.literal: On day dingsi prayers were offered for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the court prayed for snow.

sentences.zh: 命張之洞兼督辦川漢鐵路大臣。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong was ordered additionally to supervise the Sichuan-Hankou Railway.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong was also put in charge of the Sichuan-Hankou Railway.

sentences.zh: 庚申，致仕大學士王文韶卒，贈太保。

translations.literal: On day gengshen the retired Grand Secretary Wang Wenshao died and was posthumously given Grand Guardian rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Wang Wenshao died in retirement and was posthumously made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 追予故云貴總督張亮基謚。

translations.literal: A posthumous title was granted the late Yunnan-Guizhou Governor Zhang Liangji.
translations.idiomatic: The late Zhang Liangji of Yunnan-Guizhou received a posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 民政部上調查戶口章程表式。

translations.literal: The Civil Affairs Ministry submitted forms for the household census survey regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Civil Affairs Ministry filed census survey forms.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，袁世凱罷，命大學士那桐為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day renxu Yuan Shikai was dismissed and Grand Secretary Natong was appointed Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Yuan Shikai was removed and Natong joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以梁敦彥為外務部尚書兼會辦大臣。

translations.literal: On day guihai Liang Dunyan was made Minister of Foreign Affairs and concurrent joint minister.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Liang Dunyan became foreign minister and joint minister.

sentences.zh: 那桐免步軍統領，以毓朗代之。

translations.literal: Natong was relieved of command of the Metropolitan Garrison and Yulang replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Natong left the Metropolitan Garrison command and Yulang took over.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔定西陵金龍峪為德宗景皇帝山陵，稱曰崇陵。

translations.literal: On day yichou an edict fixed Golden Dragon Valley at the Western Mausoleum as the mountain tomb of the Jing Emperor Dezong, styled Chongling.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Dezong's tomb was fixed at Golden Dragon Valley, Western Mausoleum, as Chongling.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，復祈雪。

translations.literal: On day dingmao prayers for snow were offered again.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the court again prayed for snow.

sentences.zh: 己巳，度支部上清理財政章程。

translations.literal: On day jisi the Revenue Ministry submitted regulations for cleaning up finances.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the Revenue Ministry filed finance cleanup rules.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命張勛所部淮軍仍駐東三省，辦理剿撫事宜。

translations.literal: On day renshen Zhang Xun's Huai Army was ordered to remain in the three eastern provinces handling suppression and pacification.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Zhang Xun's Huai Army stayed in Manchuria for pacification duty.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，義大利地震災，出帑銀五萬兩助賑。

translations.literal: On day guiyou Italy suffered earthquake disaster; fifty thousand taels were issued from the treasury for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day fifty thousand taels aided Italy's earthquake victims.

sentences.zh: 憲政編查館奏，京旗初選、復選事宜，應歸順天府辦理。

translations.literal: The Constitutional Compilation and Review Office memorialized that initial and repeat elections for the capital banners should be handled by Shuntian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The constitutional office said capital-banner elections should go to Shuntian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，諭各省清蠲緩錢糧積弊。

translations.literal: On day yihai the provinces were instructed to clean up abuses in clearing arrears and deferring taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day provinces were told to end tax-clearance abuses.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，復祈雪。

translations.literal: On day dingchou prayers for snow were offered again.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the court prayed for snow again.

sentences.zh: 是日，雪。

translations.literal: That day it snowed.
translations.idiomatic: Snow fell that day.

sentences.zh: 免陜西各州縣光緒三十二年逋賦。

translations.literal: Arrears from Guangxu year 32 in Shaanxi prefectures and counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi's Guangxu 32 tax arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，又雪。

translations.literal: On day wuyin it snowed again.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day it snowed again.

sentences.zh: 憲政編查館上核覆城鄉地方自治，並另擬選舉章程，詔頒行之。

translations.literal: The Constitutional Compilation and Review Office submitted reviewed local self-government for town and countryside and separate draft election regulations; an edict promulgated them.
translations.idiomatic: Local self-government and election drafts were reviewed and promulgated.

sentences.zh: 始制寶星，賜外務部總理、會辦大臣及出使各國大臣。

translations.literal: Orders of merit stars were first instituted and conferred on the foreign minister, joint ministers, and envoys abroad.
translations.idiomatic: Merit stars were first created for the foreign minister, joint ministers, and envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，設奉天各級審判廳、檢察廳。

translations.literal: On day gengchen trial courts and procuratorates at each level were established in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Fengtian got graded trial courts and procuratorates.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，裁江西督糧道，設巡警、勸業兩道。

translations.literal: On day xinsi the Jiangxi grain transport circuit was cut and patrol and encouragement-of-industry circuits were added.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Jiangxi cut its grain circuit and added patrol and industry circuits.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年 宣統元年己酉春正月壬午朔，以大行在殯，不受朝賀。

translations.literal: Xuantong year 1 — First year of Xuantong, spring, first month, new moon on day renwu: because the late ruler lay in coffin mourning, court congratulations were not received.
translations.idiomatic: Xuantong 1, spring, month 1, renwu new moon: with the late emperor in mourning, New Year levees were canceled.

sentences.zh: 癸未，免江蘇長洲等二十八廳州縣荒廢田地，暨昭文、金壇、丹徒、昆山、新陽、靖江、溧陽等七縣漕屯銀米。

translations.literal: On day guiwei wasteland in twenty-eight prefectures and counties of Jiangsu, including Changzhou, was remitted, as were transport grain and rice for seven counties.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Jiangsu wasteland and transport dues in twenty-eight districts were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊子，置呼倫貝爾沿邊卡倫。

translations.literal: On day wuzi guard posts were placed along the Hulunbuir frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day frontier guard posts were set on the Hulunbuir border.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，欽差大臣東三省總督徐世昌以病請免，不許。

translations.literal: On day gengyin the special commissioner and Three Eastern Provinces Governor Xu Shichang asked leave for illness and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Xu Shichang's sick leave as Manchuria governor was denied.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，皇太后聖壽節，停筵宴，不受賀。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Empress Dowager's birthday, banquets were stopped and congratulations were not received.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the Empress Dowager's birthday, feasts and congratulations were canceled.

sentences.zh: 甲午，免雲南阿迷州被災逋賦。

translations.literal: On day jiawu arrears were remitted for disaster victims in Ami prefecture, Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Yunnan's Ami disaster arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙未，度支部奏改定幣制，請仍飭會議。

translations.literal: On day yiwei the Revenue Ministry memorialized on revising the currency system and asked that deliberation continue.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Revenue Ministry asked further debate on currency reform.

sentences.zh: 下政務處覆議。

translations.literal: The matter was sent to the Government Affairs Office for reconsideration.
translations.idiomatic: The Government Affairs Office was told to review it.

sentences.zh: 開廣西富川縣錫礦。

translations.literal: Tin mines in Fuchuan county, Guangxi, were opened.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi's Fuchuan tin mines were opened.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，禁置買奴婢。

translations.literal: On day dingyou the purchase and sale of male and female slaves was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day buying and selling slaves was banned.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以近年新設衙門，新建省分，調用人員，請加經費，不能綜覈名實，命中外切實考覈裁汰，毋漫無限制。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, because in recent years new offices and new provinces had drawn personnel and sought added funds without being able to verify names against facts, the court and provinces were ordered to examine and cut in earnest and not expand without limit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day new offices were told to cut staff and funds after real audits, not open-ended growth.

sentences.zh: 美利堅國開萬國禁煙會議於江蘇上海，端方蒞會。

translations.literal: The United States opened an international opium prohibition conference at Shanghai, Jiangsu; Duan Fang attended.
translations.idiomatic: The U.S. opened an international opium conference at Shanghai; Duan Fang attended.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，陳璧被劾罷，以徐世昌為郵傳部尚書。

translations.literal: On day yihai Chen Bi was impeached and dismissed; Xu Shichang was made Minister of Posts and Communications.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Chen Bi was impeached out and Xu Shichang became post minister.

sentences.zh: 調錫良為欽差大臣、東三省總督，兼管三省將軍事。

translations.literal: Xi Liang was transferred as special commissioner and Three Eastern Provinces Governor, also managing the three provinces' generals' affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Liang became Manchuria governor-special commissioner and oversaw the three generals.

sentences.zh: 以李經羲為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Li Jingxi was made Yunnan-Guizhou Governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingxi became Yunnan-Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命雲南交涉使高而謙赴澳門勘界。

translations.literal: On day renyin Yunnan Negotiation Commissioner Gao Erqian was ordered to Macao to survey the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Gao Erqian of Yunnan went to Macao to survey the border.

sentences.zh: 民政部上整頓京師內外警政酌改廳區章程。

translations.literal: The Civil Affairs Ministry submitted revised metropolitan police district regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Civil Affairs Ministry filed revised Beijing police districts.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上大行太皇太后尊謚，翼日頒詔天下。

translations.literal: On day guimao the late Grand Empress Dowager's posthumous title was conferred; the next day an edict was issued to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the late Grand Empress Dowager's posthumous title was set and promulgated next day.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔籌備立憲事宜，本年各省應行各節，依限成立，不得延誤。

translations.literal: On day wushen an edict ordered constitutional preparation; each province's scheduled steps for this year were to be completed on time without delay.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day provinces were ordered to meet every constitutional deadline this year.

sentences.zh: 諭核定新刑律，來年頒行。

translations.literal: The new penal code was to be fixed and promulgated next year.
translations.idiomatic: The new criminal code would be issued next year.

sentences.zh: 復已革廣西提督蘇元春原官。

translations.literal: The former dismissed Guangxi Provincial Commander Su Yuanchun was restored to his original post.
translations.idiomatic: Su Yuanchun regained his old Guangxi command post.

sentences.zh: 罷福建廈門貢燕。

translations.literal: Tribute swifts from Xiamen, Fujian, were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's Xiamen swift tribute ended.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上大行皇帝尊謚廟號，翼日頒詔天下。

translations.literal: On day jiyou the late emperor's posthumous title and temple name were conferred; the next day an edict was issued to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Dezong's posthumous title and temple name were set and announced next day.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，重整海軍，命肅親王善耆、鎮國公載澤、尚書鐵良、提督薩鎮冰籌畫，慶親王奕劻總司稽查。

translations.literal: On day gengxu the navy was reorganized; Prince Su Shanqi, Prince Guo Zaize, Minister Tie Liang, and Admiral Sa Zhenbing were ordered to plan it, with Prince Qing Yikuang in overall inspection.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the navy was reorganized under Shanqi, Zaize, Tie Liang, and Sa Zhenbing, with Yikuang inspecting.

sentences.zh: 罷鐵良專司訓練禁衛軍大臣。

translations.literal: Tie Liang was removed from exclusive duty training the Forbidden Guards minister.
translations.idiomatic: Tie Liang left exclusive command of Forbidden Guards training.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，修德宗實錄。

translations.literal: Second month, day renzi: the Veritable Records of Dezong were revised.
translations.idiomatic: Month 2, renzi day: Dezong's Veritable Records were revised.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，諭京、外問刑衙門清訟獄，釐剔弊端。

translations.literal: On day guichou capital and provincial judicial offices were instructed to clear lawsuits and cut abuses.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day courts were told to clear cases and end abuses.

sentences.zh: 戊午，農工商部奏，和蘭將訂新律，收華僑入籍，請定國籍法。

translations.literal: On day wuwu the Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce Ministry memorialized that the Netherlands would enact new laws and enroll overseas Chinese; a nationality law was requested.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the ministry asked for a nationality law as the Netherlands planned new laws for overseas Chinese.

sentences.zh: 下修訂法律大臣會外務部議。

translations.literal: The matter was sent to the statute-revision legal ministers to deliberate with the Foreign Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Legal revision ministers were told to meet with foreign affairs on it.

sentences.zh: 庚申，免浙江仁和等場竈課錢糧。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, salt-field dues in Renhe and other districts of Zhejiang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Zhejiang salt-field taxes in Renhe and elsewhere were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，宣示實行預備立憲宗旨，詔曰：「國是已定，期在必成。

translations.literal: On day yichou the purpose of implementing preparatory constitutionalism was proclaimed; an edict said: 「The national policy is fixed and the deadline must be met.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the court proclaimed constitutional prep: 「The national course is set and must be finished on time.

sentences.zh: 內外大小臣工，皆當共體此意，翊贊新猷。

translations.literal: Officials great and small at court and in the provinces must all share this intent and assist the new design.
translations.idiomatic: Every official at court and in the provinces must share that aim and help the new order.

sentences.zh: 言責諸臣，亦應於一切新政得失利病，剴切敷陳。

translations.literal: Censors and remonstrating officials should also frankly set forth the gains and losses of every new policy.
translations.idiomatic: Censors should speak plainly on what each new policy gains or costs.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，命熙彥、喬樹枬、劉廷琛、吳士鑒、周自齊、勞乃宣、趙炳麟、譚學衡與榮慶、陸潤庠、張英麟、唐景崇、寶熙、朱益藩分日進講。

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.) On day dingmao, Xiyan, Qiao Shufang, Liu Tingchen, Wu Shijian, Zhou Ziqi, Lao Naiyuan, Zhao Binglin, Tan Xueheng, and Rongqing, Lu Runxiang, Zhang Yinglin, Tang Jingchong, Baoxi, and Zhu Yifan were ordered to lecture on assigned days.
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed. On dingmao day a roster of tutors was ordered to lecture on rotation.

sentences.zh: 講義令孫家鼐、張之洞核定。

translations.literal: Lecture texts were to be approved by Sun Jianai and Zhang Zhidong.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jianai and Zhang Zhidong would approve lecture texts.

sentences.zh: 庚午，憲政編查館上統計表式。

translations.literal: On day gengwu the Constitutional Compilation and Review Office submitted statistical forms.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the constitutional office filed statistical forms.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，申鴉片煙禁。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu opium smoking was again forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the opium ban was renewed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，免雲南宣威州被災村莊銀米。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, silver and grain for disaster villages in Xuanwei prefecture, Yunnan, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Xuanwei's flooded villages were forgiven tax grain and silver.

sentences.zh: 閏二月甲申，詔嚴預備立憲責成，戒部臣、疆臣因循敷衍，放棄責任。

translations.literal: Intercalary second month, day jiashen: an edict strictly fixed responsibility for preparatory constitutionalism and warned ministry and frontier officials against dragging, perfunctory work, and abandoning duty.
translations.idiomatic: Leap month 2, jiashen: the throne warned ministries and governors not to stall constitutional prep.

sentences.zh: 以服制倫紀攸關，詔自今內外遭父母喪者，滿、漢皆離任聽終制。

translations.literal: Because mourning rites and human relations were involved, an edict ordered that henceforth all at court and outside who suffered parents' mourning, Manchu and Han alike, should leave office and observe the full mourning period.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth Manchu and Han officials alike must leave office for full parent mourning.

sentences.zh: 命前內閣學士陳寶琛總理禮學館。

translations.literal: Former Grand Secretariat Bachelor Chen Baochen was ordered to direct the Ritual Studies Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Baochen was made head of the Ritual Studies Hall.

sentences.zh: 免浙江仁和等三十二州縣並杭、嚴二衛，杭、衢、嚴三所荒廢田地山塘丁漕銀米。

translations.literal: Wasteland in thirty-two prefectures and counties of Zhejiang including Renhe, and the Hang and Yan guards and three offices, was remitted for land tax, pond tax, and transport silver and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang wasteland taxes and transport dues in thirty-two counties were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，軍機大臣、大學士那桐丁母憂，詔奪情，百日孝滿改署任，仍入直。

translations.literal: On day bingxu Grand Councilor and Grand Secretary Natong mourned his mother; an edict ordered mourning leave withheld, and after a hundred days of filial observance he was to act in his post and still attend council duty.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Natong's mother died; he was ordered to keep working through mourning with acting rank after a hundred days.

sentences.zh: 戊子，置庫倫理刑司員。

translations.literal: On day wuzi judicial commissioners were placed at Urga.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Urga got judicial commissioners.

sentences.zh: 免廣東新礦井口稅。

translations.literal: The new-mine wellhead tax in Guangdong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong's new-mine wellhead tax was cut.

sentences.zh: 予死事安徽炮營管帶官陳昌鏞優恤。

translations.literal: Preferential posthumous treatment was granted Chen Changyong, artillery battalion commander of Anhui who died in service.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui artillery commander Chen Changyong, killed on duty, received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，監國攝政王班見王公百官於文華殿。

translations.literal: On day xinmao the Regent Prince held court audience for princes, dukes, and all officials at Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Regent Prince received officials at Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 增設海參崴總領事。

translations.literal: The post of consul-general at Vladivostok was added.
translations.idiomatic: A consul-general was added at Vladivostok.

sentences.zh: 頒行度支部印花票稅。

translations.literal: The Revenue Ministry's stamp tax was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: The Revenue Ministry's stamp tax took effect.

sentences.zh: 置直省財政監理官。

translations.literal: Provincial fiscal supervisors were established.
translations.idiomatic: Each province got a fiscal supervisor.

sentences.zh: 丙申，裁湖北黃州、荊門、鄖陽、宜昌、施南、德安副將、參將、遊擊、都司、中軍守備各官。

translations.literal: On day bingshen deputy generals, colonels, brigadiers, commandants, and garrison commanders in Huangzhou, Jingmen, Yunyang, Yichang, Shinan, and De'an, Hubei, were all cut.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day many Hubei military posts from Huangzhou to De'an were abolished.

sentences.zh: 出使大臣伍廷芳與美國訂立公斷專約成。

translations.literal: Envoy Wu Tingfang completed the arbitration treaty with the United States.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Tingfang finished the U.S. arbitration treaty.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，修崇陵。

translations.literal: On day dingyou work on Chongling was undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Chongling tomb work began.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，立法政貴胄學堂，命貝勒毓朗總理。

translations.literal: On day wuxu the Aristocratic School of Political Law was founded; Prince Yulang was ordered to direct it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Aristocratic School of Political Law opened under Prince Yulang.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，旌賞年逾百歲甘肅固原州回民李生潮，賜御書匾額。

translations.literal: On day yisi Li Shengchao, a Hui commoner of Guyuan prefecture, Gansu, over a hundred years old, was honored and given an imperial inscribed plaque.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day centenarian Li Shengchao of Gansu received an imperial plaque.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以大行在殯，止年班內外劄薩克蒙古汗、王、貝勒、貝子、公、臺吉、塔布囊等，及呼圖克圖喇嘛，西藏堪布，察木多帕克巴拉，回子伯克，土司、土舍，廓爾喀等毋來京。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, because the late ruler lay in coffin mourning, the annual New Year audiences of Mongol khans, princes, nobles, lamas, Tibetan khutuktus, Qinghai and Xinjiang notables, and others were stopped from coming to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day mourning canceled the annual New Year visits of frontier nobles and lamas.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，增設浙江巡警道、勸業道。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinhai: Zhejiang patrol and encouragement-of-industry circuits were added.
translations.idiomatic: Month 3, xinhai day: Zhejiang added patrol and industry circuits.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復前河南巡撫李鶴年原官。

translations.literal: On day jiayin the former Henan Governor Li Henian was restored to his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Li Henian regained his old Henan governorship.

sentences.zh: 庚申，皇太后懿旨，度支部每歲交進年節另款銀二十八萬兩，自今停進。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, by Empress Dowager rescript, the Revenue Ministry's annual New Year special payment of two hundred eighty thousand taels was stopped from this year.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Empress Dowager ended the Revenue Ministry's annual 280,000-tael holiday payment.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，奉移德宗景皇帝梓宮於西陵梁格莊行宮。

translations.literal: On day xinyou the coffin of the Jing Emperor Dezong was moved to the Lianggezhuang palace at the Western Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Dezong's coffin went to Lianggezhuang at the Western Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以輪船招商局歸郵傳部管轄。

translations.literal: On day jiazi the Steamship Merchants Bureau was placed under the Posts and Communications Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Merchants Steamship Bureau moved to the post ministry.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，復裁奉天巡警道。

translations.literal: On day yichou the Fengtian patrol circuit was again cut.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Fengtian's patrol circuit was cut again.

sentences.zh: 增設洮昌等處兵備道，臨長海等處分巡兵備道。

translations.literal: Defense circuits were added at Taochang and elsewhere and sub-circuit defense posts at Linchanghai and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: New defense circuits were added in Manchuria and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 改奉錦山海關道為錦新等處兵備道兼山海關監督，東邊道為興鳳等處兵備道。

translations.literal: The Fengtian Jinzhou maritime customs circuit became the Jinzhou defense circuit concurrent customs supervisor; the Eastern Circuit became the Xingfeng defense circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian customs and eastern circuits were renamed defense circuits.

sentences.zh: 升興京廳為興京府。

translations.literal: Xingjing Department was raised to Xingjing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xingjing Department became Xingjing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，免梓宮經過宛平、良鄉、涿州、房山、淶水五州縣本年額賦十分之五，易州十分之七，並賞民間平毀麥田銀每畝一錢。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, for the coffin's route through Wanping, Liangxiang, Zhuozhou, Fangshan, and Laishui, half this year's quota tax was remitted; for Yizhou seven-tenths; and silver was granted to compensate leveling wheat fields at one qian per mu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day counties on the coffin route got tax cuts and silver for ruined wheat fields.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔復前戶部尚書立山、兵部尚書徐用儀、吏部左侍郎許景澄、內閣學士聯元、太常寺卿袁昶原官，並賜謚。

translations.literal: On day jisi an edict restored the original posts and granted posthumous titles to the late Ministers Lishan, Xu Yongyi, Vice Minister Xu Jingcheng, Bachelor Lian Yuan, and Director Yuan Chang.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the martyred 1900 ministers were restored and given posthumous titles.

sentences.zh: 命陸軍協都統吳祿貞督辦吉林邊務。

translations.literal: Army Lieutenant Colonel Wu Luzhen was ordered to supervise Jilin frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Luzhen was put in charge of Jilin frontier affairs.

sentences.zh: 裁山西雁平道。

translations.literal: The Shanxi Yanping circuit was cut.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi's Yanping circuit was abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以前外務部左參議楊樞充出使比國大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinwei the former Foreign Ministry left councillor Yang Shu was appointed envoy minister to Belgium.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Yang Shu became minister to Belgium.

sentences.zh: 亞東、江孜、噶大克開埠設關。

translations.literal: Yadong, Gyantse, and Gartok were opened as treaty ports with customs.
translations.idiomatic: Yadong, Gyantse, and Gartok opened as customs ports.

sentences.zh: 丙子，增置奉天輝南直隸廳。

translations.literal: On day bingzi Huinan Direct Prefecture in Fengtian was added.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Huinan Direct Prefecture was added in Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，四川總督趙爾巽、駐藏大臣趙爾豐助款興學，下部優敘。

translations.literal: On day wuyin Sichuan Governor Zhao Erxun and Tibet Commissioner Zhao Erfeng aided schools with funds and were commended by the ministries.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Zhao Erxun and Zhao Erfeng were praised for school donations.

sentences.zh: 趙爾巽捐廉贍族，賞御書「誼篤宗親」匾額。

translations.literal: Zhao Erxun donated his salary to support his clan and was given an imperial plaque reading "Deep kinship duty."
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Erxun's clan support won an imperial "Deep kinship duty" plaque.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，以各國遣使來吊，命貝子銜鎮國將軍載振使日本，法部尚書戴鴻慈使俄羅斯報謝，他國命駐使將事。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen: because foreign envoys came to offer condolences, Prince Guo rank Zaizhen was sent to Japan and Law Minister Dai Hongci to Russia to return thanks; other countries were handled by resident ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Month 4, gengchen: Zaizhen went to Japan and Dai Hongci to Russia to thank condolence missions; other states used resident ministers.

sentences.zh: 甲申，度支部立幣制調查局，鑄通行銀幣。

translations.literal: On day jiashen the Revenue Ministry established a currency investigation bureau and cast circulating silver coin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day a currency bureau was set up and silver coin minted.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，普免光緒十四年訖光緒三十三年直省逋賦。

translations.literal: On day yiyou arrears from Guangxu years 14 through 33 in the provinces were broadly remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day tax arrears from Guangxu 14–33 were broadly forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，裁吉林琿春、三姓、寧古塔、伯都訥、阿勒楚喀各城副都統。

translations.literal: On day guisi deputy commanders at Hunchun, Sanxing, Ningguta, Boduna, and Alechuka in Jilin were all cut.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day five Jilin deputy commanders were abolished.

sentences.zh: 置琿春兵備道，三姓兵備道。

translations.literal: Hunchun and Sanxing defense circuits were established.
translations.idiomatic: Hunchun and Sanxing got defense circuits.

sentences.zh: 升改增置綏芬、延吉、五常、雙城、賓州、臨江諸府，伊通直隸州，榆樹直隸廳，寶清、綏遠二州，琿春、濱江、東寧三廳，富錦、穆棱、和龍、樺川、臨湖、汪清、額穆諸縣。

translations.literal: Suifen, Yanji, Wuchang, Shuangcheng, Binzhou, Linjiang, and other prefectures, Yitong Direct Prefecture, Yushu Direct Department, Baoqing and Suiyuan prefectures, Hunchun, Binjiang, and Dongning departments, and Fuxin, Muling, Helong, Huachuan, Linhu, Wangqing, and E'mu counties were raised, changed, or newly established.
translations.idiomatic: Many Jilin prefectures, departments, and counties were created or upgraded.

sentences.zh: 尋復設舒蘭、阿城、勃利、饒河四縣。

translations.literal: Soon after, Shulan, Acheng, Boli, and Raohe counties were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Shulan, Acheng, Boli, and Raohe counties were soon restored.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命內閣、部院、翰林、科道會議德宗升祔大禮。

translations.literal: On day jiawu the Grand Secretariat, ministries, Hanlin, and censorate were ordered to confer on the great rite of elevating Dezong to the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day offices were told to plan Dezong's ancestral temple elevation.

sentences.zh: 乙未，祈雨。

translations.literal: On day yiwei prayers were offered for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 丙申，甘肅蘭州、涼州、鞏昌、碾伯、會寧各屬災，發帑銀六萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day bingshen disasters struck Lanzhou, Liangzhou, Gongchang, Nianbo, and Huining in Gansu; sixty thousand taels were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day sixty thousand taels relieved Gansu disasters.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，裁奉天左右參贊，承宣、諮議兩廳。

translations.literal: On day renyin Fengtian left and right councillors and the Announcement and Deliberation offices were cut.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Fengtian councillors and two offices were cut.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，復祈雨。

translations.literal: On day jiachen prayers for rain were offered again.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the court prayed for rain again.

sentences.zh: 戊申，諭禁煙大臣切實考驗，毋許瞻徇敷衍。

translations.literal: On day wushen the opium prohibition ministers were instructed to examine in earnest and not show favoritism or perfunctory work.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day opium commissioners were told to enforce the ban without favoritism.

sentences.zh: 外省文武職官學堂，責成督、撫、將軍、都統等嚴查禁。

translations.literal: Provincial civil and military official schools were charged to governors, generals, and commanders for strict prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: Governors and generals were to enforce bans in provincial official schools.

sentences.zh: 五月己酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day jiyou: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Month 5, jiyou new moon: a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，廷試遊學畢業生進士黃德章等一百二十人，授官有差。

translations.literal: On day xinhai the palace examination was held for returned-student jinshi including Huang Dezhang, one hundred twenty persons; offices were granted by grade.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day 120 returned-student jinshi including Huang Dezhang passed the palace exam and received ranks.

sentences.zh: 壬子，於式枚言，各省諮議局章程與普魯士國地方議會制度不符。

translations.literal: On day renzi Yu Shimei said the provincial deliberative assembly regulations did not match the Prussian local parliament system.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Yu Shimei said provincial assembly rules diverged from Prussia's.

sentences.zh: 下憲政編查館妥議。

translations.literal: The matter was sent to the Constitutional Compilation and Review Office for proper deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The constitutional office was told to review it.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，陳啟泰卒，以瑞澂為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guichou Chen Qitai died; Rui Cheng was made Jiangsu Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Chen Qitai died and Rui Cheng became Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 允浙江紳士為故兵部尚書徐用儀、吏部右侍郎許景澄、太常寺卿袁昶於浙江西湖立祠。

translations.literal: Zhejiang gentry were permitted to build temples at West Lake to the late Ministers Xu Yongyi and Xu Jingcheng and Director Yuan Chang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang gentry were allowed West Lake shrines to the 1900 martyred ministers.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復祈雨。

translations.literal: On day jiayin prayers for rain were offered again.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the court prayed for rain again.

sentences.zh: 陜甘總督升允以疏陳立憲利弊罷，以長庚代之。

translations.literal: Shaanxi-Gansu Governor Sheng Yun was dismissed for memorializing on constitutional pros and cons; Chang Geng replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Yun was removed as Shaanxi-Gansu governor for his constitutional memorial; Chang Geng replaced him.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命廣福署伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: On day yimao Guangfu was ordered to act as Ili General.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Guangfu acted as Ili general.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，聯豫、溫宗堯奏陳西藏籌辦練兵興學事宜。

translations.literal: On day dingsi Lianyu and Wen Zongyao memorialized on training troops and founding schools in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Lianyu and Wen Zongyao reported on Tibetan troops and schools.

sentences.zh: 己未，命世續署外務部會辦大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiwei Shixu was ordered to act as joint foreign minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Shixu acted as joint foreign minister.

sentences.zh: 楊士驤卒，以端方為直隸總督兼辦理通商事務大臣，張人駿為兩江總督兼辦理通商事務大臣，孫寶琦署山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Yang Shixiang died; Duan Fang became Zhili Governor and trade minister, Zhang Renjun became Liangjiang Governor and trade minister, and Sun Baoqi acted as Shandong Governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shixiang died; Duan Fang took Zhili, Zhang Renjun took Liangjiang, Sun Baoqi acted in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以乍丫地方曩屬四川，命畫歸邊務大臣管轄。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, because Chaya had formerly belonged to Sichuan, it was ordered placed under the frontier affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Chaya was put under the frontier commissioner as former Sichuan territory.

sentences.zh: 甲子，諭農工商部趣各省興舉農林工藝各政。

translations.literal: On day jiazi the Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce Ministry was urged to press each province to promote agriculture, forestry, and crafts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day provinces were urged to expand agriculture, forestry, and industry.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，復祈雨。

translations.literal: On day yichou prayers for rain were offered again.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the court prayed for rain again.

sentences.zh: 是日雨。

translations.literal: That day it rained.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell that day.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，復前協辦大學士、戶部尚書翁同龢原官。

translations.literal: On day wuchen the former joint grand secretary and Revenue Minister Weng Tonghe was restored to his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Weng Tonghe regained his old rank.

sentences.zh: 己巳，唐紹儀免奉天巡撫，以侍郎候補。

translations.literal: On day jisi Tang Shaoyi was removed as Fengtian Governor and kept as vice minister on reserve.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Tang Shaoyi left Fengtian governorship for vice-minister reserve.

sentences.zh: 辛未，立遊美學務處。

translations.literal: On day xinwei the Office for Study in America was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Office for Study in America was founded.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，河南省改編營制。

translations.literal: On day guiyou Henan's camp organization was reorganized.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Henan reorganized its camps.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賑雲南南寧州地震災。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu Nanning prefecture, Yunnan, earthquake victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Yunnan's Nanning earthquake victims were fed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔立軍諮處，以貝勒毓朗領之。

translations.literal: On day bingzi an edict established the General Staff; Prince Yulang was placed at its head.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the General Staff was founded under Prince Yulang.

sentences.zh: 攝政王代為統率陸海軍大元帥，貝勒載洵、提督薩鎮冰俱充籌辦海軍大臣。

translations.literal: The Regent Prince acted as commander-in-chief of land and sea forces; Prince Zaitao and Admiral Sa Zhenbing were both made naval planning ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The Regent Prince commanded land and sea forces; Zaitao and Sa Zhenbing planned the navy.

sentences.zh: 賑湖南澧州水災。

translations.literal: Flood victims in Lizhou, Hunan, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan's Lizhou flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命貝勒載濤管理軍諮處事務。

translations.literal: On day dingchou Prince Zaitao was ordered to manage General Staff affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Zaitao managed General Staff affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，慶親王奕劻免管理陸軍部事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiashen: Prince Qing Yikuang was removed from managing Army Ministry affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Month 6, jiashen: Yikuang left Army Ministry management.

sentences.zh: 賑湖北漢陽等府水災。

translations.literal: Flood victims in Hanyang and other prefectures of Hubei were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei flood victims in Hanyang and elsewhere were fed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，伊犁始編練陸軍。

translations.literal: On day yiyou land forces in Ili began organized drill.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Ili began drilling a land army.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，授程德全奉天巡撫，陳昭常吉林巡撫，周樹模黑龍江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingxu Cheng Detuan was made Fengtian Governor, Chen Zhaochang Jilin Governor, and Zhou Shumo Heilongjiang Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Cheng Detuan, Chen Zhaochang, and Zhou Shumo became the three Manchuria governors.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，開甘肅臯蘭縣、新城、西固城渠，以工代賑。

translations.literal: On day dinghai canals at Gaolan, Xincheng, and Xigu in Gansu were opened for work relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Gansu canal work employed flood victims.

sentences.zh: 己丑，賑雲南彌勒縣習洱等處地震災。

translations.literal: On day jichou earthquake victims in Mile county and Xier in Yunnan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Yunnan earthquake victims in Mile and Xier were fed.

sentences.zh: 免雲南太和縣屬上年被災田糧。

translations.literal: Grain tax for last year's disaster fields in Taihe county, Yunnan, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Taihe's disaster grain tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，復已故降調兩廣總督毛鴻賓原官。

translations.literal: On day gengyin the late demoted Liang-Guang Governor Mao Hongbin was restored to his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Mao Hongbin regained his old Liang-Guang post.

sentences.zh: 追予禦賊殉難已故江蘇常州府通判嶽昌於常州府建祠。

translations.literal: Yue Chang of Changzhou prefecture, Jiangsu, who died fighting bandits, was posthumously granted a shrine in Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Chang, killed fighting bandits, got a shrine in Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 賑奉天安東水災。

translations.literal: Flood victims in Andong, Fengtian, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Andong flood victims in Fengtian were fed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，呂海寰罷，以徐世昌充督辦津浦鐵路大臣，沈雲沛副之。

translations.literal: On day jiawu Lv Haihuan was dismissed; Xu Shichang was made chief commissioner of the Tianjin-Pukou Railway and Shen Yunpei his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Lv Haihuan left office; Xu Shichang headed the Tianjin-Pukou Railway with Shen Yunpei as deputy.

sentences.zh: 更奉天錦新道名錦新營口等處分巡兵備道。

translations.literal: The Fengtian Jinzhou circuit was renamed the Jinzhou-Yingkou sub-circuit defense post.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian's Jinzhou circuit was renamed the Jinzhou-Yingkou defense sub-circuit.

sentences.zh: 乙未，吉林大水，發帑銀六萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day yiwei great floods in Jilin; sixty thousand taels were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day sixty thousand taels relieved Jilin's great flood.

sentences.zh: 賑湖南澧州、安鄉、常德、岳州等廳州縣水災。

translations.literal: Floods in Lizhou, Anxiang, Changde, Yuezhou, and other districts of Hunan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan floods from Lizhou to Yuezhou were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，湖北荊州、漢陽兩府潦，發帑銀六萬兩，並命籌銀二十萬兩急賑之。

translations.literal: On day dingyou floods in Jingzhou and Hanyang prefectures, Hubei; sixty thousand taels were issued and two hundred thousand taels were ordered raised for urgent relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Hubei's Jingzhou and Hanyang floods got sixty thousand taels plus orders to raise two hundred thousand more.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，除熱河新軍營房占用圈地額租。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, quota rent on banner land occupied by new barracks in Rehe was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Rehe barracks land rent was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賑浙江錢塘等十一縣水災。

translations.literal: On day renyin flood victims in Qiantang and ten other counties of Zhejiang were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Zhejiang floods in Qiantang and ten counties were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，罷張勛東三省行營翼長，命赴甘肅提督任。

translations.literal: On day guimao Zhang Xun was removed as Eastern Three Provinces field deputy and ordered to his Gansu provincial commander post.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Zhang Xun left Manchuria for Gansu commander.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命伍廷芳、錢恂俱來京，以署外務部右丞張蔭棠為出使美墨秘古四國大臣，署外務部右參議吳宗濂為出使義國大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiachen Wu Tingfang and Qian Xun were both ordered to the capital; Acting Foreign Ministry right director Zhang Yintang was made envoy to the United States, Mexico, Peru, and Cuba, and Acting right councillor Wu Zonglian envoy to Italy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Wu Tingfang and Qian Xun were recalled; Zhang Yintang went to the Americas and Wu Zonglian to Italy.

sentences.zh: 趙爾巽奏平四川寧遠淺水倮夷。

translations.literal: Zhao Erxun memorialized that shallow-water Lolo in Ningyuan, Sichuan, were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Erxun reported pacifying shallow-water Lolo in Sichuan's Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賞京師貧民棉衣銀，後以為常。

translations.literal: On day yisi cotton-clothing silver was granted to the capital poor; this became regular.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the capital poor got winter-clothing silver, later annual.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命李準為廣東水師提督。

translations.literal: On day bingwu Li Zhun was made Guangdong naval commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Li Zhun became Guangdong naval commander.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申朔，裁湖南常德、寶慶、永順、岳州、澧州、臨武、桂陽、宣奉、永州、武岡、沅州、綏靖、辰州、嶺東各協、營，暨撫標、提標副將、參將、遊擊、都司、守備等官。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, new moon on day wushen: Hunan garrisons and camps at Changde, Baoqing, Yongshun, Yuezhou, Lizhou, Linwu, Guiyang, Xuanfeng, Yongzhou, Wugang, Yuanzhou, Suijing, Chenzhou, Lingdong, and others, with brigade and provincial deputy and staff posts, were all cut.
translations.idiomatic: Month 7, wushen new moon: Hunan cut many garrisons and staff posts.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，浚遼河。

translations.literal: On day guichou the Liao River was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the Liao River was dredged.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，籌辦海軍大臣上擬訂海軍長官旗式章服圖說，管理軍諮處上酌擬軍諮處暫行章程。

translations.literal: On day bingchen the naval planning ministers submitted draft flags and uniforms for naval officers, and the General Staff submitted provisional regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day navy insignia drafts and General Staff rules were filed.

sentences.zh: 賑江西萍鄉等縣水災。

translations.literal: Flood victims in Pingxiang and other counties of Jiangxi were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi's Pingxiang flood victims were fed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，停秋決。

translations.literal: On day dingsi autumn executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day autumn executions were halted.

sentences.zh: 法部上補訂高等各級審判廳試辦章程及擬定外省審判廳編制大綱。

translations.literal: The Law Ministry submitted supplementary trial regulations for high courts and a draft organization for provincial courts.
translations.idiomatic: The Law Ministry filed high-court trial rules and provincial court outlines.

sentences.zh: 開四川重慶江北廳龍王洞煤鐵礦。

translations.literal: Coal and iron mines at Dragon King Cave, Jiangbei department, Chongqing, Sichuan, were opened.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan's Chongqing Jiangbei Dragon King Cave mines opened.

sentences.zh: 戊午，免雲南魯甸、鎮雄二廳被災田畝銀米。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, silver and grain for disaster fields in Ludian and Zhenxiong departments, Yunnan, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Ludian and Zhenxiong disaster taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲申，南洋籌設勸業會，命南洋大臣、兩江總督張人駿為會長，各省籌辦協會，出品免稅釐。

translations.literal: On day jiashen a southern industry exhibition was planned; Liangjiang Governor Zhang Renjun was made chairman; each province was to organize associations and exhibit goods tax-free.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Zhang Renjun chaired a southern industry fair with tax-free exhibits.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，德宗景皇帝梓宮奉移山陵，免所過各州縣旗租，並賞籽種銀。

translations.literal: On day xinyou the Jing Emperor Dezong's coffin was moved to the mountain tomb; banner rent on the route was remitted and seed silver granted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Dezong's coffin went to the tomb with route tax relief and seed silver.

sentences.zh: 甲子，裁河南糧鹽道，增置巡警、勸業二道。

translations.literal: On day jiazi the Henan grain-salt circuit was cut and patrol and encouragement-of-industry circuits were added.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Henan cut its grain-salt circuit and added patrol and industry circuits.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，諭直省整飭積穀。

translations.literal: On day wuchen the provinces were instructed to restore granary reserves.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day provinces were told to refill granaries.

sentences.zh: 恤以死建言頤和園八品苑副永麟。

translations.literal: The eighth-rank Summer Palace garden deputy Yong Lin, who died remonstrating, was posthumously comforted.
translations.idiomatic: Yong Lin, who died remonstrating at the Summer Palace, was posthumously honored.

sentences.zh: 庚午，增設南洋各島領事。

translations.literal: On day gengwu consuls were added on southern islands.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day southern-island consuls were added.

sentences.zh: 壬申，學部立圖書館於京師。

translations.literal: On day renshen the Education Ministry established a library in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the Education Ministry opened a capital library.

sentences.zh: 洪江會匪姚芢山伏誅。

translations.literal: Yao Qishan of the Hong River secret society was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Hong River rebel Yao Qishan was executed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，湖北平糶。

translations.literal: On day bingzi Hubei sold grain at fair price.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Hubei sold grain at fair price.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑朔，考察憲政大臣李家駒進日本司法制度考等書。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on day dingchou: Constitutional Investigation Commissioner Li Jiaju presented books such as his study of Japan's judicial system.
translations.idiomatic: Month 8, dingchou new moon: Li Jiaju filed studies including Japan's judiciary.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，開黑龍江墨爾根嫩江甘河煤礦。

translations.literal: On day xinsi coal mines on the Gan River at Mergen, Heilongjiang, were opened.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Heilongjiang's Mergen Gan River coal mines opened.

sentences.zh: 甲申，改吉林濱江道為西北路道，西路道為西南路道，並前設之東北路道、東南路道俱名分巡兵備道。

translations.literal: On day jiashen Jilin's Binjiang circuit became the Northwest Circuit, the West Circuit the Southwest Circuit, and the earlier Northeast and Southeast circuits were all named sub-circuit defense posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Jilin circuits were renamed northwest, southwest, northeast, and southeast defense posts.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑福建福州風災，熱河開魯、平泉兩州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day yiyou Fuzhou wind disaster and floods in Kailu and Pingquan, Rehe, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Fujian wind and Rehe floods were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，藏番不靖，趙爾豐剿定之。

translations.literal: On day bingxu Tibetan unrest was pacified by Zhao Erfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Zhao Erfeng pacified Tibetan unrest.

sentences.zh: 命候補內閣學士李家駒協理資政院事。

translations.literal: Candidate Grand Secretariat Bachelor Li Jiaju was ordered to assist the Political Consultative Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiaju was told to assist the Political Consultative Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 戊子，京張鐵路工成。

translations.literal: On day wuzi the Beijing-Zhangjiakou Railway was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Beijing-Zhangjiakou Railway opened.

sentences.zh: 除浙江鎮海縣開浚河道挖廢民竈田地銀米。

translations.literal: Silver and grain for fields ruined digging channels in Zhenhai county, Zhejiang, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenhai's ruined canal fields were forgiven tax.

sentences.zh: 己丑，開湖南平江金礦，新化銻礦，常寧鉛礦。

translations.literal: On day jichou gold mines in Pingjiang, Hunan, antimony in Xinhua, and lead in Changning were opened.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Hunan opened Pingjiang gold, Xinhua antimony, and Changning lead mines.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，予救父捐軀湖北黃陂縣舉人陳鴻偉孝行，宣付史館。

translations.literal: On day gengyin Chen Hongwei, a juren of Huangpi, Hubei, who died saving his father, received praise for filial conduct and was recorded in the histories.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day filial martyr Chen Hongwei of Huangpi was recorded in the histories.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大學士孫家鼐、張之洞並以病乞休。

translations.literal: On day dingyou Grand Secretaries Sun Jianai and Zhang Zhidong both asked to retire for illness.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Sun Jianai and Zhang Zhidong both sought sick retirement.

sentences.zh: 詔慰留之。

translations.literal: An edict urged them to remain.
translations.idiomatic: An edict asked them to stay.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，農工商部奏試行勸業富簽公債票。

translations.literal: On day wuxu the Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce Ministry memorialized on trial issue of industry-promotion bonds.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the ministry trialed industry-promotion bonds.

sentences.zh: 己亥，大學士張之洞卒，贈太保，入祀賢良祠。

translations.literal: On day jihai Grand Secretary Zhang Zhidong died; he was posthumously made Grand Guardian and entered the Temple of Eminent Statesmen.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Zhang Zhidong died and was made Grand Guardian with temple honors.

sentences.zh: 命戴鴻慈在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: Dai Hongci was ordered to study at the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Hongci was told to learn on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 以廷傑為法部尚書，葛寶華為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Ting Jie was made Law Minister and Ge Baohua Rites Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Ting Jie became law minister and Ge Baohua rites minister.

sentences.zh: 庚子，調誠勛為熱河都統，以溥良為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: On day gengzi Cheng Xun was transferred as Rehe Commander-in-Chief and Pu Liang as Chahar Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Cheng Xun took Rehe and Pu Liang Chahar.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，京師開廠煮粥濟貧民，發粟二千五百石有奇，已改設教養局、習藝所者仍給之，歲以為常。

translations.literal: On day guimao the capital opened porridge kitchens for the poor; over twenty-five hundred shi of grain were issued; institutions already reformed as relief bureaus and craft schools still received grain — this became annual.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day capital porridge kitchens fed the poor with 2,500+ shi yearly thereafter.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，修訂法律大臣進編訂現行刑律，下憲政編查館核議。

translations.literal: On day yisi the statute-revision legal ministers submitted the compiled current penal code; it was sent to the Constitutional Compilation and Review Office.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the revised penal code went to the constitutional office.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔以九月初一日為各省召集議員開議之期，特申誥誡。

translations.literal: On day bingwu an edict fixed the first day of the ninth month as the date for each province to convene delegates and open session, with special admonition.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the ninth month's first day was fixed for provincial assemblies to open.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「諮議局議員於地方利弊當切實指陳，妥善計畫。

translations.literal: An instruction said: 「Deliberative assembly delegates should frankly state local gains and losses and plan soundly.
translations.idiomatic: The throne said: 「Assembly delegates must speak frankly on local good and harm and plan carefully.

sentences.zh: 勿挾私心以妨公益，勿逞意氣以紊成規，勿見事太易而議論稍涉囂張，勿權限不明而定法或滋侵越。

translations.literal: Do not let private interest harm the public good, nor temper flare and disorder settled rules, nor treat matters as too easy and speak with undue boldness, nor let unclear authority make laws encroach.
translations.idiomatic: They must not serve private ends, break rules in anger, speak rashly, or exceed legal bounds.

sentences.zh: 各督撫亦當虛心采納，裁度施行，以期上下一心，漸臻上理。

translations.literal: Each governor should also listen with an open mind, weigh, and carry out measures, so court and provinces may be of one mind and gradually reach good order.
translations.idiomatic: Governors must heed them and act so court and provinces move together toward order.

sentences.zh: 至開局以後，各督撫尤應遵照定章，實行監督，務使議決事件不稍逾越權限，違背法律。

translations.literal: After sessions open, each governor should especially follow the fixed regulations, truly supervise, and ensure resolved matters do not exceed authority or violate law.
translations.idiomatic: Once assemblies meet, governors must supervise so decisions stay within law and authority.

sentences.zh: 共攄忠愛，以圖富強，朕實有厚望焉。

translations.literal: Together offer loyal devotion to seek strength and wealth — We place great hope in this.
translations.idiomatic: Serve loyally for national strength — the throne expects much.

sentences.zh: 」是月，載洵、薩鎮冰出洋考查海軍。

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.) That month Zaitao and Sa Zhenbing went abroad to inspect the navy.
translations.idiomatic: The instruction closed. That month Zaitao and Sa Zhenbing inspected navies abroad.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未朔，始制爵章頒賜。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day dingwei: orders of nobility insignia were first made and conferred.
translations.idiomatic: Month 9, dingwei new moon: nobility insignia were first issued.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，和蘭保和會條約成，分別批準畫押。

translations.literal: On day xinhai the Hague Convention treaty was completed and ratified separately.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Hague Convention was signed and ratified.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命趙爾巽兼署成都將軍。

translations.literal: On day guichou Zhao Erxun was additionally ordered to act as Chengdu General.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Zhao Erxun also acted as Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，內閣會奏德宗升祔大禮。

translations.literal: On day yimao the Grand Secretariat jointly memorialized on the great rite of elevating Dezong.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Grand Secretariat reported Dezong's temple elevation rites.

sentences.zh: 詔穆宗毅皇帝、德宗景皇帝同為百世不祧之廟，宜以昭穆分左右，不以昭穆分尊卑。

translations.literal: An edict said the Yi Emperor Muzong and the Jing Emperor Dezong are both temples that must never be displaced; they should stand left and right by zhao-mu sequence, not by zhao-mu rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict placed Muzong and Dezong as co-eternal temples by left-right zhao-mu, not by rank.

sentences.zh: 定德宗升祔太廟中殿，供奉西又次楹又五室穆位。

translations.literal: Dezong's elevation to the Grand Temple central hall was fixed in the western second row, fifth mu chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong would enter the central Grand Temple hall in the western fifth mu chamber.

sentences.zh: 前殿於文宗顯皇帝之次，恭設坐西東向穆位。

translations.literal: In the front hall, next to the Xian Emperor Wenzong, a seat facing west in the mu position was respectfully set.
translations.idiomatic: A western-facing mu seat was set before the hall beside Wenzong.

sentences.zh: 奉先殿準此。

translations.literal: The Hall of Ancestors followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Ancestors followed the same rule.

sentences.zh: 永為定制。

translations.literal: This was fixed as perpetual statute.
translations.idiomatic: The arrangement became permanent law.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賞陸軍貴胄學堂畢業學生子爵成全等侍衛，及進敘有差。

translations.literal: On day dingsi graduates of the Aristocratic Army Academy such as Zicheng Quan, made imperial bodyguards, received attendant rank and graded promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day army academy graduates including Zicheng Quan became guards with graded promotion.

sentences.zh: 己未，資政院上選舉章程。

translations.literal: On day jiwei the Political Consultative Pavilion submitted election regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the Political Consultative Pavilion filed election rules.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，德人遊歷雲南，為怒夷所害，捕誅之。

translations.literal: On day renxu a German traveling in Yunnan was killed by angry Yi; the killers were seized and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Yunnan Yi killed a German traveler; the killers were caught and executed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，豫河安瀾。

translations.literal: On day jiazi the Yellow River in Henan ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Henan Yellow River ran clear.

sentences.zh: 賑廣東省城及南海各縣水災。

translations.literal: Floods in Guangzhou and Nanhai counties of Guangdong were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong floods in Guangzhou and Nanhai were relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，錫林果勒盟阿巴嘎、阿巴哈那爾、浩齊特、烏珠穆沁災，發帑銀三萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day yichou disaster in Xilin Gol leagues Abag, Abahanar, Haoqit, and Ujimqin; thirty thousand taels were issued.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day thirty thousand taels aided Xilin Gol league disasters.

sentences.zh: 賑雲南鎮雄等州縣水災。

translations.literal: Floods in Zhenxiong and other prefectures and counties of Yunnan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan floods in Zhenxiong and elsewhere were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，黃河安瀾。

translations.literal: On day bingyin the Yellow River ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Yellow River ran clear.

sentences.zh: 授鹿傳霖體仁閣大學士，吏部尚書陸潤庠協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Lu Chuanlin was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory; Personnel Minister Lu Runxiang joint grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Chuanlin became a grand secretary; Lu Runxiang joint grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 賞遊學畢業生項驤等舉人。

translations.literal: Returned students including Xiang Xiang were granted juren rank.
translations.idiomatic: Returned students including Xiang Xiang became juren.

sentences.zh: 辛未，升翰林院侍講學士為正四品，侍讀、侍講從四品，撰文秘書郎、修撰正五品，編修、檢討從五品。

translations.literal: On day xinwei Hanlin academicians were raised to fourth rank, readers and lecturers to sub-fourth, drafting secretaries to fifth, compilers and reviewers to sub-fifth.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Hanlin ranks were raised.

sentences.zh: 頒爪哇僑民捐立學堂扁額。

translations.literal: Plaques for schools overseas Chinese built in Java were issued.
translations.idiomatic: Java overseas Chinese school plaques were issued.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，南河安瀾。

translations.literal: On day guiyou the southern Yellow River ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the southern Yellow River ran clear.

sentences.zh: 是月，韓人安重根戕日本前朝鮮統監伊藤博文於哈爾濱。

translations.literal: That month the Korean An Jung-geun assassinated former Japanese resident-general of Korea Ito Hirobumi at Harbin.
translations.idiomatic: That month Korean An Jung-geun killed Ito Hirobumi at Harbin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑朔，四川西昌、會理交界二板房夷匪為亂，官軍剿平之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, new moon on day dingchou: Yi bandits at Erbangfang on the Xichang-Huili border in Sichuan rebelled and were suppressed by government troops.
translations.idiomatic: Month 10, dingchou new moon: Sichuan Yi rebels at Erbangfang were crushed.

sentences.zh: 成都將軍馬亮卒。

translations.literal: Chengdu General Ma Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Liang, Chengdu general, died.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，葬孝欽顯皇后於菩陀峪定東陵，免梓宮經過州縣地方額賦，並賞平毀麥田籽種銀。

translations.literal: On day gengchen the Xiaokin Empress Dowager was buried at Putuo Valley, Ding Eastern Mausoleum; quota tax on the coffin route was remitted and seed silver granted for leveling wheat fields.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the late empress dowager was buried at Putuo Valley with route tax relief.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，孝欽顯皇后神牌祔太廟，翼日頒詔天下。

translations.literal: On day yiyou the late empress dowager's spirit tablet entered the Grand Temple; the next day an edict was issued to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day her tablet entered the Grand Temple and was announced next day.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，定成都將軍勿庸統轄松潘、建昌。

translations.literal: On day bingxu it was fixed that the Chengdu General need not command Songpan and Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Chengdu general no longer commanded Songpan and Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 以玉昆為成都將軍。

translations.literal: Yu Kun was made Chengdu General.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Kun became Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，直隸總督端方坐違制奪職。

translations.literal: On day dinghai Zhili Governor Duan Fang was removed for violating regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Duan Fang lost Zhili for breaking rules.

sentences.zh: 調陳夔龍為直隸總督，兼辦理通商事務大臣，瑞澂署湖廣總督，寶棻為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Chen Qilong was transferred as Zhili Governor and trade minister; Rui Cheng acted as Huguang Governor; Bao Fen became Jiangsu Governor.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Qilong took Zhili, Rui Cheng acted in Huguang, Bao Fen took Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 以孫寶琦為山東巡撫，丁寶銓為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Sun Baoqi was made Shandong Governor and Ding Baochen Shanxi Governor.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Baoqi became Shandong governor and Ding Baochen Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔第一、二屆籌辦憲政事宜，內外諸臣應竭誠負責，並命憲政編查館稽核所奏成績，有因循敷衍、措置遲逾者，甄劾以聞。

translations.literal: On day jichou an edict on first- and second-stage constitutional preparation ordered all officials to serve faithfully and the Constitutional Compilation and Review Office to audit results and impeach delay or perfunctory work.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day constitutional prep was audited and slack officials could be impeached.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，憲政編查館上釐定各省提法使官制章程。

translations.literal: On day gengyin the Constitutional Compilation and Review Office submitted finalized regulations for provincial chief procurators.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day provincial chief-procurator rules were finalized.

sentences.zh: 開庫倫哈拉格囊圍金礦。

translations.literal: Gold mines at Harag Langang, Urga, were opened.
translations.idiomatic: Urga's Harag Langang gold mines opened.

sentences.zh: 延祉以疾免，命三多署庫倫辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Yan Zhi was removed for illness; Sanduo was ordered to act as Urga Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhi left for illness; Sanduo acted as Urga commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，江蘇溧陽、金壇、荊溪、宜興、丹徒、丹陽、震澤等縣災，發帑銀三萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day xinmao disasters in Liyang, Jintan, Jingxi, Yixing, Dantu, Danyang, Zhenze, and other counties of Jiangsu; thirty thousand taels were issued.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day thirty thousand taels relieved Jiangsu county disasters.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，民政部奏，援案請賞米石，核定各廠院實需數目，收養貧民，詔行之。

translations.literal: On day guisi the Civil Affairs Ministry memorialized to grant rice by precedent, fix each institution's real needs, and shelter the poor; an edict followed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the ministry's poor-relief rice plan was approved.

sentences.zh: 賑雲南大姚、文山等縣水災。

translations.literal: Floods in Dayao and Wenshan counties, Yunnan, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan floods in Dayao and Wenshan were relieved.

sentences.zh: 甲午，大學士孫家鼐卒，贈太傅，入祀賢良祠，賞銀治喪。

translations.literal: On day jiawu Grand Secretary Sun Jianai died; he was posthumously made Grand Tutor, entered the Temple of Eminent Statesmen, and granted silver for the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Sun Jianai died with Grand Tutor honors and funeral silver.

sentences.zh: 詔以已故五品卿銜山西即用知縣汪宗沂經學卓越，宣付史館。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the late fifth-rank Qing title Shanxi candidate magistrate Wang Zongyi, eminent in classical learning, recorded in the histories.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zongyi, classical scholar, was ordered recorded in the histories.

sentences.zh: 賞食餉閑散宗室、覺羅人等一月錢糧，暨孤寡半月錢糧，八旗、綠、步各營官兵半月錢糧，歲以為常。

translations.literal: One month's stipend was granted idle bannermen and imperial clansmen, half a month's to widows and orphans, and half a month's to Eight Banner, Green Standard, and Foot Garrison troops — this became annual.
translations.idiomatic: Bannermen, orphans, and troops got annual stipend grants.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免雲南元江州屬被水田畝銀米。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, silver and grain for flooded fields in Yuanjiang prefecture, Yunnan, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Yuanjiang flood taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚子，東明黃河安瀾。

translations.literal: On day gengzi the Yellow River at Dongming ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Dongming Yellow River ran clear.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，除廣東緝匪花紅，自今文武官有再收花紅者以贓論。

translations.literal: On day guimao the Guangdong bandit-capture reward was abolished; hereafter any civil or military official who again took such rewards would be treated as bribery.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Guangdong capture bonuses ended; taking them became bribery.

sentences.zh: 復前禮部尚書李端棻原官。

translations.literal: The former Rites Minister Li Duanfen was restored to his original post.
translations.idiomatic: Li Duanfen regained his old rites post.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，停今年吉林珠貢。

translations.literal: On day jiachen this year's Jilin pearl tribute was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Jilin's pearl tribute was canceled this year.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，順天紳士請為已故戶部尚書立山、內閣學士聯元立祠，許之。

translations.literal: On day yisi Shuntian gentry asked temples for the late Ministers Lishan and Bachelor Lian Yuan; it was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Shuntian was allowed shrines to Lishan and Lian Yuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，免直隸武清等十一廳縣額賦旗租，開州、東明、長垣等三州縣額賦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wushen: quota tax and banner rent in eleven departments and counties of Zhili including Wuqing were remitted, and quota tax in Kaizhou, Dongming, and Changyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Month 11, wushen: Zhili tax and banner rent were cut in eleven districts and three counties.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上兼祧母后皇太后徽號曰隆裕皇太后，翼日頒詔天下。
