translations.literal: On day jiyou the honorific title for the Empress Dowager who was both line mother was conferred as Empress Dowager Longyu; the next day an edict was issued to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the dual-line empress dowager received the title Longyu and it was announced next day.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，民政部上府廳州縣自治選舉章程。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Ministry of Civil Affairs submitted regulations for self-government elections in prefectures, departments, and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Civil Affairs sent up fu-ting-zhou-xian self-government election rules.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，復前福建巡撫張兆棟原官。

translations.literal: On day guihai, former Fujian governor Zhang Zhaodong was restored to his original office.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Zhang Zhaodong regained his former Fujian governor post.

sentences.zh: 設黑龍江璦琿沿邊卡倫二十，自額爾古訥河訖於遜河口。

translations.literal: Twenty border guard posts were established along the Aihui frontier in Heilongjiang, from the Ergun River to the Xun River mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty Aihui border guard posts were set from the Ergun to the Xun estuary.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，置督辦鹽政大臣，以載澤為之，產鹽省分督撫為會辦鹽政大臣，行鹽省分督撫俱兼銜。

translations.literal: On day yichou, a Superintendent of Salt Administration was created, with Zaize as incumbent; governors-general and governors of salt-producing provinces were made co-superintendents, and governors-general and governors of salt-distribution provinces all received concurrent titles.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day a salt superintendent was created under Zaize; producing provinces' governors co-supervised and distributing provinces' governors took concurrent titles.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，授陸潤庠體仁閣大學士，戴鴻慈以尚書協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Lu Runxiang was made Grand Secretary of the Tiren Hall, and Dai Hongci Associate Grand Secretary as minister.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Lu Runxiang became Tiren Hall grand secretary and Dai Hongci associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以貝勒毓朗為步軍統領。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Prince Yulang was made commander of the Metropolitan Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Prince Yulang took the Metropolitan Garrison.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，都察院上互選規則。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Censorate submitted mutual-election rules.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Censorate sent up mutual-election rules.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，學部上女學服色章程。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Board of Education submitted regulations on dress for women's schools.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Education sent up women's-school dress regulations.

sentences.zh: 予絕學專家已故候選同知直隸州知州華蘅芳，與其弟故直隸州州判世芳，及已故二品封職徐壽俱宣付史館。

translations.literal: The late candidate subprefect and Zhili department magistrate Hua Hengfang, a master of abstruse learning, was ordered entered in the histories, together with his late brother, former department assistant magistrate Shifang, and the late second-rank enfeoffed Xu Shou.
translations.idiomatic: Hua Hengfang, Shifang, and Xu Shou—masters of abstruse learning—were ordered entered in the histories.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，詔求直言。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jimao: an edict sought blunt counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jimao, the throne called for blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，增置奉天安圖、撫松二縣。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Antu and Fusong counties were added in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Fengtian gained Antu and Fusong counties.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賞遊學專門詹天佑等工科、文科、法科進士，工科、格致科舉人。

translations.literal: On day renwu, students who had studied abroad—Zhan Tianyou and others—were granted jinshi in engineering, letters, and law, and juren in engineering and natural science.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Zhan Tianyou and other returned students received engineering, letters, and law jinshi and science juren.

sentences.zh: 癸未，免山東青城等八十九州縣及衛所鹽場本年錢糧。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, this year's grain taxes were remitted for eighty-nine prefectures, departments, counties, and garrisons with salt fields in Qingcheng, Shandong, and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day grain tax was remitted for eighty-nine Shandong counties and salt-field districts.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，德宗景皇帝神牌升祔奉先殿。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the spirit tablet of the Jing Emperor Dezong was enshrined in the Hall of Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Emperor Dezong's tablet was enshrined in the Ancestral Hall.

sentences.zh: 賞一產三男河南柘城縣民婦張劉氏、通許縣民婦田厲氏米布。

translations.literal: A woman of Henan's Zhecheng county, née Zhang of the Liu household, who bore three sons in one pregnancy, and a woman of Tongxu county, née Tian of the Li household, were rewarded with grain and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Zhecheng's Zhang Liu and Tongxu's Tian Li—each bearing triplets—received grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 賑廣東佛山等十三廳縣災。

translations.literal: Disaster victims in thirteen departments and counties including Foshan, Guangdong, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen Guangdong departments and counties including Foshan received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，定太醫院院使為四品。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the superintendent of the Imperial Medical Academy was fixed at fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Medical Academy superintendent became fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 戊子，錄咸豐、同治年間戡定發、撚、回諸匪功臣後，敘官有差。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, descendants of meritorious officials who had suppressed the Miao, Nian, and Muslim rebels in the Xianfeng and Tongzhi reigns were entered on the register and given offices in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day descendants of Xianfeng-Tongzhi pacification merit received graded offices.

sentences.zh: 除琿春軍隊營房占用旗戶地畝租。

translations.literal: Rent on banner household land occupied by Hunchun garrison barracks was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Hunchun barracks' occupation rent on banner land was remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，趙爾豐奏四川德格土司多格生吉納土，改設流官，賞土舍都司世襲。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Zhao Erfeng memorialized that the Dege native chieftain in Sichuan, Duogeshengji, had submitted his territory; direct administration was established and the native-office hereditary company commander was rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Zhao Erfeng reported Sichuan Dege's Duogeshengji submitting territory for direct rule and rewarded the hereditary company commander.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，慶親王奕劻免管理陸軍貴胄學堂，以貝勒載潤代之。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Prince Qing Yikuang was relieved of managing the Army Nobles' Academy; Prince Zairun replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Yikuang left the Army Nobles' Academy and Zairun replaced him.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，增置熱河隆化縣。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Longhua county was added in Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Rehe gained Longhua county.

sentences.zh: 乙未，憲政編查館上禁煙條例，頒行之。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Constitutional Research Bureau submitted anti-opium regulations, which were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Constitutional Research Bureau's anti-opium rules were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 復故前湖南巡撫陳寶箴原官。

translations.literal: The late former Hunan governor Chen Baozhen was restored to his original office.
translations.idiomatic: Former Hunan governor Chen Baozhen was posthumously restored.

sentences.zh: 丙申，憲政編查館上禁買賣人口條款。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Constitutional Research Bureau submitted articles prohibiting the buying and selling of persons.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Constitutional Research Bureau sent up anti-trafficking articles.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，法部上法官懲戒章程。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Ministry of Justice submitted regulations on disciplining judges.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Justice sent up judge-discipline regulations.

sentences.zh: 己亥，憲政編查館上京師地方自治選舉章程。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Constitutional Research Bureau submitted regulations for local self-government elections in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the Constitutional Research Bureau sent up capital local-election rules.

sentences.zh: 庚子，升太醫院左右院判為五品。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the left and right vice-superintendents of the Imperial Medical Academy were raised to fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Medical Academy's vice-superintendents rose to fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，憲政編查館上府廳州縣地方自治章程，並府廳州縣議事會議員選舉章程。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Constitutional Research Bureau submitted regulations on local self-government in prefectures, departments, and counties, together with regulations on electing members of prefectural, departmental, and county councils.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Constitutional Research Bureau sent up local self-government and council-election rules.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，憲政編查館上法院編制法，並法官考試任用、司法區城分劃、及初級暨地方審判廳管轄案件各暫行章程。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Constitutional Research Bureau submitted a court organization law, together with provisional regulations on judicial examination and appointment, judicial district division, and cases under the jurisdiction of primary and local trial courts.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the Constitutional Research Bureau sent up court organization and provisional judicial rules.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年- 二年庚戌春正月丙午朔，不受朝賀。

translations.literal: Xuantong year 2, gengxu, spring, first month, new moon on day bingwu: court congratulations were not received.
translations.idiomatic: Xuantong 2, spring 1, bingwu new moon: levee congratulations were not held.

sentences.zh: 己酉，廣州新軍作亂，練軍討平之。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the new army at Guangzhou mutinied and was suppressed by the training troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Guangzhou's new army mutinied and training troops put it down.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔以人心浮動，黨會繁多，混入軍營，句引煽惑，命軍諮處、陸軍部、南北洋大臣新舊諸軍嚴密稽查，軍人尤重服從長官命令，如有聚眾開會演說，並嚴查禁。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, an edict said that because popular sentiment was unsettled and political associations numerous, with infiltration into the camps and incitement by agitators, the General Staff, the Army Ministry, and the northern and southern coastal ministers and all old and new armies were ordered to inspect strictly; soldiers were especially to obey superior officers' commands, and mass meetings and public speeches were also strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the throne, citing unrest and secret-society infiltration of the army, ordered strict inspection and banned soldiers' mass meetings and speeches.

sentences.zh: 移吉林大通縣駐松花江南岸，更名方正縣。

translations.literal: Datong county in Jilin was moved to the south bank of the Songhua and renamed Fangzheng county.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin's Datong was moved south of the Songhua and renamed Fangzheng.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，廣東革命黨王占魁等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Wang Zhankui and other Guangdong revolutionaries were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Guangdong revolutionaries including Wang Zhankui were executed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，達賴喇嘛患川兵至，出奔。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Dalai Lama, fearing Sichuan troops' arrival, fled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Dalai Lama fled, fearing Sichuan troops.

sentences.zh: 諭聯豫等仍遣員迎護回藏。

translations.literal: Lian Yu and others were instructed still to dispatch officials to escort him back to Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Yu was told still to send escorts to bring him back to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔奪阿旺羅布藏吐布丹甲錯濟寨汪曲卻勒朗結達賴喇嘛名號。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, an edict stripped the Dalai Lama Awang Luobuzang Tubandan Jiacuo Jizhai Wang Quque Le Langjie of his title.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Dalai Lama's title was stripped.

sentences.zh: 鹽政處上督辦鹽政試行章程。

translations.literal: The Salt Administration submitted trial regulations for the salt superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: The Salt Administration sent up trial salt-superintendent regulations.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，協辦大學士戴鴻慈卒，贈太子少保銜，賞銀治喪。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Associate Grand Secretary Dai Hongci died; he was posthumously given the rank of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and silver for the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Dai Hongci died and received posthumous Junior Guardian rank and funeral silver.

sentences.zh: 呂海寰等上中國紅十字會章程，命盛宣懷充會長。

translations.literal: Lu Haihuan and others submitted regulations for the Chinese Red Cross Society; Sheng Xuanhuai was made president.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Haihuan sent up Chinese Red Cross rules and Sheng Xuanhuai became president.

sentences.zh: 監察御史江春霖以論慶親王奕劻誤國，斥回原衙門。

translations.literal: Supervising censor Jiang Chunlin, for memorializing that Prince Qing Yikuang had harmed the state, was dismissed back to his original post.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Jiang Chunlin, who attacked Yikuang for harming the state, was sent back to his yamen.

sentences.zh: 命郵傳部尚書徐世昌協辦大學士，內閣學士吳郁生在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: Postal Minister Xu Shichang was made Associate Grand Secretary; Grand Secretariat academician Wu Yusheng was ordered to study under the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shichang became associate grand secretary and Wu Yusheng studied under the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 甲子，管理軍諮處貝勒戴濤請赴日本、美、英、法、德、義、奧、俄八國考察陸軍。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Prince Zaitao, who managed the General Staff, requested to inspect the armies of Japan, the United States, Britain, France, Germany, Italy, Austria, and Russia.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day General Staff Prince Zaitao asked to inspect armies in eight countries.

sentences.zh: 辛未，英國舉行萬國刑律改良會，法部奏遣檢察廳長徐謙往與會。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Britain held an international congress on penal reform; the Ministry of Justice memorialized sending Chief Procurator Xu Qian to attend.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Britain held a penal-reform congress and Justice sent Procurator Xu Qian.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔：「預備立憲，宜化除成見，悉泯異同。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, an edict: 「In preparing constitutional government, old prejudices should be dissolved and all differences erased.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the throne said: 「Preparing constitutional rule means dissolving prejudice and erasing difference.

sentences.zh: 自今滿、漢文武諸臣陳奏事件，一律稱臣，以昭畫一而示大同。

translations.literal: Henceforth all Manchu and Han civil and military officials presenting memorials shall uniformly style themselves chen, to show uniformity and embody great harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth all Manchu and Han officials shall address themselves uniformly as chen, for one standard and great harmony.

sentences.zh: 」 二月乙亥朔，聯豫請以新噶勒丹池巴羅布藏丹巴代理前藏事務。

translations.literal: 」Second month, first day of cycle yihai: Lian Yu requested that the new Kaletan Poolba Luobuzangdanba act as agent for former Tibet affairs.
translations.idiomatic: 」Month 2, yihai new moon: Lian Yu asked the new Kaletan Poolba Luobuzangdanba to act for former Tibet.

sentences.zh: 丙子，禁洋商湖南購運米石。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, foreign merchants were forbidden to purchase and transport rice from Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day foreign merchants were banned from buying Hunan rice.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，鐵良以疾免，以蔭昌為陸軍部尚書，梁敦彥為稅務處會辦大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Tie Liang was relieved for illness; Yin Chang was made Minister of the Army, and Liang Dunyi co-superintendent of the Tax Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Tie Liang left for illness; Yin Chang became army minister and Liang Dunyi tax co-superintendent.

sentences.zh: 免浙江仁和、海沙、鮑郎、蘆瀝四場暨江蘇橫浦、浦東二場荒蕪竈蕩宣統元年逋課。

translations.literal: Arrears from the first year of Xuantong for desolate salt pans at four fields in Zhejiang—Renhe, Haisha, Baolang, and Luli—and two fields in Jiangsu—Hengpu and Pudong—were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Xuantong 1 arrears for desolate Zhejiang and Jiangsu salt pans were remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬午，免陜西榆林等四州縣舊欠，榆林府倉糧米草束。

translations.literal: On day renwu, old arrears in four prefectures and counties including Yulin, Shaanxi, and grain, fodder, and straw in the Yulin prefectural granary were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Yulin and three other Shaanxi counties' arrears and granary dues were remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以內閣侍讀學士梁誠為出使德國大臣。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Grand Secretariat reader Liang Cheng was made envoy to Germany.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Liang Cheng became envoy to Germany.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，民政部上修正報律，下憲政編查館核奏。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Ministry of Civil Affairs submitted revised press regulations for review and memorial by the Constitutional Research Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Civil Affairs sent revised press law to the Constitutional Research Bureau.

sentences.zh: 己丑，復發帑銀三萬兩賑安徽災。

translations.literal: On day jichou, thirty thousand taels from the treasury were again issued to relieve disaster in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day another thirty thousand taels went to Anhui disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，免吉林五常廳、樺甸縣宣統元年逋賦。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Xuantong first-year arrears in Wuchang department and Huadian county, Jilin, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Jilin Wuchang and Huadian's Xuantong 1 tax arrears were remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲午，聯豫奏拉裏僧俗暨工布番兵投誠歸化。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Lian Yu memorialized that Lhasa monks and laity and Gongbo Tibetan troops had submitted and been naturalized.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Lian Yu reported Lhasa clergy and laity and Gongbo Tibetans submitting.

sentences.zh: 丙申，葛寶華卒，調榮慶為禮部尚書，以唐景崇為學部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Ge Baohua died; Rong Qing was transferred to Minister of Rites, and Tang Jingchong was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Ge Baohua died; Rong Qing became rites minister and Tang Jingchong education minister.

sentences.zh: 己亥，予故湖北提督夏毓秀優恤。

translations.literal: On day jihai, preferential posthumous treatment was granted to the late Hubei provincial commander Xia Yuxiu.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day late Hubei commander Xia Yuxiu received preferential posthumous treatment.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，憲政編查館上行政綱目。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Constitutional Research Bureau submitted an administrative outline.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the Constitutional Research Bureau sent up an administrative outline.

sentences.zh: 籌辦海軍大臣奏各司名目職掌。

translations.literal: The Superintendent of Naval Affairs memorialized on the titles and duties of each department.
translations.idiomatic: Naval affairs superintendent memorialized department titles and duties.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳朔，王士珍以疾免，命雷震春署江北提督。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day yisi: Wang Shizhen was relieved for illness; Lei Zhenchun was ordered to act as Jiangbei commander.
translations.idiomatic: Month 3, yisi new moon: Wang Shizhen left for illness and Lei Zhenchun acted as Jiangbei commander.

sentences.zh: 己酉，雲南威寧邪匪襲昭城，官軍剿滅之，匪首李老麽伏誅。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, heterodox bandits in Weining, Yunnan, raided Zhaocheng; government troops exterminated them and the bandit chief Li Laomo was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Yunnan Weining heterodox bandits raided Zhaocheng; troops killed them and chief Li Laomo was executed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，湖南民饑倡變，諭擒首要，散脅從。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, famine victims in Hunan stirred up trouble; an edict ordered the ringleaders seized and the coerced dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Hunan famine victims rioted; the throne ordered ringleaders seized and followers dispersed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，湖南巡撫岑春蓂罷，命楊文鼎暫代之。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Hunan governor Cen Chunmian was dismissed; Yang Wendian was ordered to act in his place.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Cen Chunmian left Hunan and Yang Wendian acted as governor.

sentences.zh: 遣楊士琦赴南洋充勸業會審查總長。

translations.literal: Yang Shiqi was dispatched to Nanyang as chief examiner of the industrial exposition.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shiqi went to Nanyang as chief industrial-exposition examiner.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，祈雨。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, rain was prayed for.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 庚申，雨。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day rain fell.

sentences.zh: 追復故海軍提督丁汝昌原官。

translations.literal: The late naval commander Ding Ruchang was posthumously restored to his original office.
translations.idiomatic: Late naval commander Ding Ruchang was posthumously restored.

sentences.zh: 廢秋審覆審舊制。

translations.literal: The old system of autumn review and reassessment was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn review and reassessment were abolished.

sentences.zh: 諭沿江各省督撫平糶。

translations.literal: Governors-general and governors along the Yangtze were instructed to sell grain at fair price.
translations.idiomatic: Yangtze governors-general were told to sell grain at fair price.

sentences.zh: 河南巡撫吳重熹免，以寶棻代之。

translations.literal: Henan governor Wu Chongxi was dismissed; Bao Fen replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chongxi left Henan and Bao Fen replaced him.

sentences.zh: 調程德全為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Cheng Dequan was transferred to Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Dequan became Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，予遺愛在民故太常寺卿袁昶安徽蕪湖縣建祠。

translations.literal: On day renxu, a shrine was ordered built at Wuhu county, Anhui, to the late Grand Master of Sacrifices Yuan Chong, whose kindness survived him.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day a Wuhu shrine was ordered for late Yuan Chong, beloved in death.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，裁奉天巡撫。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Fengtian governor was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Fengtian governorship was abolished.

sentences.zh: 授廣福伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Guangfu was made Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: Guangfu became Ili general.

sentences.zh: 甲子，革命黨人汪兆銘、黃復生、羅世勛謀以藥彈轟擊攝政王，事覺，捕下法部獄。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, revolutionaries Wang Mingji, Huang Fusheng, and Luo Shixun plotted to bomb the Prince Regent with explosives; the plot was discovered and they were arrested and imprisoned by the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Wang Mingji, Huang Fusheng, and Luo Shixun plotted to bomb the Prince Regent, were caught, and jailed by Justice.

sentences.zh: 庚午，旌殉夫烈婦山東曲阜孔令保妻潘氏，宣付史館。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Pan, wife of Kong Lingbao of Qufu, Shandong, who died following her husband, was honored and entered in the histories.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Kong Lingbao's widow Pan of Qufu, who died with her husband, was honored for the histories.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌朔，詔資政院於本年九月一日開院，欽選宗室王、公世爵、宗室、覺羅各部院官暨碩學通儒議員八十八人，前期召集。

translations.literal: Fourth month, new moon on day jiaxu: an edict fixed the Advisory Council to open on the first day of the ninth month of this year; eighty-eight members—imperially selected princes, dukes, hereditary nobles, imperial clansmen, officials of all boards, and eminent scholars—were to be summoned in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Month 4, jiaxu new moon: the Advisory Council would open ninth month 1; eighty-eight imperially chosen members were summoned early.

sentences.zh: 丙子，裁福建督糧道，增設巡警道、勸業道。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Fujian grain-intendant circuit was abolished and police and industrial promotion circuits were added.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Fujian lost its grain intendant and gained police and industrial circuits.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命載濤充專使大臣，往英國吊祭。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Prince Zaitao was made special envoy to Britain for mourning rites.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Prince Zaitao became special envoy to Britain for mourning.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賞遊學畢業生吳匡時等七人工科進士、法政科舉人有差。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, returned students including Wu Kuangshi were granted jinshi in engineering and juren in law in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day returned students including Wu Kuangshi received engineering jinshi and law juren.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，憲政編查館修訂法律大臣進現行刑律，命頒行之。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Constitutional Research Bureau's revising-law ministers presented the current penal code, which was ordered promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Constitutional Research Bureau's current penal code was ordered promulgated.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「此項刑律，為改用新律之預備。

translations.literal: An edict said: 「This penal code is preparatory to adopting a new code.
translations.idiomatic: The throne said: 「This code prepares adoption of new law.

sentences.zh: 內外問刑衙門，當悉心講求，依法聽斷。

translations.literal: Criminal offices at court and in the provinces should study it earnestly and judge cases according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Court and provincial criminal offices must study it and judge by law.

sentences.zh: 毋任意出入，致枉縱。

translations.literal: They must not act arbitrarily and thereby cause wrongful leniency or severity.
translations.idiomatic: They must not act arbitrarily and warp justice.

sentences.zh: 」癸未，詔：「各省增設巡警、勸業兩道，原期保衛治安，振興實業。

translations.literal: 」On day guiwei, an edict: 「In each province the police and industrial promotion circuits were added to guard public order and revive practical enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: 」On guiwei day the throne said: 「Provincial police and industrial circuits were meant to guard order and revive enterprise.

sentences.zh: 督撫於已補人員悉心考覈，如不能勝任，或於缺不宜，即奏明另補，毋回護瞻徇。

translations.literal: Governors-general and governors should carefully examine those already appointed; if they cannot perform or are unsuited to the post, they should memorialize for another appointment and must not show favor or deference.
translations.idiomatic: Governors must examine appointees; if unfit they must memorialize replacements without favor.

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，聯豫請西藏曲水、哈拉烏蘇、江達、山南、碩般多及三十九族地方各設委員一人，並停藏番造槍、造幣兩廠。

translations.literal: 」On day yiyou, Lian Yu requested one commissioner each at Qushui, Halawusu, Jiangda, Shannan, Shuobanduo, and the Thirty-nine Clans in Tibet, and that Tibetan gun and coin factories be shut.
translations.idiomatic: 」On yiyou day Lian Yu asked commissioners for six Tibetan districts and closure of Tibetan gun and coin factories.

sentences.zh: 前出使義大利大臣錢恂進和會條約譯詮。

translations.literal: Former envoy to Italy Qian Xun presented a translation and commentary on peace-treaty articles.
translations.idiomatic: Former Italy envoy Qian Xun presented translated peace-treaty articles.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以江北鹽梟、會匪出沒靡常，諭雷震春剿撫之。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, because salt smugglers and secret-society bandits in Jiangbei appeared and vanished unpredictably, Lei Zhenchun was instructed to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Jiangbei salt smugglers and secret societies were ordered suppressed by Lei Zhenchun.

sentences.zh: 己丑，度支部上幣制兌換則例。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Revenue Board submitted currency exchange regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Revenue sent up currency exchange rules.

sentences.zh: 詔：「國幣單位，定名曰圓。

translations.literal: An edict: 「The national currency unit is named yuan.
translations.idiomatic: The throne said: 「The national currency unit is called yuan.

sentences.zh: 暫就銀為本位，以一圓為主幣，重庫平七錢二分。

translations.literal: For the present silver is taken as the standard; one yuan is the main coin, weighing seven mace two candareens on the kuping scale.
translations.idiomatic: For now silver is standard; one main yuan weighs seven mace two candareens kuping.

sentences.zh: 另以五角、二角五分、一角三種銀幣，及五分鎳幣，二分、一分、五釐、一釐四種銅幣為輔幣。

translations.literal: Half-yuan, quarter-yuan, and one-dime silver subsidiary coins, and five-cent nickel and two-cent, one-cent, five-mil, and one-mil copper subsidiary coins, are added.
translations.idiomatic: Half-, quarter-, and one-dime silver and nickel and copper subsidiary coins were added.

sentences.zh: 圓、角、分、釐，各以十進，著為定制。

translations.literal: Yuan, dime, cent, and mil each advance by tens; this is fixed as the regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan, dime, cent, and mil advance by tens as fixed regulation.

sentences.zh: 」以聯芳為荊州將軍。

translations.literal: 」Lian Fang was made Jingzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: 」Lian Fang became Jingzhou general.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，定續選納稅多額十人為議員。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, it was fixed that ten persons paying the largest taxes in continued selection would be councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day ten top continued-tax payers were fixed as councilors.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命郵傳部侍郎汪大燮充出使日本大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Postal Vice Minister Wang Daxie was made envoy to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Wang Daxie became envoy to Japan.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，梁敦彥以疾免，以鄒嘉來署外務部尚書兼會辦大臣。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Liang Dunyi was relieved for illness; Zou Jialai was ordered to act as Minister of Foreign Affairs and co-superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Liang Dunyi left for illness and Zou Jialai acted as foreign minister and co-superintendent.

sentences.zh: 除湖北石首縣文義洲地方租課、蘆課。

translations.literal: Rent and reed tax on Wenyi Isle in Shishou county, Hubei, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Shishou's Wenyi Isle rent and reed tax were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙申，湖南巡撫岑春蓂褫職。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Hunan governor Cen Chunmian was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Cen Chunmian was stripped of the Hunan governorship.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，升四川寧遠阿拉所巡檢為鹽邊廳撫夷通判。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingchen: the Alasuo inspector at Ningyuan, Sichuan, was raised to salt-front department pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Month 5, bingchen: Sichuan Ningyuan's Alasuo inspector became salt-front pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊午，湖南常德府水潦災，發帑銀二萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, because Changde prefecture in Hunan suffered flood disaster, twenty thousand taels from the treasury were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day twenty thousand taels went to flood-stricken Changde, Hunan.

sentences.zh: 李經羲奏雲南永昌府屬鎮康土州改流官，增置永康州。

translations.literal: Li Jingxi memorialized that Zhenkang native prefecture under Yongchang, Yunnan, was converted to direct administration and Yongkang department was added.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingxi reported Yunnan Zhenkang native rule converted to direct administration and Yongkang added.

sentences.zh: 免雲南陸涼州被旱銀糧。

translations.literal: Silver and grain taxes for drought-stricken Luliang prefecture, Yunnan, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Luliang drought taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賑江北海州等處水災。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, flood victims in Haizhou and elsewhere in northern Jiangsu were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day northern Jiangsu flood victims including Haizhou were relieved.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，都察院代遞諮議局議員孫洪伊等並直省旗籍代表等呈請速開國會。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Censorate forwarded on behalf of advisory-council member Sun Hongyi and others and representatives of banner households from all provinces a petition requesting rapid convocation of a national parliament.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Censorate forwarded Sun Hongyi and provincial banner representatives' petition for a swift parliament.

sentences.zh: 詔仍俟九年籌備完全，再行降旨定期召集議員，宣諭之。

translations.literal: An edict still waited until the nine-year preparatory term was complete before fixing by edict the date for summoning members, which was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: The throne still waited for nine-year preparation before fixing parliament's date and proclaimed it.

sentences.zh: 甲子，免湖南苗疆佃民欠租，湖南鳳凰、乾州、永綏、保靖、瀘溪、麻陽、古丈坪七廳縣積欠屯租穀石。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, arrears in rent from Miao tenant farmers in Hunan were remitted, and accumulated garrison-rent grain in seven departments and counties—Fenghuang, Qianzhou, Yongshou, Baojing, Luxi, Mayang, and Guzhangping—was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Hunan Miao tenants' rent arrears and seven districts' garrison grain arrears were remitted.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賑湖北災。

translations.literal: On day jisi, disaster in Hubei was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Hubei disaster victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 辛未，裁奉天同江廳河防同知。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Tongjiang river-defense subprefect in Fengtian was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Fengtian's Tongjiang river-defense subprefect was abolished.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，黑龍江災，發帑銀二萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renwu: because Heilongjiang suffered disaster, twenty thousand taels from the treasury were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Month 6, renwu: twenty thousand taels went to Heilongjiang disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，汪大燮進考查英國憲政編輯各書。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Wang Daxie presented books he had examined on British constitutional compilation.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Wang Daxie presented books on British constitutional compilation.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命籌辦海軍事務大臣貝勒載洵充參預政務大臣。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Prince Zaixun, superintendent of naval affairs, was made a participant in government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day naval superintendent Prince Zaixun joined government affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命外務部侍郎胡惟德充稅務處幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Foreign Vice Minister Hu Weide was made co-superintendent of the Tax Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Hu Weide became tax co-superintendent.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔：「各省督撫勞於行政，亟於籌款，而恒疏於察吏。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, an edict: 「Provincial governors-general and governors labor at administration and urgently raise funds, yet constantly neglect inspecting officials.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the throne said: 「Governors labor at rule and fund-raising yet neglect inspecting officials.

sentences.zh: 不知吏治不修，則勞民傷財，亂端且從此起，新政何由而行？

translations.literal: They do not know that if official governance is not repaired, then exhausting the people and injuring wealth will cause disorder to arise from this, and how can the new policies be carried out?
translations.idiomatic: Without sound officials, exhausting the people breeds disorder and new policies cannot proceed.

sentences.zh: 其各慎選牧令，為地擇人，斯為綏靖地方至計。

translations.literal: Each should carefully select magistrates and choose men for the locality—this is the supreme plan for pacifying the regions.
translations.idiomatic: Each must pick honest magistrates and fit men to places—the supreme plan for peace.

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，詔各部院、各督撫嚴劾貪官汙吏，並諭貴戚及中外大臣敦品勵行，整躬率屬。

translations.literal: 」On day wuxu, an edict ordered every ministry and provincial governor-general and governor strictly to impeach corrupt officials, and also instructed nobles and Chinese and foreign ministers at court to cultivate character, encourage conduct, and rectify themselves and their subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: 」On wuxu day ministries and governors were ordered to impeach corrupt officials and nobles and ministers to rectify conduct.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命載澤、壽勛會阿穆爾靈圭、載潤查辦前鋒營暨內務府三旗護軍營，釐定章程以聞。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Zaize and Shou Xun were ordered with A Mu'erlinggui and Zairun to investigate the Vanguard Camp and the Three-Banner Guard of the Interior Ministry, draw up regulations, and report.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Zaize and Shou Xun with A Mu'erlinggui and Zairun were to fix Vanguard and Interior Guard rules.

sentences.zh: 是月，山東萊陽紳民相仇，匪首曲思文聚眾萬餘，圍攻城邑，劫殺官兵，海陽亦因徵收錢糧激變，旋並平定之。

translations.literal: That month, gentry and commoners feuded at Laizhou, Shandong; bandit chief Qu Siwen gathered more than ten thousand men, besieged cities, killed officials and soldiers, and Haiyang also rose over grain-tax collection; both were soon pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month Laizhou gentry feuded, Qu Siwen led ten thousand to besiege towns and kill troops, and Haiyang rose over taxes; both were pacified.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，裁福建督糧道，置勸業道。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jiachen: the Fujian grain-intendant circuit was abolished and an industrial promotion circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: Month 7, jiachen: Fujian lost its grain intendant and gained an industrial circuit.

sentences.zh: 瑞興免，以誌銳為杭州將軍。

translations.literal: Rui Xing was dismissed; Zhirui was made Hangzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Xing left and Zhirui became Hangzhou general.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，瑞澂、楊文鼎奏湘省匪勢蔓延，擬行清鄉法，從之。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Rui Cheng and Yang Wendian memorialized that bandit power was spreading in Hunan and proposed implementing the village-pacification method; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Rui Cheng and Yang Wendian proposed Hunan village pacification as bandits spread; approved.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔農工商部會同各督撫等調查礦產，熟籌開辦。

translations.literal: On day wushen, an edict ordered the Ministry of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce, together with governors-general and governors, to investigate mineral resources and plan opening them carefully.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce with governors were told to survey minerals and plan mines.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔趣各督撫查造官民荒田及氣候土宜圖冊，並興舉工藝實業，報農工商部奏聞。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, an edict urged governors-general to compile registers of official and private waste land and of climate and soil suitability, promote crafts and practical enterprise, and report to the Ministry of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce for memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day governors were urged to map waste land and climate, promote crafts, and report to Agriculture.

sentences.zh: 壬子，農工商部立度量權衡用器制造廠。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Ministry of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce established a factory for manufacturing weights and measures.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Agriculture opened a weights-and-measures factory.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，貝勒載濤奏考察各國軍政，軍人犯罪，統歸軍法會議處審斷，非普通裁判所得與聞。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Prince Zaitao memorialized on inspecting foreign military administration: soldiers' crimes were uniformly tried by military law councils and were not subject to ordinary courts.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Zaitao reported foreign armies try soldiers only in military courts, not civil ones.

sentences.zh: 諭照行之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered this carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered it carried out.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，世續、吳郁生免軍機大臣，以毓朗、徐世昌為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Shixu and Wu Yusheng were removed from the Grand Council; Yulang and Xu Shichang were made Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Shixu and Wu Yusheng left the Grand Council; Yulang and Xu Shichang joined it.

sentences.zh: 命唐紹儀署郵傳部尚書。

translations.literal: Tang Shaoyi was ordered to act as Postal Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Shaoyi acted as postal minister.

sentences.zh: 毓朗免步軍統領並專司訓練禁衛軍大臣。

translations.literal: Yulang was relieved of the Metropolitan Garrison and the post of minister solely in charge of training the Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Yulang left the Metropolitan Garrison and sole Imperial Guard training.

sentences.zh: 命烏珍兼署步軍統領。

translations.literal: Wu Zhen was ordered concurrently to act as commander of the Metropolitan Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhen concurrently acted as Metropolitan Garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 設各省交涉使。

translations.literal: Foreign-affairs commissioners were established in each province.
translations.idiomatic: Each province gained a foreign-affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 新疆陸軍營官田熙年以擅殺釀變伏誅。

translations.literal: Tian Xi, an officer of the Xinjiang land army camp, was executed for unauthorized killing that provoked mutiny.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang camp officer Tian Xi was executed for unauthorized killing that sparked mutiny.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，安徽皖南、南陵、宿州、靈壁等屬潦災，發帑銀四萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, because southern Wan, Nanling, Suzhou, and Lingbi in Anhui suffered flood disaster, forty thousand taels from the treasury were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day forty thousand taels went to flooded southern Anhui.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，法部上秋審條款。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Ministry of Justice submitted autumn-review articles.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Justice sent up autumn-review articles.

sentences.zh: 庚申，前江西提學使浙路總理湯壽潛，以劾盛宣懷為蘇浙路罪魁禍首，奪職。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, former Jiangxi education commissioner and Zhejiang railway superintendent Tang Shouqian was stripped of office for impeaching Sheng Xuanhuai as chief culprit of the Jiangsu-Zhejiang railway affair.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Tang Shouqian lost office for attacking Sheng Xuanhuai over the Jiangsu-Zhejiang railway.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賑皖北饑民。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, famine victims in northern Anhui were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day northern Anhui famine victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 以忠瑞為科布多辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Zhong Rui was made commissioner at Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Rui became Kobdo commissioner.

sentences.zh: 聯魁免新疆巡撫，以何彥升代之。

translations.literal: Lian Kui was dismissed as Xinjiang governor; He Yansheng replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Kui left Xinjiang and He Yansheng replaced him.

sentences.zh: 改各省按察使為提法使。

translations.literal: Provincial surveillance commissioners were changed to judicial commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial surveillance commissioners became judicial commissioners.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大學士鹿傳霖卒，贈太保，入祀賢良祠，賞銀治喪。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Grand Secretary Lu Chuanlin died; he was posthumously made Grand Tutor, entered the Shrine of Eminent Statesmen, and given silver for the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Lu Chuanlin died and received posthumous Grand Tutor rank, eminent-statesmen shrine, and funeral silver.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命外務部參議上行走沈瑞麟充出使奧國大臣，外務部右丞劉玉麟充和蘭萬國禁煙大會全權委員。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Foreign Ministry counsellor Shen Ruilin was made envoy to Austria, and Foreign Vice Minister Liu Yulin full commissioner to the Dutch international anti-opium congress.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Shen Ruilin became envoy to Austria and Liu Yulin commissioner to the Dutch anti-opium congress.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，奉天開葫蘆島港。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Huludao port in Fengtian was opened.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Fengtian's Huludao port opened.

sentences.zh: 己巳，置黑龍江訥河直隸廳同知。

translations.literal: On day jisi, a direct subprefect was established at Nehe, Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Heilongjiang gained a Nehe direct subprefect.

sentences.zh: 是月，載洵、薩鎮冰復往美利堅、日本兩國考察海軍。

translations.literal: That month, Zaixun and Sa Zhenbing again went to the United States and Japan to inspect the navy.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zaixun and Sa Zhenbing again inspected navies in America and Japan.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，置奉天鎮東縣。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: Zhendong county was established in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Month 8, jiaxu: Fengtian gained Zhendong county.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，清銳免，以鐵良為江寧將軍。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Qing Rui was dismissed; Tie Liang was made Jiangning general.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Qing Rui left and Tie Liang became Jiangning general.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命沈家本充資政院副總裁。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Shen Jiaben was made vice-president of the Advisory Council.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Shen Jiaben became Advisory Council vice-president.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以外務部右丞劉玉麟充出使英國大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Foreign Vice Minister Liu Yulin was made envoy to Britain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Liu Yulin became envoy to Britain.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，理藩部奏變通禁止出邊開墾地畝、民人聘娶蒙古婦女、內外蒙古不準延用內地書吏教讀、公牘不得擅用漢文，蒙古人不得用漢字命名等舊例，許之。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Court of Colonial Affairs memorialized relaxing old rules forbidding cultivation beyond the frontier, Han men marrying Mongol women, hiring inland clerks and teachers in Inner and Outer Mongolia, using Chinese in official documents, and Mongol use of Chinese characters in naming; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Colonial Affairs relaxed frontier-cultivation, marriage, clerk, document, and naming bans for Mongolia; approved.

sentences.zh: 增置四川昭覺縣。

translations.literal: Zhaojue county was added in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan gained Zhaojue county.

sentences.zh: 己丑，聯芳免，以鳳山為荊州將軍。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Lian Fang was dismissed; Feng Shan was made Jingzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Lian Fang left and Feng Shan became Jingzhou general.

sentences.zh: 命蔭昌兼訓練近畿各鎮大臣。

translations.literal: Yin Chang was ordered concurrently to train the metropolitan-area army divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Chang concurrently trained metropolitan-area divisions.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命近畿陸軍各鎮俱歸陸軍部管轄。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the metropolitan-area land army divisions were all placed under Army Ministry jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day metropolitan land divisions came under the Army Ministry.

sentences.zh: 裁近畿督練公所。

translations.literal: The metropolitan training office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The metropolitan training office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 增置奉天鹽運使。

translations.literal: A Fengtian salt transport commissioner was added.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian gained a salt transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 改四川鹽茶道為鹽運使，茶務歸勸業道管理。

translations.literal: The Sichuan salt-tea circuit was changed to salt transport commissioner, and tea affairs were placed under the industrial promotion circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan's salt-tea circuit became salt transport and tea went to the industrial circuit.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以奏報禁種煙苗粉飾，下吉林、黑龍江、河南、山西、福建、廣西、雲南、新疆諸省督撫部議，申諭各省嚴切查禁。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, because memorials on prohibiting opium cultivation were cosmetic, governors-general of Jilin, Heilongjiang, Henan, Shanxi, Fujian, Guangxi, Yunnan, and Xinjiang were ordered to deliberate in council and all provinces were again sternly forbidden to plant.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day eight provinces' cosmetic anti-opium reports drew council review and a renewed planting ban.

sentences.zh: 丙午，授徐世昌為體仁閣大學士，以吏部尚書李殿林協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Xu Shichang was made Grand Secretary of the Tiren Hall, and Minister of Personnel Li Dianlin Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Xu Shichang became Tiren grand secretary and Li Dianlin associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以廓爾喀額爾德尼王畢熱提畢畢噶爾瑪生寫熱曾噶扒噶都熱薩哈拒西藏求援兵，詔嘉獎之。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, because the Gorkha king Birendrabir Bikram Shah Dev had refused Tibet's request for troops, he was commended by edict.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Gorkha king was commended for refusing Tibet troops.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賑陜西華、渭南兩州縣潦災。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, flood victims in Hua and Weinan prefectures, Shaanxi, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Shaanxi Hua and Weinan flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑朔，資政院舉行開院禮，監國攝政王蒞會頒訓辭。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day xinchou: the Advisory Council held its opening ceremony; the Prince Regent attended and issued an admonitory address.
translations.idiomatic: Month 9, xinchou new moon: the Advisory Council opened; the Prince Regent attended and lectured.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賞遊學畢業生吳乃琛等四百五十九人文、醫、格致、農、工、商、法政進士、舉人有差。

translations.literal: On day renyin, four hundred fifty-nine returned students including Wu Naichen were granted jinshi and juren in letters, medicine, natural science, agriculture, engineering, commerce, and law in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day four hundred fifty-nine returned students received graded jinshi and juren.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，免甘肅河、金、渭源、伏羌、安定、會寧、寧靈、循化、秦九廳州縣上年被災地畝錢糧草束。

translations.literal: On day guimao, grain, fodder, and straw taxes on disaster-stricken land last year in nine departments and prefectures in Gansu—He, Jin, Weiyuan, Fuqiang, Anding, Huining, Ningling, Xunhua, and Qin—were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day nine Gansu districts' last-year disaster land taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙午，江北徐州等屬雨潦災，命度支部發帑賑之。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, because Xuzhou and other districts in northern Jiangsu suffered rain flood, the Revenue Board was ordered to issue treasury funds for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Revenue was told to fund northern Jiangsu rain-flood relief.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，署綏遠城將軍、督辦墾務大臣信勤以疾免，調堃岫代之。

translations.literal: On day yisi, acting Suiyuan garrison general and superintendent of reclamation Xin Qin was relieved for illness; Kun Xiu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day acting Suiyuan general Xin Qin left for illness and Kun Xiu replaced him.

sentences.zh: 以奎芳為烏裏雅蘇臺將軍。

translations.literal: Kui Fang was made Urga general.
translations.idiomatic: Kui Fang became Urga general.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命度支部再發帑銀二萬兩賑皖北災。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Revenue Board was again ordered to issue twenty thousand taels for northern Anhui disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Revenue issued another twenty thousand taels to northern Anhui.

sentences.zh: 壬子，張人駿以上海市情危急，請借洋款酌劑，並輸運庫帑銀五十萬兩，許之。

translations.literal: On day renzi, because the situation in Shanghai was critical, Zhang Renjun requested a foreign loan with discretion and transport of five hundred thousand taels from the treasury; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Zhang Renjun's Shanghai crisis loan and five hundred thousand taels transport were approved.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，永定河安瀾。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Yongding River ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the Yongding ran clear.

sentences.zh: 賑四川釂竹等廳縣水災。

translations.literal: Flood victims in Zizhu and other departments and counties in Sichuan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan flood victims in Zizhu and other districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，裁海龍圍場總管。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Hailong hunting-ground superintendent was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Hailong hunting-ground superintendent was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔直省舉賢良方正，從嚴甄取。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, an edict ordered all provinces to recommend men of eminent integrity and upright conduct, with strict selection.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day provinces were told to recommend eminent men under strict selection.

sentences.zh: 己未，予積貲興學山東堂邑義丐武訓事實宣付史館。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the facts in the case of Shandong Tangyi beggar Wu Xun, who amassed wealth to found schools, were ordered entered in the histories.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Wu Xun of Tangyi, who begged to fund schools, entered the histories.

sentences.zh: 裁湖南常德府同知、寶慶府長安營同知。

translations.literal: The Changde prefectural subprefect and the Chang'an garrison subprefect in Baoding prefecture, Hunan, were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan lost Changde's subprefect and Baoding's Chang'an garrison subprefect.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，諭綏遠城墾務緊要，沿邊道廳以下官，凡關墾務者，均聽墾務大臣節制。

translations.literal: On day guihai, an edict said Suiyuan reclamation was urgent; officials from frontier circuits and departments downward concerned with reclamation were all subject to the reclamation superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Suiyuan reclamation officials were placed under the reclamation superintendent.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，楊樞以疾免，命農工商部右丞李國傑充出使比國大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Yang Shu was relieved for illness; Agriculture Vice Minister Li Guojie was made envoy to Belgium.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Yang Shu left for illness and Li Guojie became envoy to Belgium.

sentences.zh: 賑黑龍江水災。

translations.literal: Heilongjiang flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Heilongjiang flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，袁樹勛以疾免，命張鳴岐署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Yuan Shuxun was relieved for illness; Zhang Mingqi was ordered to act as governor-general of the two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Yuan Shuxun left for illness and Zhang Mingqi acted as two-Guangs governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以沈秉堃為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Shen Bingkan was made Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Bingkan became Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，裁貴州副將、遊擊、都司、守備等官。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Guizhou brigade generals, colonels, lieutenant colonels, and majors were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Guizhou brigade through major posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 免新疆迪化等十一廳縣民欠錢糧、籽種。

translations.literal: Popular arrears in grain taxes and seed grain in eleven departments and counties including Dihua, Xinjiang, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven Xinjiang districts' popular tax and seed arrears were remitted.

sentences.zh: 十月癸酉，詔改於宣統五年開國會，以直省督撫多以為言，復據順天直隸各省諮議局人民代表請原速開國會，故有是命。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day guiyou: an edict changed opening of the national parliament to the fifth year of Xuantong; because governors-general of all provinces had often spoken on it, and in accordance with the petition of people's representatives from the Shuntian and Zhili advisory councils requesting the original rapid opening, this order was issued.
translations.idiomatic: Month 10, guiyou: parliament was moved to Xuantong 5 after governors and Zhili representatives pressed for earlier opening.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命溥倫、載澤充纂擬憲法大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Pulun and Zaize were made ministers drafting the constitution.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Pulun and Zaize drafted the constitution.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，黃河安瀾。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Yellow River ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the Yellow River ran clear.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，廣西岑溪匪亂，官軍剿定之，匪首陳榮安伏誅。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, bandit disorder at Cenxi, Guangxi, was suppressed by government troops; bandit chief Chen Rong'an was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Guangxi Cenxi bandits were suppressed and chief Chen Rong'an executed.

sentences.zh: 程文炳卒，以程允和為長江水師提督，命甘肅提督張勛接統江南浦口各營。

translations.literal: Cheng Wenbing died; Cheng Yunhe was made Yangtze naval commander, and Gansu provincial commander Zhang Xun was ordered to take over all camps at Pukou south of the Yangtze in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Wenbing died; Cheng Yunhe became Yangtze naval commander and Zhang Xun took Jiangnan Pukou camps.

sentences.zh: 免甘肅靈州水災銀米。

translations.literal: Silver and grain for Lingzhou flood disaster in Gansu were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu Lingzhou flood silver and grain were remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，增韞奏浙江裁綠營改編水師。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Zeng Yun memorialized that Zhejiang's Green Standard was abolished and reorganized as a naval force.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Zeng Yun reported Zhejiang's Green Standard abolished and reorganized as navy.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔以縮改宣統五年開設議院，責成各主管衙門切實籌備，民政、度支、法、學諸部俱有應負責任，提前通盤籌畫，分別最要、次要，詳細以聞。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, an edict said that because opening parliament in the fifth year of Xuantong had been shortened, each supervising office was charged earnestly to prepare; the ministries of civil affairs, revenue, justice, and education all bore responsibility and were to plan comprehensively in advance, distinguishing essentials from secondary matters, and report in detail.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the throne, having moved parliament to Xuantong 5, charged ministries to plan essentials and secondaries in detail.

sentences.zh: 並誡勉直省督撫淬厲精神，切實遵行，毋再因循推諉，致誤限期。

translations.literal: It also admonished provincial governors-general to steel their spirits, carry this out in earnest, and not again procrastinate and shirk duty, thereby missing the deadline.
translations.idiomatic: Governors were admonished to act earnestly and not miss the deadline.

sentences.zh: 壬午，何彥升卒，以袁大化為新疆巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renwu, He Yansheng died; Yuan Dahua was made Xinjiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day He Yansheng died and Yuan Dahua became Xinjiang governor.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，予故大學士、前署兩廣總督張之洞於江寧省城建祠。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, a shrine was granted to the late Grand Secretary and former acting governor-general of the two Guangs Zhang Zhidong in Jiangning province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day late Zhang Zhidong received a Jiangning shrine.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，罷陸軍尚書、侍郎及左右丞、參議，改設陸軍大臣、副大臣各一人。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guimao: the army minister, vice minister, and left and right directors and counsellors were abolished; one army minister and one vice minister were established.
translations.idiomatic: Month 11, guimao: army minister, vice minister, directors, and counsellors were abolished for one minister and one vice minister.

sentences.zh: 置海軍部，設海軍大臣、副大臣各一人。

translations.literal: A Navy Ministry was established, with one navy minister and one vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: A Navy Ministry was created with one minister and one vice minister.

sentences.zh: 以蔭昌為陸軍大臣，壽勛副之。

translations.literal: Yin Chang was made army minister and Shou Xun vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Chang became army minister and Shou Xun vice minister.

sentences.zh: 貝勒載洵為海軍大臣，譚學衡副之。

translations.literal: Prince Zaixun was navy minister and Tan Xueheng vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zaixun became navy minister and Tan Xueheng vice minister.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命海軍提督薩鎮冰統巡洋長江艦隊。

translations.literal: On day yisi, naval commander Sa Zhenbing was ordered to command the cruiser and Yangtze fleets.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Sa Zhenbing took the cruiser and Yangtze fleets.

sentences.zh: 丙午，雲南大姚縣民亂，入城劫獄殺人，官軍剿定之，匪首陳文培、鄧良臣俱伏誅。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, commoners at Dayao county, Yunnan, rioted, entered the city, raided the prison, and killed people; government troops suppressed them and bandit chiefs Chen Wenpei and Deng Liangchen were both executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Dayao, Yunnan, rioters raided the prison; troops suppressed them and chiefs Chen Wenpei and Deng Liangchen were executed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命前安徽巡撫馮煦為江、皖籌賑大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, former Anhui governor Feng Xu was made relief commissioner for Jiangsu and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day former Anhui governor Feng Xu became Jiangsu-Anhui relief commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬子，農工商部進編輯棉花圖說。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Ministry of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce presented an edited illustrated treatise on cotton.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Agriculture presented an edited cotton treatise.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，資政院言軍機大臣責任不明，難資輔弼，請設立責任內閣。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Advisory Council said Grand Councilors' responsibilities were unclear and they could not assist effectively, and requested establishment of a responsible cabinet.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Advisory Council asked for a responsible cabinet, citing unclear Grand Council duties.

sentences.zh: 詔以朝廷自有權衡，非院臣所得擅預，斥之。

translations.literal: An edict said the court had its own balance and this was not for council members to presume upon; they were rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: The throne said the court held its own balance, rebuked the council for overstepping.

sentences.zh: 雷震春罷，命段祺瑞署江北提督。

translations.literal: Lei Zhenchun was dismissed; Duan Qirui was ordered to act as Jiangbei commander.
translations.idiomatic: Lei Zhenchun left and Duan Qirui acted as Jiangbei commander.

sentences.zh: 庚申，陳夔龍奏順直諮議局呈請明年即開國會，諭提前豫備事宜已慮不及，豈能再議更張。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Chen Kuilong memorialized that the Shuntian advisory council petitioned to open parliament the next year; an edict said advance preparation was already barely manageable and how could reopening be discussed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Chen Kuilong reported Shuntian's next-year parliament petition; the throne said preparation already strained further change.

sentences.zh: 命剴切宣示，不準再行要求瀆奏。

translations.literal: They were ordered sternly proclaimed and forbidden again to demand or memorialize impertinently.
translations.idiomatic: They were sternly told not to demand or memorialize again.

sentences.zh: 加賞普濟教養局倉米六十石，月以為常。

translations.literal: Sixty additional shi of granary rice for the Universal Relief and Nurture Bureau were granted monthly as a permanent allotment.
translations.idiomatic: The Universal Relief Bureau gained sixty shi monthly in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，置各省高等審判、檢察廳，設丞、長，湖南緩設。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, high trial and procuratorate offices were established in each province, with directors and chiefs; Hunan's establishment was deferred.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day provincial high courts and procuratorates were set; Hunan's was deferred.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，東三省國會請原代表來京，呈請明年即開國會。

translations.literal: On day guihai, representatives of the three eastern provinces who had petitioned for parliament came to the capital and petitioned to open parliament the next year.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day three eastern provinces' parliament petitioners came to the capital.

sentences.zh: 軍機大臣以聞。

translations.literal: The Grand Council reported.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Council reported.

sentences.zh: 詔民政部、步軍統領衙門勒歸籍，勿逗留，再有來京及各省聚眾者察治之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Ministry of Civil Affairs and the Metropolitan Garrison to compel them to return to native place and not linger; if others came to the capital or provinces gathered in crowds, they were to be investigated and punished.
translations.idiomatic: Civil Affairs and the Metropolitan Garrison were told to send petitioners home and punish further gatherings.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔趣憲政編查館擬訂籌備清單，內閣官制並纂擬具奏。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, an edict urged the Constitutional Research Bureau to draft the preparatory checklist, and also to compile and memorialize the cabinet organization.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Constitutional Research Bureau was urged to draft the preparatory checklist and cabinet organization.

sentences.zh: 予故大學士張之洞於湖北省城建祠。

translations.literal: A shrine was granted to the late Grand Secretary Zhang Zhidong in Hubei province.
translations.idiomatic: Late Zhang Zhidong received a Hubei shrine.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，慶親王奕劻請免軍機大臣及總理外務部，優詔慰留之。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Prince Qing Yikuang requested relief from Grand Councilor and concurrent Minister of Foreign Affairs; a gracious edict urged him to remain.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Yikuang asked to leave the Grand Council and Foreign Ministry; the throne urged him to stay.

sentences.zh: 己巳，資政院請明諭剪發易服。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Advisory Council requested a clear edict on cutting queues and changing dress.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the Advisory Council asked for an edict on queue-cutting and dress reform.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，諭各省曉諭學堂，禁學生幹豫政治，聚眾要求，違者重治。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renshen: an edict instructed each province to admonish schools that students must not interfere in politics or gather to make demands; violators would be severely punished.
translations.idiomatic: Month 12, renshen: provinces were told to forbid students' political interference and mass demands.

sentences.zh: 丙子，唐紹儀以疾免，以盛宣懷為郵傳部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Tang Shaoyi was relieved for illness; Sheng Xuanhuai was made Postal Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Tang Shaoyi left for illness and Sheng Xuanhuai became postal minister.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，察哈爾右翼四旗蒙古災，發帑銀一萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, because the four right-wing banners of Chakhar Mongolia suffered disaster, ten thousand taels from the treasury were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day ten thousand taels went to Chakhar's four right-wing banners.

sentences.zh: 己卯，誌銳請變通銷除旗檔舊制。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Zhirui requested flexible abolition of the old banner-register system.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Zhirui asked to abolish the old banner register flexibly.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，召增祺入覲，命孚琦署廣州將軍。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Zeng Qi was summoned to audience; Fu Qi was ordered to act as Guangzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Zeng Qi was summoned and Fu Qi acted as Guangzhou general.

sentences.zh: 壬午，召趙爾巽入覲。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Zhao Erfen was summoned to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Zhao Erfen was summoned.

sentences.zh: 癸未，重申煙禁，地方官仍前粉飾者罪之，並命民政、度支二部考核。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the opium ban was reaffirmed; local officials who continued cosmetic enforcement were punishable, and the ministries of civil affairs and revenue were ordered to assess them.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the opium ban was reaffirmed and Civil Affairs and Revenue were to assess officials.

sentences.zh: 命各省總督會同憲政編查館王大臣參訂外省官制。

translations.literal: Each provincial governor-general was ordered, together with the Constitutional Research Bureau princes, to revise provincial official organization.
translations.idiomatic: Governors-general with Constitutional Research princes were to revise provincial organization.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，裁並江蘇州縣，設審判廳。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Suzhou and Kunshan counties in Jiangsu were merged and abolished, and trial offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Jiangsu merged counties and set trial offices.

sentences.zh: 江寧以江寧並入上元，蘇州以長洲、元和並入吳，江都並入甘泉，昭文並入常熟，新陽並入昆山，震澤並入吳江，婁並入華亭，陽湖並入武進，金匱並入無錫，荊溪並入宜興。

translations.literal: In Jiangning, Jiangning was merged into Shangyuan; in Suzhou, Changzhou and Yuanhe were merged into Wu; Jiangdu into Ganquan; Zhaowen into Changshu; Xinyang into Kunshan; Zhenze into Wujiang; Lou into Huating; Yanghu into Wujin; Jinqui into Wuxi; Jingxi into Yixing.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangning merged into Shangyuan, Suzhou's paired counties into Wu, and eight other Jiangsu county pairs were merged likewise.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，憲政編查館上遵擬修正逐年籌備事宜清單。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Constitutional Research Bureau submitted a revised checklist of annual preparatory matters.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Constitutional Research Bureau sent a revised annual preparatory checklist.

sentences.zh: 裁吉林水師營官丁。

translations.literal: Jilin naval camp clerks and soldiers were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin naval camp clerks and soldiers were abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊子，四川匪踞黔江縣為亂，官軍擊卻之，復其城。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Sichuan bandits seized Qianjiang county as a base; government troops drove them off and recovered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Sichuan bandits held Qianjiang; troops drove them off and recovered the city.

sentences.zh: 己丑，考察憲政大臣李家駒進日本租稅制度考、會計制度考。

translations.literal: On day jichou, constitutional investigation commissioner Li Jiaju presented studies on Japanese tax and accounting systems.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Li Jiaju presented Japanese tax and accounting studies.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，四川匪首溫朝鍾竄入湖北咸豐縣境，擒斬之。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Sichuan bandit chief Wen Chaozhong slipped into Xianfeng county, Hubei, and was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Sichuan chief Wen Chaozhong was captured in Hubei Xianfeng and executed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命貝子銜鎮國將軍載振充頭等專使大臣，賀英君加冕。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Prince-rank Bordered Baron Zaizhen was made chief special envoy to congratulate the British king's coronation.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Zaizhen became chief envoy to the British coronation.

sentences.zh: 資政院議決新刑律總則、分則，詔頒布之。

translations.literal: The Advisory Council resolved the general and particular provisions of the new penal code, which was ordered promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: The Advisory Council's new penal code general and particular provisions were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 丙申，免陜西咸寧等六十四府廳州縣光緒三十三年逋賦，並廣有倉錢糧草束。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, arrears from the thirty-third year of Guangxu in sixty-four prefectures, departments, and counties including Xianning, Shaanxi, and grain, fodder, and straw in the Guangyou granary were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day sixty-four Shaanxi districts' Guangxu 33 arrears and Guangyou granary dues were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，資政院上議決統一國庫章程。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Advisory Council submitted a resolved charter unifying the national treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Advisory Council sent a unified national-treasury charter.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，資政院奏議決宣統三年歲出歲入總豫算。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the Advisory Council memorialized the resolved general budget of revenue and expenditure for the third year of Xuantong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Advisory Council memorialized Xuantong 3's resolved budget.

sentences.zh: 廷傑卒，以紹昌為法部尚書。

translations.literal: Ting Jie died; Shaochang was made Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Ting Jie died and Shaochang became justice minister.

sentences.zh: 己亥，裁甘肅蘭州道，置勸業道。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Lanzhou circuit in Gansu was abolished and an industrial promotion circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Gansu lost its Lanzhou circuit and gained an industrial circuit.

sentences.zh: 是月，江、淮饑，人相食。

translations.literal: That month, on the Jianghuai plain there was famine and people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jianghuai famine drove people to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 東三省疫。

translations.literal: Plague struck the three eastern provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Plague struck the three eastern provinces.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年- 三年辛亥春正月庚子朔，以山海關外防疫，天寒道阻，諭陳夔龍、錫良安置各省工作人。

translations.literal: Xuantong year 3, xinhai, spring, first month, new moon on day gengzi: because of epidemic prevention beyond Shanhaiguan, cold weather, and blocked roads, Chen Kuilong and Xi Liang were instructed to settle workers from each province.
translations.idiomatic: Xuantong 3, spring 1, gengzi new moon: Chen Kuilong and Xi Liang were told to settle provincial workers beyond Shanhaiguan for epidemic prevention.

sentences.zh: 丙午，馮煦奏察勘徐、淮災狀。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Feng Xu memorialized on inspecting disaster conditions in Xuzhou and the Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Feng Xu reported inspecting Xuzhou-Huai disaster.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免江蘇長洲等四十廳州縣田地銀糧。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, field and land taxes in forty departments and counties including Changzhou, Jiangsu, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day forty Jiangsu districts' field taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賑江蘇高郵、寶應、清河、安東、山陽、阜寧等縣水災。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, flood victims in Gaoyou, Baoying, Qinghe, Andong, Shanyang, and Funing counties, Jiangsu, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day six Jiangsu counties' flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，度支部上全國豫算章程。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Revenue Board submitted regulations for the national budget.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Revenue sent up national budget regulations.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，釋服。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, mourning garments were laid aside.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day mourning garments were laid aside.

sentences.zh: 御史胡思敬劾憲政編查館，言新官不可濫設，舊官不可盡裁；

translations.literal: Censor Hu Sijing impeached the Constitutional Research Bureau, saying new offices must not be created recklessly and old offices must not all be abolished;
translations.idiomatic: Censor Hu Sijing attacked the Constitutional Research Bureau for reckless new offices and abolishing all old ones;

sentences.zh: 起草應用正人，頒行當采眾議。

translations.literal: drafting should employ upright men, and promulgation should adopt public discussion.
translations.idiomatic: drafting needs upright men and promulgation needs public discussion.

sentences.zh: 下其章於政務處。

translations.literal: his memorial was sent to the Government Affairs Office.
translations.idiomatic: his memorial went to the Government Affairs Office.

sentences.zh: 庚申，調誌銳為伊犁將軍，廣福為杭州將軍。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Zhirui was transferred to Ili general and Guangfu to Hangzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Zhirui became Ili general and Guangfu Hangzhou general.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，除非刑。

translations.literal: On day yichou, corporal punishment excepting the death penalty was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day corporal punishment short of death was abolished.

sentences.zh: 凡遣、流以下罪，毋用刑訊。

translations.literal: For crimes of exile and below, torture must not be used.
translations.idiomatic: Exile and lesser crimes could not be tortured.

sentences.zh: 法部奏上已革綏遠城將軍貽穀罪論死。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Justice memorialized that the dismissed former Suiyuan garrison general Yi Gu was sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Justice memorialized dismissed Suiyuan general Yi Gu condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 詔改戍新疆效力贖罪。

translations.literal: An edict changed this to banishment to Xinjiang to redeem guilt through service.
translations.idiomatic: The throne changed it to Xinjiang banishment for redeeming guilt.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命周樹模會勘中俄邊界。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Zhou Shumo was ordered to survey the Sino-Russian boundary.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Zhou Shumo surveyed the Sino-Russian boundary.

sentences.zh: 是月，直隸、山東民疫。

translations.literal: That month, plague struck commoners in Zhili and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That month plague struck Zhili and Shandong commoners.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午朔，予故大學士、前湖南巡撫王文韶於湖南省城建祠。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day gengwu: a shrine was granted to the late Grand Secretary and former Hunan governor Wang Wenshao in Hunan province.
translations.idiomatic: Month 2, gengwu new moon: late Wang Wenshao received a Hunan shrine.

sentences.zh: 馮煦請濬睢河。

translations.literal: Feng Xu requested dredging the Sui River.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Xu asked to dredge the Sui River.

sentences.zh: 民政部上編訂戶籍法。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Civil Affairs submitted a compiled household-registration law.
translations.idiomatic: Civil Affairs sent up a compiled household-registration law.

sentences.zh: 壬申，諭所司防疫，毋藉端騷擾，並命民政部、步軍統領衙門、順天府以保衛民生之意諭人民。

translations.literal: On day renshen, an edict ordered offices in charge of epidemic prevention not to use it as a pretext for harassment, and also ordered the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the Metropolitan Garrison, and Shuntian prefecture to instruct the people in the spirit of protecting livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day epidemic offices were forbidden harassment and told to protect livelihood.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，四川德格、春科、高日三土司改設流官，置邊北道，登科府，德化、白玉二州，石渠、同普二縣。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the three native chieftaincies of Dege, Chunke, and Gaori in Sichuan were converted to direct administration; a northern border circuit, Dengke prefecture, Dehua and Baiyu departments, and Shiqu and Tongpu counties were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Sichuan's Dege, Chunke, and Gaori chieftains became direct rule with new circuit, prefecture, departments, and counties.

sentences.zh: 定應遣新疆軍臺人犯改發巴、藏。

translations.literal: It was fixed that offenders to be sent to Xinjiang courier stations would instead be sent to Ba and Zang.
translations.idiomatic: Xinjiang courier-station convicts were instead sent to Ba and Zang.

sentences.zh: 丙子，免雲南昆明等三州縣被災田地條糧銀米。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, itemized grain and silver taxes on disaster-stricken land in three prefectures and counties including Kunming, Yunnan, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day three Yunnan districts' disaster land taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，免浙江仁和等三十州縣，杭、嚴二衛，衢、嚴二所荒地錢糧漕米。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, grain taxes and tribute rice on waste land in thirty counties including Renhe, Zhejiang, and the Hang and Yan garrisons and Qu and Yan stations were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day thirty Zhejiang waste-land taxes and garrison tribute were remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，改陸軍部、海軍部大臣、副大臣為正都統、副都統，仍以蔭昌、壽勛、載洵、譚學衡為之。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, army and navy ministers and vice ministers were changed to chief and deputy commanders-in-chief; Yin Chang, Shou Xun, Zaixun, and Tan Xueheng remained in post.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day army and navy ministers became chief and deputy commanders; Yin Chang, Shou Xun, Zaixun, and Tan Xueheng stayed.

sentences.zh: 英人占片馬。

translations.literal: The British occupied Pianma.
translations.idiomatic: Britain occupied Pianma.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命李家駒撰擬講義輪班進呈。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Li Jiaju was ordered to draft lectures and present them in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Li Jiaju was ordered to draft rotating lectures.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，裁駐藏幫辦大臣，設左右參贊。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the assistant resident in Tibet was abolished and left and right councillors were established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Tibet's assistant resident was abolished for left and right councillors.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，頒浙江惠興女學堂「貞心毅力」扁額。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, a plaque reading 「Steadfast Heart and Stalwart Resolve」 was issued to Zhejiang's Huixing Girls' School.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Zhejiang's Huixing Girls' School received a 「Steadfast Heart and Stalwart Resolve」 plaque.

sentences.zh: 己丑，外務部上勛章贈賞章程。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs submitted regulations on conferring orders and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Foreign Affairs sent up order-and-reward regulations.

sentences.zh: 命度支部右侍郎陳邦瑞、學部右侍郎李家駒、民政部左參議汪榮寶協纂憲法。

translations.literal: Revenue Vice Minister Chen Bangrui, Education Vice Minister Li Jiaju, and Civil Affairs Left Counsellor Wang Rongbao were ordered to assist in compiling the constitution.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Bangrui, Li Jiaju, and Wang Rongbao were ordered to assist compiling the constitution.

sentences.zh: 以誠勛為廣州將軍，溥颋為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Cheng Xun was made Guangzhou general and Pu Huang Rehe governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Xun became Guangzhou general and Pu Huang Rehe governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以貝子溥倫為農工商部尚書，世續為資政院總裁，李家駒副之，劉若曾為修訂法律大臣。

translations.literal: Prince Pulun was made Minister of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce; Shixu was made Advisory Council president and Li Jiaju vice-president; Liu Ruoceng was made revising-law minister.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Pulun headed Agriculture; Shixu chaired the Advisory Council with Li Jiaju vice-chair; Liu Ruoceng revised law.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，禁洋商運鹽入口。

translations.literal: On day renchen, foreign merchants were forbidden to import salt.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day foreign salt import was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 改設英屬檳榔嶼正領事官。

translations.literal: The consul at British Penang was changed to chief consul.
translations.idiomatic: British Penang's consul became chief consul.
