sentences.zh: 三月庚子，以劉銳恒為雲南提督。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi: Liu Ruiheng was made Yunnan provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: Month 3, gengzi: Liu Ruiheng became Yunnan commander.

sentences.zh: 裁稽察守衛處，置管理前鋒、護軍等營事務處，三旗護軍仍隸內務府。

translations.literal: The inspection and guard office was abolished and an office managing Vanguard, Guard, and other camps was established; the Three-Banner Guard still came under the Interior Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: The inspection office was abolished for a camp-management office; Three-Banner Guard stayed under Interior.

sentences.zh: 陸軍部奏，東三省測量局員焦滇賄賣秘密地圖，誅之。

translations.literal: The Army Ministry memorialized that Jiao Dian of the three eastern provinces survey bureau had bribed to sell secret maps and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: The Army Ministry reported Jiao Dian executed for selling secret survey maps.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，裁奉天承德、錦二縣。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Chengde and Jin counties in Fengtian were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Fengtian abolished Chengde and Jin counties.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，裁四川川北、重慶二鎮總兵官。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the two regional commanders at northern Sichuan and Chongqing were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Sichuan's northern and Chongqing regional commanders were abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，頒盡忠節、守禮節、尚武勇、崇信義、敦樸素、重廉恥六條訓諭軍人。

translations.literal: On day guimao, six injunctions were promulgated for soldiers—utmost loyalty, observance of ritual, valor in war, esteem for faith, plain living, and regard for shame.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day six soldier injunctions—loyalty, ritual, valor, faith, plain living, shame—were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 丁未，賞陸軍各鎮、協統制、統領等官何宗蓮、李奎元等陸軍副都統銜、協都統有差。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, army division, brigade, and regimental commanders including He Zonglian and Li Kuiyuan were granted deputy commander-in-chief and deputy brigade ranks in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day He Zonglian, Li Kuiyuan, and other commanders received graded deputy ranks.

sentences.zh: 戊申，吉林濬圖們江航路通於海。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Jilin dredged the Tumen River route to reach the sea.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Jilin opened the Tumen River to the sea.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命出使義國大臣吳宗濂充專使，賀義大利立國慶典。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, envoy to Italy Wu Zonglian was made special envoy to congratulate Italy's national founding.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Italy envoy Wu Zonglian became special envoy to Italy's founding celebration.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，革命黨人以藥彈擊殺署廣州將軍孚琦。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, revolutionaries killed acting Guangzhou general Fu Qi with explosives.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day revolutionaries bombed acting Guangzhou general Fu Qi to death.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以薩鎮冰為海軍副都統。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Sa Zhenbing was made deputy commander-in-chief of the navy.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Sa Zhenbing became navy deputy commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 趙爾豐奏平三巖野番，改孔撒、麻書兩土司，設流官。

translations.literal: Zhao Erfeng memorialized pacifying the Sanyan wild tribes, converting the Kongsa and Mashu native chieftaincies, and establishing direct administration.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Erfeng reported pacifying Sanyan tribes and converting Kongsa and Mashu to direct rule.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，授張鳴岐兩廣總督。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Zhang Mingqi was appointed governor-general of the two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Zhang Mingqi became two-Guangs governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，度支部尚書載澤與英美德法四國銀行締結借款契約。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Revenue Minister Zaize concluded a loan contract with banks of Britain, the United States, Germany, and France.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Zaize concluded a loan with British, American, German, and French banks.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，賞伊犁將軍誌銳尚書銜，伊犁地方文武各官受節制。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Ili General Zhirui was granted ministerial rank; all civil and military officials in Ili were placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Ili General Zhirui received ministerial rank and command over Ili officials.

sentences.zh: 免浙江仁和等三十七州縣並衛所田塘宣統二年銀糧。

translations.literal: Field and pond taxes for the second year of Xuantong in thirty-seven counties and garrisons including Renhe, Zhejiang, were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-seven Zhejiang districts' Xuantong 2 field taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以江、皖、豫災，命馮煦會三省督撫籌春賑。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, because of disaster in Jiangsu, Anhui, and Henan, Feng Xu was ordered to join the three provinces' governors-general in planning spring relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Feng Xu joined three provinces' governors in spring relief for Jiangsu, Anhui, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 己未，和蘭開禁煙會於海牙，命出使德國大臣梁誠往與會。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Dutch opened an anti-opium congress at The Hague; envoy to Germany Liang Cheng was ordered to attend.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Liang Cheng went to the Hague Dutch anti-opium congress.

sentences.zh: 賑科布多劄哈沁蒙古遊牧災。

translations.literal: Disaster among the nomadic Mongols of Zakhachin in Kobdo was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Kobdo Zakhachin nomads received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 庚申，錫良以疾免，調趙爾巽為東三省總督，授欽差大臣，兼管三省將軍事。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Xi Liang was relieved for illness; Zhao Erfen was transferred to governor-general of the three eastern provinces, made imperial commissioner, and also placed in charge of the three provinces' generals' affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Xi Liang left for illness; Zhao Erfen became three-eastern-province governor-general and imperial commissioner over generals.

sentences.zh: 加直隸熱河道提法使銜。

translations.literal: The Rehe circuit judicial commissioner in Zhili received an additional title.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili's Rehe judicial commissioner gained an additional title.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命趙爾豐署四川總督，王人文為川滇邊務大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Zhao Erfeng was ordered to act as Sichuan governor and Wang Renwen was made commissioner for Sichuan-Yunnan border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Zhao Erfeng acted as Sichuan governor and Wang Renwen took border affairs.

sentences.zh: 予哀毀殉親前浙江巡撫聶緝椝孝行宣付使館。

translations.literal: The filial conduct of the late former Zhejiang governor Nie Jigui, who died of grief for his parent, was ordered entered in the histories.
translations.idiomatic: Late Zhejiang governor Nie Jigui, who died mourning a parent, entered the histories.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，漢儒趙岐、元儒劉因俱從祀文廟。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Han scholar Zhao Qi and Yuan scholar Liu Yin were both granted secondary sacrifice in the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Zhao Qi and Liu Yin entered the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 華商創立大同學校於日本橫濱，頒「育才廣學」扁額。

translations.literal: Chinese merchants founded the Datong School at Yokohama, Japan, and were granted a plaque reading 「Cultivate Talent and Broaden Learning」.
translations.idiomatic: Overseas Chinese opened Datong School in Yokohama and received a 「Cultivate Talent and Broaden Learning」 plaque.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，革命黨人黃興率其黨於廣州焚總督衙署，擊走之。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, revolutionary Huang Xing led his party to burn the governor-general's yamen at Guangzhou and drive him out.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Huang Xing's revolutionaries burned the Guangzhou governor-general's office and routed him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，楊文鼎請緩裁湖南綠營及防軍。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinwei: Yang Wending asked to defer cutting Hunan's Green Standard and defense forces.
translations.idiomatic: In summer month 4, xinwei, Yang Wending asked to slow Hunan Green Standard and defense cuts.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賞遊學畢業生鍾世銘、汪爔芝等法政科進士、舉人，工科舉人有差。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, returned students Zhong Shiming, Wang Yizhi, and others were rewarded with law and administration jinshi and juren ranks and engineering juren with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day overseas graduates Zhong Shiming, Wang Yizhi, and others received law jinshi, juren, and engineering juren ranks.

sentences.zh: 丙子，趙爾巽奏請用人行政便宜行事，從之。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Zhao Erxun memorialized for discretionary power in appointments and administration; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Zhao Erxun won discretionary appointment power.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，裁山東撫、鎮標營官。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, provincial and garrison command posts in Shandong's Green Standard were cut.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Shandong Green Standard provincial and garrison posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔改立責任內閣。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, an edict ordered establishment of a responsible cabinet.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the throne ordered a responsible cabinet.

sentences.zh: 頒內閣官制。

translations.literal: Cabinet regulations were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Cabinet regulations were issued.

sentences.zh: 授慶親王奕劻為內閣總理大臣，大學士那桐、徐世昌俱為協理大臣。

translations.literal: Prince Qing Yikuang was appointed Prime Minister of the Cabinet; Grand Secretaries Natong and Xu Shichang were both made Associate Prime Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qing Yikuang became cabinet prime minister; Natong and Xu Shichang became associate prime ministers.

sentences.zh: 以梁敦彥為外務大臣，善耆為民政大臣，載澤為度支大臣，唐景崇為學務大臣，蔭昌為陸軍大臣，載洵為海軍大臣，紹昌為司法大臣，溥倫為農工商大臣，盛宣懷為郵傳大臣，壽耆為理藩大臣。

translations.literal: Liang Dunyan was made Minister of Foreign Affairs, Shanqi Minister of Civil Affairs, Zaize Minister of Revenue, Tang Jingchong Minister of Education, Yin Chang Minister of the Army, Zaixun Minister of the Navy, Shaochang Minister of Justice, Pulun Minister of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce, Sheng Xuanhuai Minister of Posts and Communications, and Shouqi Minister of Dependencies.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Dunyan took foreign affairs, Shanqi civil affairs, Zaize revenue, Tang Jingchong education, Yin Chang army, Zaixun navy, Shaochang justice, Pulun agriculture and industry, Sheng Xuanhuai posts, and Shouqi dependencies.

sentences.zh: 復命內閣總、協理大臣俱為國務大臣，內閣總理大臣、協理大臣均充憲政編查館大臣，慶親王奕劻仍管理外務部。

translations.literal: It was further ordered that the Prime Minister and Associate Prime Ministers of the Cabinet should all serve as State Ministers; the Prime Minister and Associate Prime Ministers should all serve as ministers on the Constitutional Drafting Bureau; Prince Qing Yikuang still directed the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Cabinet prime and associate ministers also became state ministers and constitutional drafting ministers; Yikuang still ran foreign affairs.

sentences.zh: 置弼德院，以陸潤庠為院長，榮慶副之。

translations.literal: The Privy Council was established, with Lu Runxiang as president and Rongqing as vice-president.
translations.idiomatic: The Privy Council was set up under Lu Runxiang with Rongqing as deputy.

sentences.zh: 罷舊內閣、辦理軍機處及會議政務處。

translations.literal: The old Cabinet, the Grand Council, and the Conference on Government Affairs were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The old cabinet, Grand Council, and government affairs conference were abolished.

sentences.zh: 大學士、協辦大學士仍序次於翰林院。

translations.literal: Grand Secretaries and Associate Grand Secretaries still ranked after the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Grand and associate grand secretaries still ranked below the Hanlin.

sentences.zh: 裁內閣學士以下官。

translations.literal: Cabinet academicians and lower offices were cut.
translations.idiomatic: Cabinet academicians and subordinate posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 置軍諮府，以貝勒載濤、毓朗俱為軍諮大臣，命訂府官制。

translations.literal: The General Staff was established, with Princes Zaitao and Yulang both as staff ministers, and it was ordered to draft staff regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The General Staff was created with Princes Zaitao and Yulang as ministers and told to draft its regulations.

sentences.zh: 趙爾巽會陳夔龍、張人駿、瑞澂、李經羲與憲政編查館大臣商訂外省官制。

translations.literal: Zhao Erxun met with Chen Ailong, Zhang Renjun, Ruicheng, and Li Jingxi and constitutional drafting ministers to revise provincial government regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Erxun met Chen Ailong, Zhang Renjun, Ruicheng, Li Jingxi, and drafting ministers to revise provincial government.

sentences.zh: 己卯，慶親王奕劻、大學士那桐、徐世昌俱辭內閣總理、協理，不許，趣即任事。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Prince Qing Yikuang, Grand Secretary Natong, and Xu Shichang all resigned as Prime Minister and Associate Prime Ministers; resignation was not permitted, and they were urged to take office at once.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Yikuang, Natong, and Xu Shichang tried to quit the cabinet and were refused and ordered to serve.

sentences.zh: 重申鴉片煙禁，諭民政、度支二部，各省督撫剋期禁絕。

translations.literal: The opium prohibition was reaffirmed, and the Ministries of Civil Affairs and Revenue and all provincial governors-general and governors were instructed to ban it by a set date.
translations.idiomatic: Opium prohibition was reaffirmed and civil affairs, revenue, and every province told to end it on schedule.

sentences.zh: 詔定鐵路國有。

translations.literal: An edict fixed trunk railways as state property.
translations.idiomatic: The throne nationalized trunk railways.

sentences.zh: 先是，給事中石長信疏論各省商民集股造路公司弊害，宜敕部臣將全國幹路定為國有，自餘枝路準各省紳商集股自修，上韙之，下郵傳部議。

translations.literal: Earlier, Censor Shi Changxin had memorialized on the abuses of provincial merchant stock companies building railways: the ministry should fix all national trunk lines as state-owned, while branch lines might be built by provincial gentry stock subscription; the throne approved and referred it to the Ministry of Posts and Communications.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Censor Shi Changxin said merchant railway companies were corrupting the realm; trunk lines should be state-owned and branches left to gentry stock; the court agreed and sent it to posts.

sentences.zh: 至是，奏言：「中國幅員廣袤，邊疆遼遠，必有縱橫四境諸大幹路，方足以利行政而握中樞。

translations.literal: To this it was memorialized: 「China's territory is vast and its frontiers remote; there must be trunk railways running in all directions across the realm before administration can benefit and the center be grasped.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry said: 「China is vast and remote—trunk lines must run in every direction before rule and the center hold firm.

sentences.zh: 從前規畫未善，致路政錯亂紛歧，不分枝幹，不量民力，一紙呈請，輒準商辦。

translations.literal: Former planning was unsound, causing railway policy to fall into confusion and division, with no distinction between trunk and branch lines, no measure of the people's strength, and every paper petition promptly approved for merchant operation.
translations.idiomatic: Old planning was bad—trunk and branch were confused, the people's strength ignored, and every petition became a merchant line.

sentences.zh: 乃數載以來，粵則收股及半，造路無多。

translations.literal: In the years since, in Guangdong only half the shares were collected and little track was built.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong raised barely half its shares and built little.

sentences.zh: 川則倒帳甚鉅，參追無著。

translations.literal: In Sichuan debts were enormous and recovery was hopeless.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan debts ballooned beyond recovery.

sentences.zh: 湘、鄂則開局多年，徒供坐耗。

translations.literal: In Hunan and Hubei companies had been opened for years yet only consumed funds in idleness.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan and Hubei companies sat for years and only burned money.

sentences.zh: 循是不已，恐曠日彌久，民累愈深，上下交受其害。

translations.literal: If this continued, days would lengthen, the people's burdens deepen, and court and country alike suffer harm.
translations.idiomatic: If this went on, years would pass, burdens deepen, and court and country both suffer.

sentences.zh: 應請定幹路均歸國有，枝路任民自為。

translations.literal: It should be requested that trunk lines all revert to state ownership and branch lines be left to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Trunk lines should be nationalized and branches left to private effort.

sentences.zh: 曉諭人民，宣統三年以前各省分設公司集股商辦之幹路，應即由國家收回。

translations.literal: The people should be clearly informed that trunk lines in each province set up as merchant stock companies before the third year of Xuantong should now be recovered by the state.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial trunk companies formed before Xuantong year 3 must be bought back by the state.

sentences.zh: 亟圖修築，悉廢以前批準之案。

translations.literal: Construction should be pressed forward at once, and all previously approved cases voided.」
translations.idiomatic: Build at once and void every earlier approval.」

sentences.zh: 」故有是詔。

translations.literal: 」Hence this edict.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the edict.

sentences.zh: 辛未，吉林火災，發帑銀四萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Jilin suffered fire; forty thousand taels from the treasury were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Jilin fire relief received 40,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 癸未，贈恤署廣州將軍副都統孚琦。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, posthumous honors were granted Acting Guangzhou General and Vice Commander-in-Chief Fuqi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Acting Guangzhou General Fuqi was posthumously honored.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，資政院請預算借款兩事歸院會議，不許。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Political Consultative Assembly asked that budget and loan matters be referred to the assembly for deliberation; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the assembly asked to debate budgets and loans and was refused.

sentences.zh: 戊子，起端方以侍郎候補，充督辦粵漢、川漢鐵路大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Duanfang was recalled as vice minister on reserve appointment and made Superintendent of the Guang-Han and Chuan-Han Railways.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Duanfang returned as vice minister and took the Guang-Han and Chuan-Han railways.

sentences.zh: 諭裁缺候補人員毋得奏事。

translations.literal: An edict stated that personnel on abolished posts awaiting reassignment must not submit memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Abolished-post personnel awaiting appointment were barred from memorializing.

sentences.zh: 諭本年秋季調集禁衛軍及近畿各鎮陸軍於直隸永平府大操。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that in autumn of this year the Imperial Guard and nearby garrison armies be assembled at Yongping in Zhili for grand maneuvers.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn maneuvers at Yongping were ordered for the guard and nearby Zhili garrisons.

sentences.zh: 己丑，恭親王溥偉以疾免禁煙大臣，以順承郡王訥勒赫代之。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Prince Gong Puwei was excused as opium prohibition minister on grounds of illness; Prince Shuncheng Nelehe replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Prince Gong Puwei quit the opium post for illness and Prince Shuncheng Nelehe replaced him.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，郵傳大臣盛宣懷與英德法美四國銀行締結借款契約成。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Minister of Posts and Communications Sheng Xuanhuai completed loan contracts with banks of Britain, Germany, France, and the United States.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Sheng Xuanhuai finished railway loans with British, German, French, and American banks.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，龐鴻書罷，以沈瑜慶為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Pang Hongshu was dismissed and Shen Yuqing was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Pang Hongshu left office and Shen Yuqing became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命督撫曉諭人民，鐵路現歸官辦，起降旨之日，川、湘兩省租股，並停罷之。

translations.literal: On day renchen, governors-general and governors were ordered to inform the people that railways were now under official management and that from the date of the edict land and share levies in Sichuan and Hunan were to cease.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day provinces were told railways were state-run and Sichuan-Hunan levies must stop from the edict date.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年四月以前所收者，應由郵傳部、督辦鐵路大臣會督撫查奏。

translations.literal: Funds collected before the fourth month of the third year of Xuantong should be reported jointly by the Ministry of Posts and Communications, the railway superintendent, and the governors-general and governors.
translations.idiomatic: Collections before Xuantong year 3 month 4 must be reported by posts, the railway chief, and provincial governors.

sentences.zh: 地方官敢有隱匿不報者詰治。

translations.literal: Local officials who concealed and failed to report would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who hid receipts would be punished.

sentences.zh: 楊文鼎奏湘省自聞鐵路幹路收歸國有諭旨，群情洶懼，譁噪異常，遍發傳單，恐滋煽動。

translations.literal: Yang Wending memorialized that since Hunan heard the edict nationalizing trunk railways, popular feeling had surged in alarm, with extraordinary uproar and handbills everywhere, fearing incitement.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wending said Hunan panicked after the nationalization edict, with uproar and handbills that might incite trouble.

sentences.zh: 諭嚴行禁止，儻有匪徒從中煽惑，意在作亂者，照懲治亂黨例，格殺勿論。

translations.literal: An edict ordered strict prohibition; if bandits stirred the crowd with intent to rebel, they were to be punished under the statute on rebellious parties and killed on the spot without trial.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered a crackdown—rebels who stirred crowds were to be killed on sight under the rebel statute.

sentences.zh: 朱家寶奏江、淮交會為匪黨出沒之區，比歲薦饑，盜風尤熾。

translations.literal: Zhu Jiabao memorialized that the Jiang-Huai junction was a haunt of bandit parties and that in recent years of repeated famine robbery had grown fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Jiabao said the Jiang-Huai border bred bandits and famine years had made robbery fiercer.

sentences.zh: 請援鄂、蜀懲辦會匪、土匪章程，犯者以軍法從事。

translations.literal: He asked to apply the Hubei and Sichuan regulations for punishing secret-society and mountain bandits, with offenders dealt with by military law.
translations.idiomatic: He asked for Hubei-Sichuan secret-society rules and military-law punishment.

sentences.zh: 丙申，移稅務司附屬之郵政歸郵傳部管理。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, postal service under the Inspector General of Customs was transferred to the Ministry of Posts and Communications.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day customs postal service went to posts and communications.

sentences.zh: 除雲南昆明縣官用田地額賦。

translations.literal: Land tax on official fields in Kunming county, Yunnan, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Kunming official-field land tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賑山東滕、嶧二縣災。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Teng and Yi counties in Shandong received disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Shandong's Teng and Yi counties were fed.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，用湖南京官大理寺少卿王世祺等言，停湖南因路抽收房捐及米鹽捐。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengzi: following the memorial of Beijing official and Acting Dali Vice Minister Wang Shiqi and others, Hunan's house tax and rice-salt levies for the railway were stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, gengzi, Beijing official Wang Shiqi ended Hunan's railway house tax and rice-salt levies.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，楊文鼎奏湖南諮議局呈湘路力能自辦，不甘借債，據情代奏，嚴飭之。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Yang Wending memorialized that the Hunan Consultative Assembly had stated the Hunan railway could be self-managed and they would not borrow; he had relayed the petition and was severely rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Yang Wending relayed Hunan's refusal to borrow for its railway and was sharply rebuked.

sentences.zh: 恤墨西哥被害華僑銀。

translations.literal: Silver was granted in condolence for Chinese merchants killed in Mexico.
translations.idiomatic: Silver was sent for Chinese killed in Mexico.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，裁廣西綠營都司、守備以下官及馬步兵。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Guangxi Green Standard brigade commanders, defenders, and lower officers and cavalry and infantry were cut.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Guangxi Green Standard brigade and defender posts and troops were cut.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，山東兗、沂、曹三府，濟寧州災，發帑銀三萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Yan, Yi, and Cao prefectures and Jining subprefecture in Shandong suffered disaster; thirty thousand taels were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Shandong's Yan, Yi, Cao, and Jining received 30,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 四川諮議局以紳民自聞鐵路國有之旨，函電紛馳，請緩接收，並請停刊訁謄黃，呈王人文代奏。

translations.literal: The Sichuan Consultative Assembly, since gentry and people heard the railway nationalization edict, sent letters and telegrams in succession asking to defer takeover and to stop printing the edict text; Wang Renwen relayed the petition.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan's assembly asked to delay takeover and stop printing the edict after nationalization; Wang Renwen relayed it.

sentences.zh: 人文以聞，詔切責之，仍命迅速刊刻訁謄黃，遍行曉諭，並剴切開導。

translations.literal: Wang Renwen reported it; an edict sharply rebuked them and still ordered rapid printing and distribution of the edict text with earnest exhortation.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Renwen reported it; the court rebuked them but still ordered the edict printed and preached.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，免琿春貧苦旗丁承領荒地價銀。

translations.literal: On day yisi, poor bannermen of Hunchun were exempted from payment for wasteland they had taken up.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day poor Hunchun bannermen owed no wasteland fees.

sentences.zh: 戊申，廷試遊學畢業生進士江古懷等，敘官有差。

translations.literal: On day wushen, returned-student jinshi Jiang Guhuai and others underwent palace examination and received offices with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day returned-student jinshi Jiang Guhuai and others were examined and posted.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，孫寶琦奏宗支不宜豫政，飭之。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Sun Baoqi memorialized that collateral princes should not meddle in government; he was rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Sun Baoqi said princes should not meddle in politics and was rebuked.

sentences.zh: 壬子，起復那桐，仍授文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Natong was recalled to service and again made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Natong returned as Wenyuan grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，廣東因收回路事，倡議不用官發紙幣，持票取銀。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Guangdong, over railway recovery, urged refusal of government paper notes and demanded silver for notes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Guangdong refused government notes over railway recovery and demanded silver.

sentences.zh: 諭張鳴岐防範。

translations.literal: Zhang Mingqi was ordered to guard against it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Mingqi was told to guard against it.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，資政院上修改速記學堂章程。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Political Consultative Assembly submitted revised regulations for the Stenography Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the assembly revised stenography academy rules.

sentences.zh: 戊午，度支、郵傳二部會奏川、粵、漢幹路收回辦法。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Ministries of Revenue and Posts and Communications jointly memorialized methods for recovering the Chuan, Yue, and Han trunk lines.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day revenue and posts reported how to recover Sichuan, Guangdong, and Hankou trunk railways.

sentences.zh: 請收回粵、川、湘、鄂四省公司股票，由部特出國家鐵路股票換給。

translations.literal: They asked to recover company stock in Guangdong, Sichuan, Hunan, and Hubei and issue special state railway bonds in exchange.
translations.idiomatic: They asked to swap Guangdong, Sichuan, Hunan, and Hubei stock for state railway bonds.

sentences.zh: 粵路發六成。

translations.literal: Guangdong stock would be paid at sixty percent.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong would get sixty percent.

sentences.zh: 湘、鄂路照本發還。

translations.literal: Hunan and Hubei stock would be repaid in full.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan and Hubei would be repaid at par.

sentences.zh: 川路宜昌實用工料之款四百餘萬，給國家保利股票，其現存七百餘萬兩，或仍入股，或興實業，悉聽其便。

translations.literal: For the Sichuan line, more than four million taels actually spent on labor and materials at Yichang would receive state interest-bearing bonds; the more than seven million taels on hand might remain as shares or go into industry, as holders wished.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan's four million spent at Yichang would become state bonds; seven million on hand could stay invested or enter industry.

sentences.zh: 詔端方迅往三省會各督撫照行之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Duanfang to go swiftly to the three provinces and carry this out with each governor-general and governor.
translations.idiomatic: Duanfang was told to hurry to the three provinces and enforce the plan with each governor.

sentences.zh: 丁寶銓以疾免，以陳寶琛為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Ding Baochen was excused on grounds of illness; Chen Baochen was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Baochen quit for illness and Chen Baochen became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命於式枚總理禮學館。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Yu Shimei was made director of the College of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Yu Shimei took the College of Rites.

sentences.zh: 甲子，內閣上內閣屬官官制、法制院官制，詔頒布之。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Cabinet submitted regulations for subordinate cabinet offices and for the Legislative Bureau; an edict promulgated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the cabinet issued subordinate and legislative bureau regulations.

sentences.zh: 置內閣承宣廳，制誥、敘官、統計、印鑄四局。

translations.literal: The Cabinet Dispatch Office was established, with Bureaus of Edicts, Appointments, Statistics, and Seals.
translations.idiomatic: A cabinet dispatch office and edict, appointment, statistics, and seal bureaus were set up.

sentences.zh: 設閣丞、廳長、局長各官。

translations.literal: Chancellors, directors, and bureau chiefs were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellors, directors, and bureau chiefs were named.

sentences.zh: 並置內閣法制院院使。

translations.literal: A president of the Cabinet Legislative Bureau was also appointed.
translations.idiomatic: A cabinet legislative bureau president was appointed.

sentences.zh: 罷憲政編查館、吏部、中書科、稽察欽奉上諭事件處、批本處，俱歸其事於內閣。

translations.literal: The Constitutional Drafting Bureau, Ministry of Personnel, Secretariat of the Grand Secretariat, Office for Investigating Imperial Rescripts, and Drafting Office were abolished and their duties transferred to the Cabinet.
translations.idiomatic: Drafting, personnel, secretariat, rescript investigation, and drafting offices were abolished and merged into the cabinet.

sentences.zh: 以繙書房改隸翰林院。

translations.literal: The Translation Office was placed under the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: The Translation Office went under the Hanlin.

sentences.zh: 陸軍部奏，簡各省督練公所軍事參議官。

translations.literal: The Army Ministry memorialized simplifying military advisers in each province's training offices.
translations.idiomatic: The army ministry simplified provincial training-office advisers.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，翰林院進檢討章梫所纂康熙政要。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Hanlin Academy presented the Kangxi Political Essentials compiled by Compiler Zhang Jie.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the Hanlin presented Zhang Jie's Kangxi Political Essentials.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，命資政院會內閣改訂院章。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingmao: the Political Consultative Assembly was ordered to meet with the Cabinet to revise assembly regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, dingmao, the assembly was told to revise its charter with the cabinet.

sentences.zh: 賑湖南武陵、龍陽、益陽三縣水災。

translations.literal: Flood victims in Wuling, Longyang, and Yiyang counties in Hunan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan's Wuling, Longyang, and Yiyang flood victims were fed.

sentences.zh: 保定陸軍軍械局火藥庫、陸軍第二鎮演武廳火藥庫俱火。

translations.literal: Powder magazines at the Baoding Army Ordnance Bureau and at the Second Division drill hall in Baoding both caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: Baoding ordnance and Second Division powder magazines burned.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，安徽水，無為州五里碑、九連等處圩壞。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Anhui flooded; dikes at Wuli Tablet and Jiulian in Wuwei subprefecture broke.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Anhui flooded and Wuwei dikes broke at Wuli Tablet and Jiulian.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以榮慶為弼德院院長，鄒嘉來副之。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Rongqing was made president of the Privy Council and Zou Jialai vice-president.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Rongqing headed the Privy Council and Zou Jialai deputized.

sentences.zh: 陸潤庠免禁煙大臣，陳寶琛免山西巡撫，以侍郎候補。

translations.literal: Lu Runxiang was excused as opium prohibition minister; Chen Baochen was excused as Shanxi governor and placed on vice-minister reserve appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Runxiang left the opium post; Chen Baochen left Shanxi and went on vice-minister reserve.

sentences.zh: 伊克坦免都察院副都御史，以副都統記名。

translations.literal: Yiketan was excused as Vice Censor-in-Chief and placed on vice commander-in-chief reserve list.
translations.idiomatic: Yiketan left the censorate and went on vice commander reserve.

sentences.zh: 裁兼管順天府府尹。

translations.literal: The concurrent post of Shuntian Metropolitan Prefect was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The concurrent Shuntian prefect post was cut.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以陸鍾琦為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Lu Zhongqi was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Lu Zhongqi became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 癸未，趙爾豐奏收巴塘得榮地方，戶民請納糧稅，浪莊寺喇嘛千餘人許還俗。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Zhao Erfeng memorialized that Derong in Batang had been recovered, household people asked to pay grain tax, and more than a thousand monks of Langzhuang Monastery were permitted to return to lay life.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Zhao Erfeng said Batang's Derong paid tax and a thousand Langzhuang monks were allowed to leave the robe.

sentences.zh: 又奏巴塘臨卡石戶民投誠，撥隸三壩廳管理。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that household people at Linka Rock in Batang had submitted and were placed under Sanba subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He also said Linka Rock households submitted to Sanba subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，伊克昭盟紥薩克固山貝子三濟密都布旗災，發帑銀一萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, disaster struck the banner of Jasagh Gushan Beizi Sanjimidub in the Ike Zhaoleague; ten thousand taels were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Ike Zhaoleague's Sanjimidub banner received 10,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，丹噶爾廳及西寧縣匪黨糾眾為亂，官軍擊散之，首犯李旺、李統春、李官博儉等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, bandits in Dangar subprefecture and Xining county gathered a crowd in revolt; government troops scattered them, and ringleaders Li Wang, Li Tongchun, Li Guanbo, and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Dangar and Xining bandits rose, troops scattered them, and Li Wang, Li Tongchun, and Li Guanbo were executed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，置典禮院，設掌院大學士、副掌院學士、學士、直學士各官。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the College of Rites was established, with posts of chief grand secretary, associate chief, academician, and direct academician.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the College of Rites was set up with chief, deputy, academician, and direct academician posts.

sentences.zh: 以李殿林為典禮院掌院學士，郭曾炘為副。

translations.literal: Li Dianlin was made chief academician of the College of Rites and Guo Cengxin associate.
translations.idiomatic: Li Dianlin headed the College of Rites and Guo Cengxin deputized.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，四川紳民羅綸等二千四百餘人，以收路國有，盛宣懷、端方會度支部奏定辦法，對待川民純用威力，未為持平，不敢從命，呈請裁察。

translations.literal: On day renchen, more than twenty-four hundred Sichuan gentry and people led by Luo Lun, because trunk railways were nationalized and Sheng Xuanhuai and Duanfang with the Revenue Ministry had set methods treating Sichuan people with pure force and no fairness, dared not obey and asked for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day 2,400 Sichuan gentry led by Luo Lun said nationalization and Sheng Xuanhuai's harsh methods were unfair and asked for review.

sentences.zh: 王人文以聞，詔以一再瀆奏，切責之。

translations.literal: Wang Renwen reported it; an edict sharply rebuked them for repeated disrespect in memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Renwen relayed it; the court rebuked repeated disrespect.

sentences.zh: 增設和屬爪哇島總領事，泗水、蘇門答臘正領事。

translations.literal: A consul-general for the Netherlands East Indies and consuls at Surabaya and Sumatra were added.
translations.idiomatic: Consuls were added for the Dutch East Indies, Surabaya, and Sumatra.

sentences.zh: 甲午，湖南常德府大雨河溢，浸屬縣，壞田廬，發帑銀六萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, heavy rain in Changde prefecture, Hunan, overflowed the river and flooded subordinate counties, ruining fields and houses; sixty thousand taels were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Hunan's Changde flooded its counties and received 60,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以禁煙與英使續訂條件，重申厲禁，諭中外切實奉行。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, renewed opium prohibition terms were concluded with the British minister, the strict ban was reaffirmed, and China and foreign countries were ordered to enforce it in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Britain renewed opium terms, the ban was reaffirmed, and all were told to enforce it.

sentences.zh: 閏六月己亥，命寶熙充禁煙大臣。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, day jihai: Baoxi was appointed opium prohibition minister.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 6, jihai, Baoxi became opium prohibition minister.

sentences.zh: 庚子，恩壽以疾免，以余誠格為陜西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Enshou was excused on grounds of illness; Yu Chengge was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Enshou quit for illness and Yu Chengge became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，安徽大雨，江潮暴發，濱江沿河各州縣澇災，發帑銀五萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, heavy rain in Anhui raised the Yangtze tide; flooded counties along the river received fifty thousand taels for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Anhui's Yangtze flood counties received 50,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，調余誠格為湖南巡撫，楊文鼎為陜西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Yu Chengge was transferred to Hunan governor and Yang Wending to Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Yu Chengge went to Hunan and Yang Wending to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔本年調集禁衛軍及近畿各鎮軍於永平府大操，命軍諮大臣貝勒載濤恭代親臨監軍。

translations.literal: On day renzi, an edict ordered that this year's assembly of the Imperial Guard and nearby garrison armies at Yongping for grand maneuvers should have Staff Minister Prince Zaitao attend in the regent's place to oversee the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Yongping maneuvers were ordered with Prince Zaitao overseeing for the regent.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命貝子溥倫、鎮國公載澤會宗人府纂擬皇室大典。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Princes Pulun and Zaize were ordered to join the Imperial Clan Court in drafting the imperial house code.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Princes Pulun and Zaize joined the clan court to draft the imperial code.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，革命黨人以藥彈道擊廣東水師提督李準，傷而免。

translations.literal: On day yimao, revolutionaries struck Guangdong naval commander Li Zhun with an explosive device; he was wounded but survived.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day revolutionaries bombed Guangdong naval commander Li Zhun, who survived wounded.

sentences.zh: 前吉林將軍銘安卒。

translations.literal: Former Jilin General Ming'an died.
translations.idiomatic: Former Jilin General Ming'an died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命載振、陸潤庠、增祺、陳寶琛、丁振鐸、姚錫光、沈雲沛、誠勛、清銳、朱祖謀俱充弼德院顧問大臣，國務大臣奕劻、那桐、徐世昌、梁敦彥、善耆、載澤、唐景崇、蔭昌、載洵、紹昌、溥倫、盛宣懷、壽耆及宗人府宗令世鐸、總管內務府大臣奎俊、繼祿俱兼任弼德院顧問大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Zai Zhen, Lu Runxiang, Zengqi, Chen Baochen, Ding Zhenduo, Yao Xiguang, Shen Yunpei, Cheng Xun, Qingrui, and Zhu Zumou were all made Privy Council advisers; State Ministers Yikuang, Natong, Xu Shichang, Liang Dunyan, Shanqi, Zaize, Tang Jingchong, Yin Chang, Zaixun, Shaochang, Pulun, Sheng Xuanhuai, and Shouqi, together with Imperial Clan Court Director Shiro, Chief of the Imperial Household Department Kuichun, and Jilu, were all made concurrent Privy Council advisers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Zai Zhen, Lu Runxiang, and others became privy advisers; Yikuang, Natong, Xu Shichang, and other state ministers also advised the privy council.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，調善耆為理藩大臣，以桂春署民政大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Shanqi was transferred to Minister of Dependencies and Gui Chun acted as Minister of Civil Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Shanqi took dependencies and Gui Chun acted for civil affairs.

sentences.zh: 調鳳山為廣州將軍，以壽耆為荊州將軍。

translations.literal: Fengshan was transferred to Guangzhou general; Shouqi was made Jingzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: Fengshan became Guangzhou general and Shouqi Jingzhou general.

sentences.zh: 川路股東會會長顏楷等呈劾郵傳部，趙爾豐以聞，不報。

translations.literal: Yan Kai and other leaders of the Sichuan Railway Shareholders' Association memorialized impeaching the Ministry of Posts and Communications; Zhao Erfeng reported it and no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan railway shareholders impeached posts through Zhao Erfeng and got no answer.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，裁各省府治首縣，改置地方審判廳。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, chief counties of provincial prefectures were cut and local trial courts established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day provincial chief counties were cut and local courts set up.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，內閣請修訂法規。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Cabinet asked to revise regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the cabinet asked to revise regulations.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申，趙爾豐奏鐵路收歸國有，川民仍多誤會，相率要求。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day renshen: Zhao Erfeng memorialized that with trunk railways nationalized, Sichuan people still widely misunderstood and pressed demands in groups.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, renshen, Zhao Erfeng said Sichuan still misunderstood nationalization and pressed demands.

sentences.zh: 諭郵傳部、督辦鐵路大臣清理路股，明示辦法，以釋群疑。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Posts and Communications and the railway superintendent were ordered to clear railway shares and make the methods plain to dispel public doubt.
translations.idiomatic: Posts and the railway chief were told to settle shares and explain the plan.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命瑞澂、張鳴岐、趙爾豐、余誠格各於轄境會辦鐵路事宜。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Ruicheng, Zhang Mingqi, Zhao Erfeng, and Yu Chengge were each ordered to handle railway affairs jointly within their jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Ruicheng, Zhang Mingqi, Zhao Erfeng, and Yu Chengge were told to handle railways in their provinces.

sentences.zh: 命端方赴四川按查路事。

translations.literal: Duanfang was ordered to go to Sichuan to investigate railway affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Duanfang was sent to Sichuan to investigate railways.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以四川人心浮動，宜防鼓惑，諭提督田振邦嚴束營伍彈壓之，趣端方速赴四川，許帶兵隊。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, because Sichuan popular feeling was unsettled and agitation should be guarded against, Brigade Commander Tian Zhenbang was ordered strictly to restrain his camp and suppress; Duanfang was urged to go swiftly to Sichuan and permitted to bring troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Tian Zhenbang was told to hold his troops and Duanfang to hurry to Sichuan with soldiers.

sentences.zh: 趙爾豐、玉昆率提督、司、道奏，川民爭路激烈，請交資政院議決仍歸商辦，不許，仍責趙爾豐彈壓解散。

translations.literal: Zhao Erfeng and Yukun with brigade commanders and provincial officials memorialized that the Sichuan people's railway struggle was fierce and asked the Political Consultative Assembly to decide to return to merchant management; it was not permitted, and Zhao Erfeng was still charged to suppress and disperse them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Erfeng and Yukun asked the assembly to restore merchant railways; the court refused and ordered suppression.

sentences.zh: 己卯，江蘇各屬大雨，圩堤潰決，田禾淹沒，發帑銀四萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day jimao, heavy rain in Jiangsu jurisdictions broke dikes; crops were submerged; forty thousand taels were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Jiangsu floods broke dikes and received 40,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 永定河決。

translations.literal: The Yongding River burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding River burst.

sentences.zh: 端方入川，水陸新舊諸軍聽調遣。

translations.literal: Duanfang entered Sichuan; new and old land and water forces were placed at his disposal.
translations.idiomatic: Duanfang entered Sichuan with all land and water forces at his call.

sentences.zh: 調陸徵祥為出使俄國大臣，劉鏡人為出使和國大臣。

translations.literal: Lu Zhengxiang was transferred to minister to Russia; Liu Jingren to minister to the Netherlands.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhengxiang went to Russia and Liu Jingren to the Netherlands.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，忠瑞免，以桂芳為科布多辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Zhongrui was excused; Guifang was made Kobdo Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Zhongrui left office and Guifang became Kobdo commissioner.

sentences.zh: 溥睘免，以薩蔭圖為科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Puyi was excused; Sayintu was made Kobdo Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Puyi left Kobdo and Sayintu became deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬午，四川亂作，趙爾豐執諮議局議長蒲殿俊、副議長羅綸、保路同志會長鄧孝可、股東會長顏楷、張瀾及胡嶸、江三乘、葉秉誠、王銘新九人。

translations.literal: On day renwu, disorder broke out in Sichuan; Zhao Erfeng arrested Consultative Assembly Speaker Pu Dianjun, Vice Speaker Luo Lun, Railway Protection League head Deng Xiaoke, Shareholders' Association head Yan Kai, Zhang Lan, Hu Rong, Jiang Sanheng, Ye Bingcheng, and Wang Mingxin—nine men in all.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Sichuan rose; Zhao Erfeng arrested Pu Dianjun, Luo Lun, Deng Xiaoke, Yan Kai, Zhang Lan, and five others.

sentences.zh: 尋同志會聚眾圍總督署，擊之始散。

translations.literal: Soon the league gathered a crowd and besieged the governor's office; they were driven off only after attack.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the league besieged the governor's office and was driven off by force.

sentences.zh: 賑浙江杭、嘉、湖、紹四府災。

translations.literal: Disaster relief was given for Hang, Jia, Hu, and Shao prefectures in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang's Hang, Jia, Hu, and Shao prefectures were fed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，帝入學，大學士陸潤庠、侍郎陳寶琛授讀，副都統伊克坦教習國語清文。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, the Emperor began study; Grand Secretary Lu Runxiang and Vice Minister Chen Baochen taught reading; Vice Commander-in-Chief Yiketan taught Manchu and Qing script.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the Emperor began study under Lu Runxiang, Chen Baochen, and Yiketan for Manchu.

sentences.zh: 賑湖北水災。

translations.literal: Hubei flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei flood victims were fed.

sentences.zh: 甲申，廣東澄海縣堤決，發帑銀四萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, dikes in Chenghai county, Guangdong, broke; forty thousand taels were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Guangdong's Chenghai dikes broke and received 40,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 四川旅京人民以爭路開會，具呈資政院乞代奏。

translations.literal: Sichuan people in Beijing met over the railway struggle and submitted a petition to the Political Consultative Assembly asking it to memorialize on their behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan residents in Beijing petitioned the assembly over the railway fight.

sentences.zh: 命捕代表劉聲元解歸籍。

translations.literal: Representative Liu Shengyuan was ordered arrested and sent back to his native place.
translations.idiomatic: Representative Liu Shengyuan was arrested and sent home.

sentences.zh: 諭學部約束學生勿預外事，並敕所司禁聚眾開會。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Education was ordered to restrain students from foreign affairs, and officials were charged to forbid mass meetings.
translations.idiomatic: Education was told to keep students out of politics and mass meetings were banned.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，山東濟南及東西路各州縣水災，黃河上遊民墊復決，發帑銀五萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Jinan and eastern and western route counties in Shandong suffered flood; the Yellow River upstream levee broke again; fifty thousand taels were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Shandong and the Yellow River upstream flooded and received 50,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 賑福建水災。

translations.literal: Fujian flood victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian flood victims were fed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命前兩廣總督岑春煊往四川，會趙爾豐辦理剿撫事宜。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, former Liang-Guang Governor-General Cen Chunxuan was sent to Sichuan to join Zhao Erfeng in pacification and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Cen Chunxuan was sent to Sichuan with Zhao Erfeng to pacify and suppress.

sentences.zh: 己丑，監國攝政王閱禁衛軍。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Prince Regent reviewed the Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the Prince Regent reviewed the guard.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以四川民亂，諭趙爾豐督飭諸軍迅速擊散，仍分別良莠剿撫，被脅者宥之。

translations.literal: On day guisi, because of disorder among the Sichuan people, Zhao Erfeng was ordered to command all armies swiftly to scatter them, while distinguishing good from bad in suppression and pacification and pardoning those coerced.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Zhao Erfeng was told to scatter Sichuan rebels, spare the coerced, and punish ringleaders.

sentences.zh: 甲午，波密野番投誠。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, wild tribes of Bomi submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Bomi tribes submitted.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，總稅務司赫德卒，晉太子太保銜。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingshen: Inspector General of Customs Robert Hart died and was posthumously given the rank of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, bingshen, Inspector General Hart died and received Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent rank.

sentences.zh: 予故成都將軍、前伊犁將軍馬亮於伊犁建祠。

translations.literal: Former Chengdu General and former Ili General Ma Liang was granted a temple at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Former Chengdu and Ili General Ma Liang received a temple at Ili.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，慶親王奕劻復請免內閣總理大臣及管理外務部，不許。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Prince Qing Yikuang again asked to be excused as Prime Minister and director of foreign affairs; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Prince Qing Yikuang tried again to quit the cabinet and foreign affairs and was refused.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，裁直隸督標、提標，通永、天津、正定、大名、宣化各鎮標官弁馬步守兵，提督依舊。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Zhili provincial and brigade commands, Tongyong, Tianjin, Zhengding, Daming, and Xuanhua garrison commands, officers, and cavalry and infantry were cut; the brigade commander remained.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Zhili provincial, brigade, and garrison posts and troops were cut but brigade commanders kept.

sentences.zh: 丙午，江南提督劉光才以疾免，調張勛代之，以張懷芝為甘肅提督。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Jiangnan Brigade Commander Liu Guangcai was excused on grounds of illness; Zhang Xun replaced him; Zhang Huaizhi was made Gansu brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Liu Guangcai quit, Zhang Xun took Jiangnan, and Zhang Huaizhi took Gansu.

sentences.zh: 丁未，定國樂。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, state music was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day state music was set.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，置鹽政院，設大臣以下官，廢鹽務處。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Salt Administration Bureau was established with ministers and subordinate officers; the Salt Affairs Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Salt Administration Bureau replaced the Salt Affairs Office.

sentences.zh: 命載澤兼任鹽政大臣。

translations.literal: Zaize was ordered to serve concurrently as Salt Administration Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Zaize also took salt administration.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，端方、瑞澂奏，湖北境內粵漢、川漢鐵路改歸國有，取消商辦公司，議定接收路股辦法，詔嘉之，並以深明大義獎士紳。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Duanfang and Ruicheng memorialized that within Hubei the Guang-Han and Chuan-Han railways were changed to state ownership, merchant companies canceled, and methods for receiving shares set; an edict praised this and rewarded gentry and scholars for grasping the great principle.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Duanfang and Ruicheng nationalized Guang-Han and Chuan-Han lines in Hubei and were praised.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，革命黨謀亂於武昌，事覺，捕三十二人，誅劉汝夔等三人。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, revolutionaries plotted disorder at Wuchang; the plot was discovered, thirty-two were arrested, and Liu Ru'ao and three others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day a Wuchang plot was uncovered, thirty-two arrested, and Liu Ru'ao and three executed.

sentences.zh: 瑞澂以聞，詔嘉其弭患初萌，定亂俄頃，命就擒獲諸人嚴鞫，並緝逃亡。

translations.literal: Ruicheng reported it; an edict praised his quelling trouble at the first sprout and settling disorder in a moment, ordered strict interrogation of those captured, and pursuit of fugitives.
translations.idiomatic: Ruicheng reported it; the court praised early suppression and ordered harsh interrogation and pursuit.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，武昌新軍變附於革命黨，總督瑞澂棄城走，遂陷武昌。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Wuchang's new army mutinied and joined the revolutionaries; Governor Ruicheng abandoned the city and fled, and Wuchang fell.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Wuchang's new army mutinied, Ruicheng fled, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 詔奪瑞澂職，仍命權總督事，戴罪圖功。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Ruicheng of office but still ordered him to act as governor and redeem guilt by achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Ruicheng lost his post but stayed as acting governor to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 命陸軍大臣蔭昌督師往討，湖北軍及援軍悉聽節制，薩鎮冰率兵艦、程允和率水師並援之。

translations.literal: Army Minister Yin Chang was ordered to lead troops in suppression; all Hubei forces and reinforcements were placed under his command; Sa Zhenbing led warships and Cheng Yunhe led the navy in support.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Chang was sent to suppress Wuchang with Hubei forces, Sa Zhenbing's fleet, and Cheng Yunhe's navy.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，張彪以兵匪構變，棄營潛逃，奪湖北提督，仍責剿匪。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Zhang Biao, because soldiers and bandits had joined in mutiny, abandoned camp and fled in secret; he was stripped of Hubei brigade command but still charged with suppressing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Zhang Biao fled a mutiny, lost Hubei command, but still had to fight bandits.

sentences.zh: 停永平大操。

translations.literal: The Yongping grand maneuvers were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Yongping maneuvers were canceled.

sentences.zh: 弛山西、河南運糧禁。

translations.literal: The ban on grain transport through Shanxi and Henan was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi and Henan grain transport bans were lifted.

sentences.zh: 武昌軍民擁陸軍第二十一混成協統領官黎元洪稱都督，置軍政府。

translations.literal: Wuchang's soldiers and people installed Colonel Li Yuanhong of the Twenty-first Mixed Brigade as governor and set up a military government.
translations.idiomatic: Wuchang made Li Yuanhong of the Twenty-first Mixed Brigade governor and founded a military government.

sentences.zh: 嗣是行省各擁兵據地號獨立，舉為魁者皆稱都督。

translations.literal: Thereafter each province seized troops and territory and declared independence; those chosen as leaders were all called governors.
translations.idiomatic: Then provinces seized troops, declared independence, and called their leaders governors.

sentences.zh: 革命軍取漢陽，襲兵工廠、鐵廠，據漢口。

translations.literal: Revolutionary forces took Hanyang, raided the arsenal and ironworks, and held Hankou.
translations.idiomatic: Revolutionaries took Hanyang, seized the arsenal and ironworks, and held Hankou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，起袁世凱為湖廣總督，岑春煊為四川總督，俱督辦剿撫事宜。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Yuan Shikai was recalled as Huguang governor-general and Cen Chunxuan as Sichuan governor-general, both to supervise suppression and pacification.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Yuan Shikai became Huguang governor-general and Cen Chunxuan Sichuan governor-general for suppression.

sentences.zh: 命貝勒載濤督禁衛各軍守近畿。

translations.literal: Prince Zaitao was ordered to command the Imperial Guard and nearby armies to guard the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zaitao was told to hold the guard and nearby armies around the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊午，王人文罷，復以趙爾豐為川滇邊務大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Wang Renwen was dismissed; Zhao Erfeng was again made Sichuan-Yunnan Border Affairs Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Wang Renwen left and Zhao Erfeng returned to Sichuan-Yunnan border affairs.

sentences.zh: 停奉天今年貢。

translations.literal: Fengtian's tribute for this year was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian tribute was suspended for the year.

sentences.zh: 己未，岑春煊辭四川總督，詔不許。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Cen Chunxuan declined Sichuan governor-general; the edict did not permit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Cen Chunxuan tried to refuse Sichuan and was refused.

sentences.zh: 趣梁敦彥來京供職。

translations.literal: Liang Dunyan was urged to come to the capital for duty.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Dunyan was summoned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 京師開糶濟民食。

translations.literal: The capital opened fair-price grain sales to relieve the people's food supply.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing sold grain at fair price.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔長江水陸諸軍俱聽袁世凱節制。

translations.literal: On day renxu, an edict placed all Yangtze land and water forces under Yuan Shikai's command.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day all Yangtze land and water forces went to Yuan Shikai.

sentences.zh: 諭川、楚用兵，原脅從，自拔來歸，不咎既往，原隨軍自效，能擒獻匪黨者，優賞之。

translations.literal: It was stated that in Sichuan and Huguang military operations, those originally coerced, if they came over of themselves, would not be punished for the past; if they followed the army and proved effective, or captured and presented bandit leaders, they would be richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan and Huguang coerced men who defected would be spared; those who served or captured rebels would be rewarded.

sentences.zh: 獲逆黨名冊應銷毀，毋株連。

translations.literal: Registers of rebels captured were to be destroyed and no guilt extended by association.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel registers were to be burned and kin left alone.

sentences.zh: 兩省被擾地方撫恤之。

translations.literal: Disturbed places in the two provinces were to be comforted.
translations.idiomatic: War-torn districts in both provinces were to be comforted.

sentences.zh: 免裁各省綠營、巡防隊。

translations.literal: The cutting of Green Standard and patrol forces in each province was waived.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Green Standard and patrol cuts were canceled.

sentences.zh: 壽耆免，授連魁荊州將軍。

translations.literal: Shouqi was excused; Lian Kui was made Jingzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: Shouqi left office and Lian Kui became Jingzhou general.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，皇太后懿旨，發帑銀二十萬兩賑湖北遭兵難民。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Empress Dowager's benevolent edict issued two hundred thousand taels to relieve Hubei people afflicted by war.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the empress dowager sent 200,000 taels for Hubei war victims.

sentences.zh: 福建龍溪、南靖兩縣河溢堤決，發帑銀二萬兩賑之。

translations.literal: Longxi and Nanjing counties in Fujian overflowed and dikes broke; twenty thousand taels were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's Longxi and Nanjing floods received 20,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 以湖北用兵，諭山東、山西兩省購運米麥濟軍。

translations.literal: Because Hubei was at war, Shandong and Shanxi were ordered to purchase and transport grain to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong and Shanxi were told to buy grain for the Hubei army.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命副都統王士珍襄辦湖北軍務。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Vice Commander-in-Chief Wang Shizhen was ordered to assist in Hubei military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Wang Shizhen was sent to assist Hubei military affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon day yichou: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On month 9's yichou new moon the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 資政院第二次開會，詔勖議員。

translations.literal: The Political Consultative Assembly opened its second session; an edict exhorted the members.
translations.idiomatic: The assembly's second session opened under an exhorting edict.

sentences.zh: 湖南新軍變，巡撫余誠格奔於兵艦，巡防營統領前廣西右江鎮總兵黃忠浩死之。

translations.literal: Hunan's new army mutinied; Governor Yu Chengge fled to a warship; Patrol Commander and former Guangxi Youjiang Brigade Commander Huang Zhonghao died.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan's new army mutinied; Yu Chengge fled to a ship and Huang Zhonghao was killed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，陜西新軍變，護巡撫布政使錢能訓自殺不克，遂走潼關，西安將軍文瑞、副都統承燕、克蒙額俱死之。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Shaanxi's new army mutinied; Acting Governor and Provincial Treasurer Qian Nengxun tried suicide and failed, then fled to Tong Pass; Xi'an General Wen Rui and Vice Commanders-in-Chief Cheng Yan and Keming'e all died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Shaanxi mutinied; Qian Nengxun fled to Tong Pass and Wen Rui, Cheng Yan, and Keming'e died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，皇太后懿旨，發內帑二十四萬兩賑直隸、吉林、江蘇、安徽、山東、浙江、湖南、廣東諸省饑，立慈善救濟會。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, the Empress Dowager's benevolent edict issued two hundred forty thousand taels from the inner treasury to relieve famine in Zhili, Jilin, Jiangsu, Anhui, Shandong, Zhejiang, Hunan, and Guangdong and established a charitable relief society.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the empress dowager sent 240,000 taels for eight provinces' famine and founded a relief society.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，張蔭棠免，以施肇基充出使義墨秘魯三國大臣。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Zhang Yintang was excused; Shi Zhaoji was made minister to Italy, Mexico, and Peru.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Zhang Yintang left and Shi Zhaoji went to Italy, Mexico, and Peru.

sentences.zh: 革命黨人以藥彈擊殺廣州將軍鳳山。

translations.literal: Revolutionaries killed Guangzhou General Fengshan with an explosive device.
translations.idiomatic: Revolutionaries bombed and killed Guangzhou General Fengshan.

sentences.zh: 己巳，皇太后助帑於慈善救濟會。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Empress Dowager contributed from the inner treasury to the charitable relief society.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the empress dowager gave to the relief society.

sentences.zh: 資政院言郵傳大臣盛宣懷侵權違法，罔上欺君，塗附政策，釀成禍亂，實為誤國首惡，詔奪職。

translations.literal: The Political Consultative Assembly stated that Minister of Posts and Communications Sheng Xuanhuai had exceeded authority, violated law, deceived the throne, and clung to policy, brewing calamity and disorder, and was in truth the chief culprit who had ruined the state; an edict stripped him of office.
translations.idiomatic: The assembly impeached Sheng Xuanhuai as the ruin of the state and he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 端方奏，訪查川亂緣起，實由官民交閧而成，請釋諮議局議長蒲殿俊及鄧孝可等九人，湖北拘留法部主事蕭湘並免議，從之。

translations.literal: Duanfang memorialized that on investigation the Sichuan disorder arose from mutual strife between officials and people; he asked release of Consultative Assembly Speaker Pu Dianjun and Deng Xiaoke and eight others, and that Ministry of Justice Director Xiao Xiang detained in Hubei be exempted from prosecution; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Duanfang said Sichuan's trouble came from official-people strife and won release for Pu Dianjun, Deng Xiaoke, and eight others plus Xiao Xiang.

sentences.zh: 以唐紹儀為郵傳大臣。

translations.literal: Tang Shaoyi was made Minister of Posts and Communications.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Shaoyi became posts minister.

sentences.zh: 命陳邦瑞為江、皖賑務大臣。

translations.literal: Chen Bangrui was made Jiang-Anhui relief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Bangrui took Jiang-Anhui relief.

sentences.zh: 庚午，皇太后出內帑一百萬兩濟湖北軍。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Empress Dowager issued one million taels from the inner treasury to supply the Hubei army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the empress dowager sent one million taels to the Hubei army.

sentences.zh: 召蔭昌還，授袁世凱欽差大臣，督辦湖北剿撫事宜，節制諸軍。

translations.literal: Yin Chang was recalled; Yuan Shikai was made Imperial Commissioner to supervise Hubei suppression and pacification and command all armies.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Chang returned; Yuan Shikai became imperial commissioner for Hubei with full army command.

sentences.zh: 命軍諮使馮國璋總統第一軍，江北提督段祺瑞總統第二軍，俱受袁世凱節制。

translations.literal: Staff Officer Feng Guozhang was made commander of the First Army and Jiangbei Brigade Commander Duan Qirui commander of the Second Army, both under Yuan Shikai's command.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guozhang took the First Army and Duan Qirui the Second, both under Yuan Shikai.

sentences.zh: 以春祿為廣州將軍。

translations.literal: Chunlu was made Guangzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: Chunlu became Guangzhou general.

sentences.zh: 贈恤遇害廣州將軍鳳山。

translations.literal: Posthumous honors were granted Guangzhou General Fengshan, who had been killed.
translations.idiomatic: Slain Guangzhou General Fengshan was posthumously honored.

sentences.zh: 馮國璋與革命軍戰於灄口，水陸夾擊漢口，復之。

translations.literal: Feng Guozhang fought the revolutionaries at Zhangkou; land and water forces jointly struck Hankou and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guozhang fought at Zhangkou and land-water forces retook Hankou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以瑞澂失守武昌，避登兵艦，潛逃出省，偷生喪恥，詔逮京，下法部治罪。

translations.literal: On day renshen, because Ruicheng had lost Wuchang, boarded a warship to escape, and secretly fled the province—living in shame—an edict ordered him seized and sent to the capital for trial by the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Ruicheng was arrested for abandoning Wuchang and fleeing on a warship.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，下詔罪己。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, an edict confessed fault.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the throne confessed fault.

sentences.zh: 命溥倫、載澤纂憲法條文，迅速以聞。

translations.literal: Pulun and Zaize were ordered to draft constitutional articles and report swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: Pulun and Zaize were told to draft the constitution quickly.

sentences.zh: 資政院總裁大學士世續以疾免，以李家駒代之，達壽為副。

translations.literal: Political Consultative Assembly President and Grand Secretary Shiro was excused on grounds of illness; Li Jiaju replaced him, with Dashou as vice-president.
translations.idiomatic: Assembly President Shiro quit for illness; Li Jiaju replaced him with Dashou as deputy.

sentences.zh: 桂春回倉場侍郎任，趙秉鈞署民政大臣。

translations.literal: Gui Chun returned to grain transport vice minister; Zhao Bingjun acted as Minister of Civil Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Chun went back to grain transport and Zhao Bingjun acted for civil affairs.

sentences.zh: 奪湖南巡撫余誠格職，仍權管湖南巡撫事。

translations.literal: Hunan Governor Yu Chengge was stripped of office but still temporarily managed Hunan affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Chengge lost Hunan governorship but still acted there.

sentences.zh: 山西新軍變，巡撫陸鍾琦死之。

translations.literal: Shanxi's new army mutinied; Governor Lu Zhongqi died.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi mutinied and Governor Lu Zhongqi was killed.

sentences.zh: 雲南新軍變，總督李經羲遁，布政使世增及統制官鍾麟同、兵備處候補道王振畿、輜重營管帶範鍾嶽俱死之。

translations.literal: Yunnan's new army mutinied; Governor Li Jingxi fled; Provincial Treasurer Shizeng, Brigade Commander Zhong Lintong, Acting Daotai Wang Zhenji, and Transport Camp Commander Fan Zhongyue all died.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan mutinied; Li Jingxi fled and Shizeng, Zhong Lintong, Wang Zhenji, and Fan Zhongyue died.

sentences.zh: 命湯壽潛總辦浙江團練。

translations.literal: Tang Shouqian was ordered to direct Zhejiang militia training.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Shouqian took Zhejiang militia training.

sentences.zh: 開黨禁。

translations.literal: The ban on political parties was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Party bans were lifted.

sentences.zh: 戊戌政變獲咎，及先後犯政治革命嫌疑，與此次被脅自歸者，悉原之。

translations.literal: Those punished in the 1898 coup, and those earlier suspected of political revolution, together with those coerced in this affair who returned of themselves, were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: 1898 victims, revolution suspects, and coerced returners were all pardoned.

sentences.zh: 資政院言內閣應負責任，請廢現行章程，實行內閣完全制度，不以親貴充任。

translations.literal: The Political Consultative Assembly stated that the Cabinet should bear responsibility, asked abolition of the present regulations, and implementation of a fully responsible cabinet system without appointment of imperial kinsmen.
translations.idiomatic: The assembly said the cabinet must be fully responsible, without kinsmen, under new rules.

sentences.zh: 詔韙之。

translations.literal: An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 順天府平糶。

translations.literal: Shuntian sold grain at fair price.
translations.idiomatic: Shuntian sold grain at fair price.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，江西新軍變，巡撫馮汝骙走九江，仰藥死。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Jiangxi's new army mutinied; Governor Feng Rukui fled to Jiujiang and took poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Jiangxi mutinied; Feng Rukui fled to Jiujiang and poisoned himself.

sentences.zh: 安徽新軍犯省垣，擊散之。

translations.literal: Anhui's new army attacked the provincial capital and was scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui's new army struck the capital and was driven off.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，授袁世凱內閣總理大臣，命組織完全內閣。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Yuan Shikai was appointed Prime Minister of the Cabinet and ordered to organize a fully responsible cabinet.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Yuan Shikai became prime minister and was told to form a responsible cabinet.

sentences.zh: 慶親王奕劻罷內閣總理大臣，命為弼德院院長。

translations.literal: Prince Qing Yikuang was dismissed as Prime Minister and made president of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qing Yikuang left the cabinet and headed the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 那桐、徐世昌罷內閣協理大臣，及榮慶並為弼德院顧問大臣。

translations.literal: Natong and Xu Shichang were dismissed as Associate Prime Ministers; they and Rongqing became Privy Council advisers.
translations.idiomatic: Natong and Xu Shichang left the cabinet and joined Rongqing as privy advisers.

sentences.zh: 罷善耆、鄒嘉來、載澤、唐景崇、蔭昌、載洵、紹昌、溥倫、唐紹儀、壽耆國務大臣，俱解部務。

translations.literal: State Ministers Shanqi, Zou Jialai, Zaize, Tang Jingchong, Yin Chang, Zaixun, Shaochang, Pulun, Tang Shaoyi, and Shouqi were dismissed and released from ministry duties.
translations.idiomatic: Shanqi, Zaize, Tang Jingchong, Yin Chang, Pulun, Tang Shaoyi, Shouqi, and other state ministers were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 載濤罷軍諮大臣，以蔭昌為之。

translations.literal: Zaitao was dismissed as staff minister; Yin Chang replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Zaitao left the General Staff and Yin Chang replaced him.

sentences.zh: 起魏光燾為湖廣總督，命速往湖北。

translations.literal: Wei Guangtao was recalled as Huguang governor-general and ordered to go swiftly to Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Guangtao returned as Huguang governor-general and was rushed to Hubei.

sentences.zh: 陸海各軍及長江水師仍聽袁世凱節制調遣。

translations.literal: All land and sea forces and Yangtze naval forces remained under Yuan Shikai's command and disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Land, sea, and Yangtze forces stayed under Yuan Shikai.

sentences.zh: 丙子，召袁世凱來京。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Yuan Shikai was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Yuan Shikai was summoned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 命王士珍權署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Wang Shizhen was ordered to act as Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shizhen acted as Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 用張紹曾言，改命資政院制定憲法。

translations.literal: Following Zhang Shaozeng's memorial, the Political Consultative Assembly was ordered to draft the constitution.
translations.idiomatic: On Zhang Shaozeng's advice the assembly was told to draft the constitution.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，資政院奏采用君主立憲主義，上重大信條十九事。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Political Consultative Assembly memorialized adoption of constitutional monarchy and submitted nineteen great articles of faith.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the assembly proposed constitutional monarchy and nineteen great articles.

sentences.zh: 發內帑十萬兩賑四川遭兵難民。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand taels from the inner treasury were issued to relieve Sichuan people afflicted by war.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan war victims received 100,000 inner-treasury taels.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔統兵大員以朝廷與民更始，不忍再用兵力之意諭人民。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, an edict ordered commanders of troops to proclaim to the people the court's intent, in renewing relations with the people, not to employ force readily.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day commanders were told the court sought renewal with the people and would not rush to arms.

sentences.zh: 諭統兵大員申明紀律，禁擾民。

translations.literal: Commanders of troops were ordered to declare discipline and forbid disturbing the people.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders were told to keep discipline and spare civilians.

sentences.zh: 命第六鎮統制吳祿貞署山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Sixth Division Commander Wu Luzhen was ordered to act as Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Luzhen of the Sixth Division acted as Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 袁世凱辭內閣總理大臣，溫詔勉之。

translations.literal: Yuan Shikai declined the post of Prime Minister; a warm edict urged him on.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shikai tried to refuse the premiership and was warmly pressed to accept.

sentences.zh: 贈恤殉難山西巡撫陸鍾琦。

translations.literal: Posthumous honors were granted Shanxi Governor Lu Zhongqi, who died for the state.
translations.idiomatic: Martyr Shanxi Governor Lu Zhongqi was posthumously honored.

sentences.zh: 貴州獨立，舉都督，巡撫沈瑜慶遁。

translations.literal: Guizhou declared independence, chose a governor, and Governor Shen Yuqing fled.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou declared independence, chose a governor, and Shen Yuqing fled.

sentences.zh: 革命軍陷上海。

translations.literal: Revolutionary forces took Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Revolutionaries seized Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 袁世凱命前敵諸軍停進兵。

translations.literal: Yuan Shikai ordered front-line armies to halt advance.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shikai halted the advance.

sentences.zh: 尋遣知府劉承恩、正參領蔡廷幹詣黎元洪勸解兵，不得要領而還。

translations.literal: Soon Prefect Liu Chengen and First Adjutant Cai Tinggan were sent to persuade Li Yuanhong to lay down arms; they gained no clear terms and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Liu Chengen and Cai Tinggan failed to persuade Li Yuanhong to disarm.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔許革命黨人以法律組政黨。

translations.literal: On day jimao, an edict permitted revolutionaries to form political parties under law.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day revolutionaries were allowed lawful political parties.

sentences.zh: 資政院言漢口之役，官軍慘殺人民，請敕停戰。

translations.literal: The Political Consultative Assembly stated that in the Hankou campaign government troops had slaughtered the people and asked an order to cease fighting.
translations.idiomatic: The assembly said Hankou troops had slaughtered civilians and asked for a ceasefire.

sentences.zh: 諭袁世凱按治軍官罪，商民損失由國家償之。

translations.literal: Yuan Shikai was ordered to punish offending officers by law and have merchant losses compensated by the state.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shikai was told to punish officers and pay merchant losses.

sentences.zh: 吳祿貞奏，遣員入敵軍勸告，下令停攻擊，親赴襄子關撫慰革命軍，詔嘉之。

translations.literal: Wu Luzhen memorialized sending men into enemy lines to advise surrender, ordering a halt to attacks, and going in person to Xiangzikou to comfort revolutionary troops; an edict praised this.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Luzhen asked to parley, halt attacks, and comfort rebels at Xiangzikou and was praised.

sentences.zh: 裁廣東交涉使司。

translations.literal: Guangdong's diplomatic commissioner office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong's diplomatic commissioner was cut.

sentences.zh: 江蘇巡撫程德全以蘇州附革命軍，自稱都督。

translations.literal: Jiangsu Governor Cheng Desheng joined the revolutionaries at Suzhou and styled himself governor.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu's Cheng Desheng joined the revolution at Suzhou as governor.

sentences.zh: 浙江新軍變，巡撫增韞被執，尋縱之。

translations.literal: Zhejiang's new army mutinied; Governor Zengyun was seized and soon released.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang mutinied; Governor Zengyun was seized then released.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，予第二十鎮統制張紹曾侍郎銜，宣撫長江。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Twentieth Division Commander Zhang Shaozeng was given vice-minister rank and ordered to pacify the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Zhang Shaozeng of the Twentieth Division received vice-minister rank to pacify the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 紹曾稱疾不赴。

translations.literal: Zhang Shaozeng pleaded illness and did not go.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shaozeng pleaded illness and stayed.

sentences.zh: 命張勛充會辦南洋軍務大臣。

translations.literal: Zhang Xun was made concurrent Southern Seas military affairs minister.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xun also took Southern Seas military affairs.

sentences.zh: 趙爾豐免，命端方署四川總督。

translations.literal: Zhao Erfeng was excused; Duanfang was ordered to act as Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Erfeng left and Duanfang acted as Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 趣袁世凱入京。

translations.literal: Yuan Shikai was urged to enter the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shikai was urged to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 釋政治嫌疑犯汪兆銘、黃復生、羅世勛於獄。

translations.literal: Wang Zhaoming, Huang Fusheng, and Luo Shixun were released from prison as political suspects.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhaoming, Huang Fusheng, and Luo Shixun were freed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，廣西巡撫沈秉堃自稱都督。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Guangxi Governor Shen Bingcheng styled himself governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Guangxi's Shen Bingcheng declared himself governor.

sentences.zh: 內閣銓敘局火。

translations.literal: The Cabinet Appointments Bureau caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: The cabinet appointments bureau burned.

sentences.zh: 壬午，江寧新軍統制徐紹楨以其軍變，將軍鐵良、總督張人駿、提督張勛拒守。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Jiangning new-army commander Xu Shaozhen mutinied with his troops; General Tie Liang, Governor-General Zhang Renjun, and Brigade Commander Zhang Xun held defense.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Xu Shaozhen mutinied at Jiangning while Tie Liang, Zhang Renjun, and Zhang Xun held the city.

sentences.zh: 鎮江陷，京口副都統載穆死之。

translations.literal: Zhenjiang fell; Jingkou Vice Commander-in-Chief Zaimu died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenjiang fell and Vice Commander Zaimu was killed.

sentences.zh: 安徽新軍變，推巡撫朱家寶為都督。

translations.literal: Anhui's new army mutinied and installed Governor Zhu Jiabao as governor.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui mutinied and made Zhu Jiabao governor.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔特命袁世凱為內閣總理大臣。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, an edict specially appointed Yuan Shikai Prime Minister of the Cabinet.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Yuan Shikai was specially appointed prime minister.

sentences.zh: 從資政院奏，依憲法信條公舉，故有是命。

translations.literal: Following the Political Consultative Assembly's memorial, selection was made under the constitutional articles of faith; hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The assembly's constitutional articles of faith led to the appointment.

sentences.zh: 呂海寰請依紅十字會法，推廣慈善救濟會，從之。

translations.literal: Lu Haihuan asked to extend the charitable relief society by Red Cross rules; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Haihuan asked to run relief on Red Cross lines and was approved.

sentences.zh: 廣東獨立，舉都督，總督張鳴岐遁。

translations.literal: Guangdong declared independence, chose a governor, and Governor-General Zhang Mingqi fled.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong declared independence and Zhang Mingqi fled.

sentences.zh: 福建新軍變，將軍樸壽、總督松壽死之。

translations.literal: Fujian's new army mutinied; General Pu Shou and Governor Songshou died.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian mutinied; Pu Shou and Songshou were killed.

sentences.zh: 甲申，皇太后懿旨罷繼祿，起世續復為總管內務府大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Empress Dowager's benevolent edict dismissed Jilu and recalled Shiro as Chief of the Imperial Household Department.
