translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the empress dowager dismissed Jilu and recalled Shiro to the household department.

sentences.zh: 召錫良入覲。

translations.literal: Xiliang was summoned to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Xiliang was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 以朝廷於滿、漢軍民初無歧視，命統兵大員曉諭之。

translations.literal: Because the court had never discriminated between Manchu-Han bannermen and Han civilians at the outset, commanders of troops were ordered to proclaim this.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders were told the court made no Manchu-Han distinction.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，山東巡撫孫寶琦宣告獨立。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Shandong Governor Sun Baoqi declared independence.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Shandong's Sun Baoqi declared independence.

sentences.zh: 順天府奏立臨時慈善普濟赤十字總會於京師。

translations.literal: Shuntian memorialized establishing a temporary charitable Red Cross society in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Shuntian set up a temporary capital Red Cross society.

sentences.zh: 罷貝勒毓朗軍諮大臣，以徐世昌代之。

translations.literal: Prince Yulang was dismissed as staff minister; Xu Shichang replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yulang left the General Staff and Xu Shichang replaced him.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賞恤江寧戰守將士。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, rewards were granted to Jiangning officers and soldiers who fought and held defense.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Jiangning's defenders were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 命呂海寰充中國紅十字會會長，兼慈善救濟會事。

translations.literal: Lu Haihuan was made president of the Chinese Red Cross and charged with charitable relief affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Haihuan headed the Chinese Red Cross and relief work.

sentences.zh: 東三省諮議局及新軍要求獨立，總督趙爾巽不從，寢其議，仍令解勸之。

translations.literal: The Three Eastern Provinces Consultative Assembly and new army demanded independence; Governor-General Zhao Erxun did not agree, shelved the proposal, and still ordered persuasion and dissolution.
translations.idiomatic: Manchuria's assembly and new army sought independence; Zhao Erxun refused and ordered persuasion.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命近畿各鎮及各路軍隊並姜桂題所部俱聽袁世凱節制。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, all nearby garrison divisions, route armies, and Jiang Guiyi's forces were placed under Yuan Shikai's command.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day nearby garrisons, route armies, and Jiang Guiyi's troops went to Yuan Shikai.

sentences.zh: 戊子，分遣被兵各省宣慰使，徵國民意見。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, condolence commissioners were sent to war-afflicted provinces to gather popular opinion.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day commissioners were sent to war provinces to hear the people.

sentences.zh: 命各省督撫舉足為代表者來京與會議。

translations.literal: Each provincial governor-general and governor was ordered to choose suitable representatives to come to the capital for conference.
translations.idiomatic: Each governor was told to send representatives to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 趙爾巽以川事引咎請罷，詔不許。

translations.literal: Zhao Erxun, blaming himself for Sichuan affairs, asked to resign; the edict did not permit.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Erxun tried to resign over Sichuan and was refused.

sentences.zh: 吳祿貞以兵至石家莊，為其下所殺。

translations.literal: Wu Luzhen brought troops to Shijiazhuang and was killed by his subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Luzhen reached Shijiazhuang and was killed by his men.

sentences.zh: 御史溫肅劾祿貞包藏禍心，反形顯著。

translations.literal: Censor Wen Su impeached Luzhen for harboring evil intent with rebellion already clear.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Wen Su impeached Wu Luzhen for treason.

sentences.zh: 詔陳夔龍按查。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Chen Ailong to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ailong was told to investigate.

sentences.zh: 王士珍以疾免，命段芝貴護湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Wang Shizhen was excused on grounds of illness; Duan Zhigui was ordered to act as Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shizhen quit for illness and Duan Zhigui acted for Huguang.

sentences.zh: 永定河合龍。

translations.literal: The Yongding River works were joined.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding River was closed.

sentences.zh: 袁世凱來京。

translations.literal: Yuan Shikai came to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shikai reached Beijing.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以張錫鑾為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Zhang Xiluan was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Zhang Xiluan became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 溥颋免，以錫良為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Puying was excused; Xiliang was made Rehe governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Puying left Rehe and Xiliang became governor-general.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，袁世凱舉國務大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Yuan Shikai nominated State Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Yuan Shikai named his cabinet.

sentences.zh: 詔命梁敦彥為外務大臣，趙秉鈞為民政大臣，嚴修為度支大臣，唐景崇為學務大臣，王士珍為陸軍大臣，薩鎮冰為海軍大臣，沈家本為司法大臣，張謇為農工商大臣，楊士琦為郵傳大臣，達壽為理藩大臣，俱置副大臣佐之。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Liang Dunyan Minister of Foreign Affairs, Zhao Bingjun Minister of Civil Affairs, Yan Xiu Minister of Revenue, Tang Jingchong Minister of Education, Wang Shizhen Minister of the Army, Sa Zhenbing Minister of the Navy, Shen Jiaben Minister of Justice, Zhang Jian Minister of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce, Yang Shiqi Minister of Posts and Communications, and Dashou Minister of Dependencies, each with a vice-minister to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shikai's cabinet: Liang Dunyan foreign affairs, Zhao Bingjun civil affairs, Yan Xiu revenue, Tang Jingchong education, Wang Shizhen army, Sa Zhenbing navy, Shen Jiaben justice, Zhang Jian agriculture and industry, Yang Shiqi posts, Dashou dependencies.

sentences.zh: 於式枚、寶熙充修律大臣。

translations.literal: Yu Shimei and Baoxi were made ministers for revising the code.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Shimei and Baoxi revised the legal code.

sentences.zh: 紹昌、林紹年、陳邦瑞、王垿、吳郁生、恩順俱充弼德院顧問大臣。

translations.literal: Shaochang, Lin Shaonian, Chen Bangrui, Wang Qi, Wu Yusheng, and Enshun were all made Privy Council advisers.
translations.idiomatic: Shaochang, Lin Shaonian, Chen Bangrui, Wang Qi, Wu Yusheng, and Enshun became privy advisers.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命段祺瑞署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Duan Qirui was ordered to act as Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Duan Qirui acted as Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 起升允署陜西巡撫，督辦軍務。

translations.literal: Sheng Yun was recalled to act as Shaanxi governor and supervise military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Yun returned to act as Shaanxi governor with military charge.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，浙江巡撫增韞坐擅離職守奪職。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Zhejiang Governor Zengyun was stripped of office for leaving his post without authority.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Zhejiang's Zengyun was dismissed for abandoning his post.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以督攻秣陵關餘黨，將士奮勇，賞張勛二等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: On day guisi, because in attacking remaining rebels at Moling Pass the officers and soldiers fought bravely, Zhang Xun was rewarded with hereditary Second Class Light Chariot Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Zhang Xun received hereditary Second Class Light Chariot Commandant for Moling Pass.

sentences.zh: 甲午，資政院上改訂院章，頒布之。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Political Consultative Assembly submitted revised assembly regulations; they were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the assembly's revised charter was issued.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，內閣奏立憲牴觸事項，停召對奏事。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingshen: the Cabinet memorialized that under constitutional government certain matters conflicted and audience for memorials was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In winter month 10, bingshen, the cabinet suspended memorial audiences under constitutional rule.

sentences.zh: 弼德院、軍諮府並限制之。

translations.literal: The Privy Council and General Staff were likewise restricted.
translations.idiomatic: The privy council and General Staff were restricted too.

sentences.zh: 廢各衙門直日舊章。

translations.literal: Old regulations for daily duty in each yamen were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Old yamen daily-duty rules were abolished.

sentences.zh: 更命世續復為文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: Shiro was again appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Shiro again became Wenyuan grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，伍廷芳、張謇、唐文治、溫宗堯勸告攝政王，請贊共和政體。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Wu Tingfang, Zhang Jian, Tang Wenzi, and Wen Zongyao urged the Prince Regent to favor a republican polity.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Wu Tingfang, Zhang Jian, Tang Wenzi, and Wen Zongyao urged the regent toward republic.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以憲法信條十九事誓告太廟，攝政王代行祀事。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the nineteen constitutional articles of faith were sworn before the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the Prince Regent performed the rite in the Emperor's place.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the nineteen constitutional articles were sworn at the ancestral temple by the regent for the emperor.

sentences.zh: 以勞乃宣為大學堂總監督。

translations.literal: Lao Naixuan was made superintendent of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: Lao Naixuan took the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 溥良免，命直隸宣化鎮總兵黃懋澄兼署察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: Puliang was excused; Xuanhua Brigade Commander Huang Maocheng was ordered concurrently to act as Chahar governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Puliang left Chahar and Huang Maocheng of Xuanhua acted there.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命甘肅提督張懷芝幫辦直隸防務。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Gansu Brigade Commander Zhang Huaizhi was ordered to assist in Zhili defense.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Zhang Huaizhi of Gansu helped Zhili defense.

sentences.zh: 四川成都獨立，舉都督。

translations.literal: Chengdu in Sichuan declared independence and chose a governor.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu declared independence and chose a governor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，督辦鐵路大臣、候補侍郎、署四川總督端方率兵入川，次資州，為其下所殺。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Railway Superintendent and Vice Minister on Reserve Appointment and Acting Sichuan Governor-General Duanfang led troops into Sichuan, halted at Zizhou, and was killed by his subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Duanfang was killed by his men at Zizhou on the march into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 其弟端錦從，並遇害。

translations.literal: His younger brother Duan Jin, who followed him, was also killed.
translations.idiomatic: His brother Duan Jin, who followed him, was also killed.

sentences.zh: 敘復漢陽功，封馮國璋二等男爵。

translations.literal: For recovering Hanyang, Feng Guozhang was enfeoffed as Second Class Baron.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guozhang received Second Class Baron for retaking Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 命科爾沁親王阿穆爾靈圭往奉天，會趙爾巽籌畫蒙古事宜。

translations.literal: Prince Almuerging of Horqin was ordered to Fengtian to join Zhao Erxun in planning Mongol affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Horqin Prince Almuerging was sent to Fengtian to plan Mongol affairs with Zhao Erxun.

sentences.zh: 變軍犯金陵，副將王有宏戰死。

translations.literal: Mutinous troops attacked Jinling; Deputy Commander Wang Youhong died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel troops struck Jinling and Deputy Commander Wang Youhong was killed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，孫寶琦罷獨立，自劾待罪。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Sun Baoqi renounced independence and impeached himself to await punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Sun Baoqi gave up independence and impeached himself to await sentence.

sentences.zh: 詔原之，褒獎山東官商不附和者。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned him and commended Shandong officials and merchants who had not joined the revolt.
translations.idiomatic: He was pardoned and Shandong officials and merchants who stayed loyal were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 發帑犒張勛軍。

translations.literal: Treasury funds were issued to reward Zhang Xun's army.
translations.idiomatic: Treasury silver was sent to reward Zhang Xun's troops.

sentences.zh: 賞梁鼎芬三品京堂，會李準規復廣東。

translations.literal: Liang Dingfen was granted third-rank capital bureau status and ordered to join Li Zhun in recovering Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Dingfen received third-rank capital status and was told to help Li Zhun retake Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 丙午，革命軍陷江寧，將軍鐵良、總督張人駿走上海，張勛以其餘眾退保徐州。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the revolutionary army took Jiangning; General Tieliang and Governor-General Zhang Renjun fled to Shanghai, and Zhang Xun withdrew the remnant force to hold Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day revolutionaries seized Jiangning; Tieliang and Zhang Renjun fled to Shanghai while Zhang Xun fell back to Xuzhou with what remained.

sentences.zh: 袁世凱與民軍訂暫時息戰條款，停戰三日。

translations.literal: Yuan Shikai and the revolutionary army agreed on provisional ceasefire terms and halted fighting for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shikai and the revolutionaries signed a temporary truce and stopped fighting for three days.

sentences.zh: 自是展期再三，至決定國體日乃已。

translations.literal: Extensions followed again and again until the day the form of government was decided.
translations.idiomatic: The truce was extended repeatedly until the national polity was settled.

sentences.zh: 命徐世昌充專司訓練禁衛軍大臣。

translations.literal: Xu Shichang was appointed minister exclusively charged with training the Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shichang was made the minister in charge of drilling the Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 丁未，寶棻免，以齊耀琳為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Bao Fang was dismissed and Qi Yaolin was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Bao Fang was removed and Qi Yaolin became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 命壽勛會袁世凱、徐世昌籌辦軍務。

translations.literal: Shou Xun was ordered to join Yuan Shikai and Xu Shichang in handling military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shou Xun was told to handle military affairs with Yuan Shikai and Xu Shichang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，哲布尊丹巴胡圖克圖自立，逐庫倫辦事大臣三多。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Jebtsundamba Khutuktu declared himself ruler and expelled the Urga resident commissioner San Duo.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Jebtsundamba Khutuktu declared independence and drove out Urga commissioner San Duo.

sentences.zh: 詔奪三多職。

translations.literal: An edict stripped San Duo of office.
translations.idiomatic: San Duo was dismissed by edict.

sentences.zh: 己酉，贈恤殉難江西巡撫馮汝骙。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, posthumous honors were granted to Jiangxi Governor Feng Ruqi, who died for the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Jiangxi Governor Feng Ruqi, killed in service, received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，監國攝政王載灃奏皇太后，繳監國攝政王章，退歸藩邸。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Regent Prince Zai Feng memorialized the Empress Dowager, surrendered the regent's seal, and returned to his princely residence.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Regent Prince Zai Feng memorialized the empress dowager, gave back the regent seal, and went home to his princedom.

sentences.zh: 皇太后懿旨，晉世續、徐世昌俱為太保，衛護皇帝。

translations.literal: An empress dowager edict promoted Shi Xu and Xu Shichang both to Grand Tutor to guard and protect the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager made Shi Xu and Xu Shichang grand tutors to guard the emperor.

sentences.zh: 諭段祺瑞剿當陽、天門諸路土匪。

translations.literal: Duan Qirui was ordered to suppress bandits on the Dangyang and Tianmen routes.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Qirui was told to crush bandits along the Dangyang and Tianmen lines.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔授袁世凱全權大臣，委代表人赴南方討論大局。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, an edict appointed Yuan Shikai plenipotentiary minister and authorized representatives to go south to discuss the overall situation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Yuan Shikai was made plenipotentiary minister with authority to send envoys south on the great settlement.

sentences.zh: 以馮國璋為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: Feng Guozhang was made Chahar governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Guozhang became Chahar governor-general.

sentences.zh: 資政院請改用陽歷，並臣民自由剪發，詔俱行之。

translations.literal: The Advisory Council asked to adopt the solar calendar and to allow subjects freely to cut their queues; an edict approved both.
translations.idiomatic: The Advisory Council sought the solar calendar and free queue-cutting; both were approved.

sentences.zh: 壬子，改訓練禁衛軍大臣為總統官，以馮國璋為之。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the minister for training the Imperial Guard was renamed president of the guard, with Feng Guozhang appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the Imperial Guard training minister became guard president under Feng Guozhang.

sentences.zh: 以良弼為軍諮府軍諮使。

translations.literal: Liang Bi was made military advisory commissioner of the General Staff.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Bi was appointed General Staff military advisory commissioner.

sentences.zh: 贈恤殉難閩浙總督松壽。

translations.literal: Posthumous honors were granted to Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General Song Shou, who died for the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General Song Shou, killed in service, received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，開黑龍江省太平山察漢敖拉煤礦。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Chahan Aolai coal mine at Taiping Mountain in Heilongjiang Province was opened.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Heilongjiang's Taiping Mountain Chahan Aolai coal mine was opened.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，革命軍至荊州，署左翼副都統恒齡死之。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the revolutionary army reached Jingzhou; Acting Left Deputy Commander Hengling died in defense.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day revolutionaries reached Jingzhou and Acting Left Deputy Commander Hengling was killed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，內閣奏行愛國公債票。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the cabinet issued patriotic public bonds.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the cabinet floated patriotic bonds.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，孫寶琦免，以胡建樞為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Sun Baoqi was dismissed and Hu Jianchu was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Sun Baoqi was removed and Hu Jianchu became Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子朔，袁世凱請廢臣工封奏舊制。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day jiazi: Yuan Shikai asked to abolish the old system of sealed memorials from officials.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, jiazi new moon, Yuan Shikai sought an end to sealed official memorials.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命前署湖北提法使施紀雲、前光祿寺少卿陳鍾信四川團練。

translations.literal: On day yichou, former acting Hubei legal commissioner Shi Jiyun and former Guanglu Temple vice minister Chen Zhong were ordered to manage Sichuan militia.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day ex-acting Hubei legal commissioner Shi Jiyun and ex-Guanglu vice minister Chen Zhong were told to run Sichuan militia.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，成都尹昌衡、羅綸以同志軍入總督衙，劫前署四川總督、川滇邊務大臣趙爾豐執之，不屈，死。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Yin Changheng and Luo Lun of the Comrade Army entered the governor's yamen, seized former acting Sichuan governor and Sichuan-Yunnan frontier commissioner Zhao Erfeng, and when he would not yield, killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Yin Changheng and Luo Lun's Comrade Army seized Zhao Erfeng in the governor's yamen and killed him when he refused to submit.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，贈恤死事廣東潮州鎮總兵趙國賢。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, posthumous honors were granted to Guangdong Chaozhou garrison commander Zhao Guoxian, who died in service.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Chaozhou commander Zhao Guoxian, killed in service, received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 壬申，皇太后命召集臨時國會，以共和立憲國體付公決。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Empress Dowager ordered a provisional congress convened and the republican constitutional polity submitted to public decision.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the empress dowager ordered a provisional congress to decide the republican constitutional polity by public vote.

sentences.zh: 初，袁世凱遣唐紹儀南下，與民軍代表伍廷芳討論大局，以上海為議和地，一再會議，廷芳力持廢帝制建共和國，紹儀不能折，以當先奏聞取上裁，遂以入告。

translations.literal: Earlier, Yuan Shikai had sent Tang Shaoyi south to discuss the overall situation with the revolutionary representative Wu Tingfang; Shanghai was the place of negotiation, and after repeated meetings Wu Tingfang insisted on abolishing the monarchy and founding a republic, which Tang Shaoyi could not overcome, so he said he must first memorialize for the throne's decision and then reported back.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yuan Shikai had sent Tang Shaoyi to negotiate in Shanghai with Wu Tingfang; Wu held out for abolishing the throne and a republic, Tang could not prevail, and he returned to seek the court's ruling.

sentences.zh: 世凱奏請召集王公大臣開御前會議，終從其言。

translations.literal: Yuan Shikai memorialized asking to convene princes, dukes, and grand ministers for an imperial audience conference, and in the end the court followed his advice.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shikai asked for a princes-and-ministers audience conference and the court at last agreed.

sentences.zh: 至是，乃定期開國民會議於上海，解決國體。

translations.literal: Thereupon a date was set to open a national conference at Shanghai to settle the form of government.
translations.idiomatic: A national conference was then scheduled at Shanghai to decide the polity.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，各省代表十七人開選舉臨時大總統選舉會於上海，舉臨時大總統，立政府於南京，定號曰中華民國。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, seventeen provincial representatives opened the provisional presidential election at Shanghai, elected a provisional president, established a government at Nanjing, and fixed the state name as the Republic of China.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day seventeen provincial delegates at Shanghai elected a provisional president, set up government at Nanjing, and named the state the Republic of China.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，勸親貴王公等輸財贍軍。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, princes, nobles, and the imperial clan were urged to contribute wealth to support the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day princes and nobles were urged to donate funds for the armies.

sentences.zh: 大理院正卿定成免，以劉若曾代之。

translations.literal: Chief justice Ding Cheng was dismissed and Liu Ruoceng replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Chief justice Ding Cheng was removed and Liu Ruoceng took his place.

sentences.zh: 己卯，楊士琦免，命梁士詒署郵傳大臣。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Yang Shiqi was dismissed and Liang Shiyi was appointed acting minister of posts and communications.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Yang Shiqi was removed and Liang Shiyi became acting posts minister.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，贈恤署四川總督、督辦粵漢川漢鐵路大臣、候補侍郎端方及其弟知府端錦。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, posthumous honors were granted to acting Sichuan governor, Guang-Han and Sichuan-Han railway commissioner, and expectant vice minister Duan Fang and his brother prefect Duan Jin, who died for the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Duan Fang, acting Sichuan governor and railway commissioner, and his brother Duan Jin received posthumous honors for dying in service.

sentences.zh: 罷鹽政院。

translations.literal: The Salt Administration Bureau was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Salt Administration Bureau was cut.

sentences.zh: 灤州兵變，撫定之。

translations.literal: Soldiers mutinied at Luanzhou and were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: A Luanzhou mutiny was pacified.

sentences.zh: 伊犁新軍協統領官楊纘緒軍變，將軍誌銳死之。

translations.literal: Yang Zuanxu, acting commander of the Ili New Army, mutinied and General Zhirui was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Ili New Army acting commander Yang Zuanxu mutinied and General Zhirui was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，告諭哲布尊丹巴胡圖克圖，並賚先朝珍物。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, an edict was sent to admonish the Jebtsundamba Khutuktu, and treasures of former reigns were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Jebtsundamba Khutuktu was admonished by edict and given former-dynasty treasures.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，贈恤殉難署荊州左翼副都統恒齡。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, posthumous honors were granted to acting Jingzhou Left Deputy Commander Hengling, who died for the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Acting Jingzhou Left Deputy Commander Hengling received posthumous honors for dying in service.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，袁世凱道遇炸彈，不中。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Yuan Shikai was struck by a bomb on the road but not hit.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day a bomb was thrown at Yuan Shikai on the road and missed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，命張懷芝兼幫辦山東防務大臣。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Zhang Huaiyi was ordered concurrently to assist in Shandong defense affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Zhang Huaiyi was also told to help handle Shandong defense.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命所司保護外人生命財產。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the responsible offices were ordered to protect foreigners' lives and property.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day officials were ordered to protect foreign lives and property.

sentences.zh: 命舒清阿幫辦湖北防務。

translations.literal: Shu Qinga was ordered to assist in Hubei defense.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Qinga was told to help with Hubei defense.

sentences.zh: 以烏珍為步軍統領，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: Wu Zhen was made metropolitan garrison commander and the capital was placed under martial law.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhen became metropolitan garrison commander and Beijing was put under martial law.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午朔，賞張懷芝巡撫銜。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day jiawu: Zhang Huaiyi was granted acting governor rank.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jiawu new moon, Zhang Huaiyi received acting governor rank.

sentences.zh: 己未，再予前山西巡撫陸鍾琦二等輕車都尉世職，追贈同時遇害其子翰林院侍講陸光熙三品京堂，優恤賜謚，並旌恤鍾琦妻唐氏。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, former Shanxi Governor Lu Zhongqi was again granted a hereditary second-rank light-chariot commandancy; his son, Hanlin reader Lu Guangxi, killed at the same time, was posthumously made third-rank capital bureau officer with favors, posthumous title, and honors for Lu Zhongqi's wife, Lady Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Lu Zhongqi received a second hereditary light-chariot commandancy; his son Lu Guangxi, killed with him, was posthumously made third-rank capital officer with title and honors for Lady Tang.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，張人駿罷，命張勛護兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Zhang Renjun was dismissed and Zhang Xun was ordered to act as Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Zhang Renjun was removed and Zhang Xun was told to act as Liangjiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 胡建樞罷，命張廣建署山東巡撫，吳鼎元會辦山東防務。

translations.literal: Hu Jianchu was dismissed; Zhang Guangjian was appointed acting Shandong governor and Wu Dingyuan was ordered to assist in Shandong defense.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Jianchu was removed; Zhang Guangjian became acting Shandong governor and Wu Dingyuan helped on Shandong defense.

sentences.zh: 己亥，贈恤殉難伊犁將軍誌銳。

translations.literal: On day jihai, posthumous honors were granted to Ili General Zhirui, who died for the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Ili General Zhirui, killed in service, received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，皇太后懿旨，以袁世凱公忠體國，封一等侯爵。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, an empress dowager edict said that because Yuan Shikai served the state with public loyalty, he was enfeoffed as first-class marquis.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the empress dowager enfeoffed Yuan Shikai as first-class marquis for loyal public service.

sentences.zh: 命額勒渾署伊犁將軍，文琦辦塔爾巴哈臺參贊大臣事。

translations.literal: Elerhun was appointed acting Ili general and Wen Qi was ordered to handle Tarbagatai councillor affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Elerhun became acting Ili general and Wen Qi took Tarbagatai councillor affairs.

sentences.zh: 李家駒免，以許鼎霖為資政院總裁。

translations.literal: Li Jiaju was dismissed and Xu Dingsen was made president of the Advisory Council.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiaju was removed and Xu Dingsen became Advisory Council president.

sentences.zh: 革命黨以藥彈擊良弼，傷股，越二日死。

translations.literal: Revolutionaries struck Liang Bi with an explosive and wounded his thigh; two days later he died.
translations.idiomatic: Revolutionaries bombed Liang Bi in the thigh; he died two days later.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，袁世凱辭侯爵，固讓再三乃受。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Yuan Shikai declined the marquisate and only accepted after repeated earnest refusal.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Yuan Shikai refused the marquisate until repeated urging made him accept.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以復潼關，賞銀一萬兩犒軍。

translations.literal: On day guimao, because Tong Pass was recovered, ten thousand taels of silver were granted to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Tong Pass's recovery brought ten thousand taels to reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以敘漢陽功，復張彪提督。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, because of merit at Hanyang, Zhang Biao was restored to provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Zhang Biao was restored to provincial commander for Hanyang merit.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以張懷芝為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Zhang Huaiyi was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Zhang Huaiyi became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 贈恤死事福州將軍樸壽。

translations.literal: Posthumous honors were granted to Fuzhou General Pu Shou, who died for the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou General Pu Shou, killed in service, received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命張錫鑾往奉天會辦防務，李盛鐸署山西巡撫，盧永祥會辦山西軍務。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Zhang Xiluan was ordered to Fengtian to assist in defense; Li Shengduo was appointed acting Shanxi governor and Lu Yongxiang was ordered to assist in Shanxi military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Zhang Xiluan went to Fengtian on defense; Li Shengduo became acting Shanxi governor and Lu Yongxiang helped Shanxi command.

sentences.zh: 贈恤遇害軍諮府軍諮使良弼。

translations.literal: Posthumous honors were granted to General Staff military advisory commissioner Liang Bi, who was killed.
translations.idiomatic: General Staff commissioner Liang Bi, assassinated, received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以王賡為軍諮府軍諮使。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Wang Geng was made General Staff military advisory commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Wang Geng became General Staff military advisory commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己酉，皇太后懿旨，授袁世凱全權，與民軍商酌條件奏聞。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, an empress dowager edict granted Yuan Shikai full authority to negotiate terms with the revolutionary army and memorialize the results.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the empress dowager gave Yuan Shikai full power to negotiate with the revolutionaries and report up.

sentences.zh: 時岑春煊、袁樹勛、陸徵祥、段祺瑞等請速定共和國體，以免生靈塗炭，故不俟國會召集，決定自讓政權，遂有是命。

translations.literal: At that time Cen Chunxuan, Yuan Shukun, Lu Zhengxiang, Duan Qirui, and others asked that the republican polity be settled quickly to spare the people further slaughter; therefore, without waiting for the congress to convene, the decision was made to yield power, and this order followed.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Chunxuan, Yuan Shukun, Lu Zhengxiang, Duan Qirui, and others then urged a swift republic to spare the people; without waiting for congress the court decided to yield power.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命昆源會辦熱河防務。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Kun Yuan was ordered to assist in Rehe defense.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Kun Yuan was told to help with Rehe defense.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命宋小濂署黑龍江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Song Xiaolian was appointed acting Heilongjiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Song Xiaolian became acting Heilongjiang governor.

sentences.zh: 壬子，徐世昌免軍諮大臣，贈恤雲南殉難甘肅布政使世增。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Xu Shichang was dismissed as military advisory minister; posthumous honors were granted to Gansu provincial administration commissioner Shi Zeng, who died for the dynasty in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Xu Shichang left the military advisory post; Gansu commissioner Shi Zeng, killed in Yunnan service, received posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，錫良免，命昆源署熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Xi Liang was dismissed and Kun Yuan was appointed acting Rehe governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Xi Liang was removed and Kun Yuan became acting Rehe governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，免江南徐州府未完丁漕銀糧。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, unpaid land-tax grain and transport dues for Jiangsu's Xuzhou Prefecture were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day unpaid Xuzhou land tax and transport grain were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊午，袁世凱奏與南方代表伍廷芳議，贊成共和，並進皇室優待條件八，皇族待遇條件四，滿、蒙、回、藏待遇條件七，凡十九條。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Yuan Shikai memorialized that in negotiations with the southern representative Wu Tingfang he endorsed the republic and submitted eight conditions for preferential treatment of the imperial house, four for treatment of the imperial clan, and seven for treatment of Manchus, Mongols, Muslims, and Tibetans—nineteen articles in all.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Yuan Shikai reported agreement with Wu Tingfang on a republic plus nineteen articles on the throne, the clan, and Manchu-Mongol-Muslim-Tibetan treatment.

sentences.zh: 皇太后命袁世凱以全權立臨時共和政府，與民軍商統一辦法。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager ordered Yuan Shikai, with full authority, to establish a provisional republican government and negotiate unified arrangements with the revolutionary army.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager told Yuan Shikai to form a provisional republican government and negotiate unity with the revolutionaries.

sentences.zh: 袁世凱遂承皇太后懿旨，宣示中外曰：「前因民軍起義，各省響應，九夏沸騰，生靈塗炭。

translations.literal: Yuan Shikai thereupon carried out the empress dowager's edict and proclaimed to China and abroad: 「Previously, because the revolutionary army rose in arms and the provinces answered in succession, the empire seethed through nine summers and the people were ground under war.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shikai then proclaimed the empress dowager's edict at home and abroad: 「Earlier the revolutionary army rose, the provinces followed, the realm boiled nine summers long, and the people burned in war.

sentences.zh: 特命袁世凱遣員與民軍代表討論大局，議開國會、公決政體。

translations.literal: The court had specially ordered Yuan Shikai to send envoys to discuss the overall situation with revolutionary representatives, to open a congress, and to decide the polity by public vote.
translations.idiomatic: The throne had ordered Yuan Shikai to send envoys south, open a congress, and let the polity be decided by vote.

sentences.zh: 兩月以來，尚無確當辦法。

translations.literal: For two months there had still been no settled plan.
translations.idiomatic: Two months passed with no settled plan.

sentences.zh: 南北暌隔，彼此相持。

translations.literal: North and south stood apart and each side held fast.
translations.idiomatic: North and south were estranged and locked in stalemate.

sentences.zh: 商輟於塗，士露於野。

translations.literal: Merchants halted on the roads and scholars lay exposed in the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Trade stopped on the roads and scholars slept in the open fields.

sentences.zh: 國體一日不決，民生一日不安。

translations.literal: While the form of government went undecided for a single day, the people's livelihood knew no peace for a single day.
translations.idiomatic: One day without a settled polity meant one more day without peace for the people.

sentences.zh: 今全國人民心理，多傾向共和。

translations.literal: Now the mind of the whole nation inclines overwhelmingly toward a republic.
translations.idiomatic: Now the whole nation's heart leaned toward republic.

sentences.zh: 南中各省，既倡義於前，北方將領，亦主張於後。

translations.literal: The southern provinces had raised the standard first; northern commanders had also declared for it afterward.
translations.idiomatic: The south had risen first; northern generals had followed.

sentences.zh: 人心所向，天命可知。

translations.literal: Where hearts turn, Heaven's mandate may be known.
translations.idiomatic: Where hearts turn, Heaven's mandate is plain.

sentences.zh: 予亦何忍因一姓之尊榮，拂兆民之好惡。

translations.literal: How could We bear, for the honor of one surname, to go against the likes and dislikes of the myriad people?
translations.idiomatic: How could We cling to one clan's honor against the will of the myriad people?

sentences.zh: 是用外觀大勢，內審輿情，特率皇帝將統治權公諸全國，定為立憲共和國體。

translations.literal: Therefore, looking outward at the great trend and inward at public sentiment, We specially lead the Emperor to yield ruling power to the whole nation and fix a constitutional republic as the polity.
translations.idiomatic: Reading the great trend abroad and public feeling within, We yield the emperor's ruling power to the nation and fix a constitutional republic.

sentences.zh: 近慰海內厭亂望治之心，遠協古聖天下為公之義。

translations.literal: This will soon ease the empire's weariness of chaos and longing for order, and in the long run accord with the ancient sages' principle that all under Heaven is for the public.
translations.idiomatic: It will ease the empire's hunger for peace now and match the sages' teaching that all under Heaven belongs to all.

sentences.zh: 袁世凱前經資政院選為總理大臣，當茲新舊代謝之際，宜為南北統一之方。

translations.literal: Yuan Shikai had earlier been chosen by the Advisory Council as prime minister; at this passage between old and new, he should serve as the means of north-south unity.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shikai, already chosen prime minister by the Advisory Council, should bridge old and new and unite north and south.

sentences.zh: 即由袁世凱以全權組織臨時共和政府，與民軍協商統一辦法。

translations.literal: Let Yuan Shikai therefore, with full authority, organize a provisional republican government and negotiate unified arrangements with the revolutionary army.
translations.idiomatic: Let Yuan Shikai, with full power, form a provisional republican government and negotiate unity with the revolutionaries.

sentences.zh: 總期人民安堵，海宇乂安，仍合滿、蒙、漢、回、藏五族完全領土為一大中華民國。

translations.literal: The aim is that the people may dwell in peace, the realm be governed in tranquillity, and the complete territory of the five peoples—Manchu, Mongol, Han, Muslim, and Tibetan—still form one great Republic of China.
translations.idiomatic: The aim is peace for the people, order for the realm, and one Republic of China embracing Manchu, Mongol, Han, Muslim, and Tibetan lands entire.

sentences.zh: 予與皇帝得以退處安閒，優遊歲月，受國民之優禮，親見郅治之告成，豈不懿歟！

translations.literal: The Emperor and We may then withdraw to ease, pass the years in leisure, receive the nation's courteous treatment, and ourselves witness the accomplishment of perfect order—would that not be glorious!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor and We may then retire in ease, enjoy the nation's courtesy, and see perfect order achieved—what glory could exceed it!

translations.literal: 」It also said: 「Of old, those who held all under Heaven valued preserving the people's lives and could not bear to harm men in order to nourish men.
translations.idiomatic: 」It also said: 「Ancient rulers held the realm to preserve life and would not harm the people to feed power.

sentences.zh: 現將新定國體，無非欲先弭大亂，期保乂安。

translations.literal: In fixing the new polity now, the purpose is solely to end great disorder first and to secure lasting peace.
translations.idiomatic: The new polity is meant first to end great disorder and secure lasting peace.

sentences.zh: 若拂逆多數之民心，重啟無窮之戰禍，則大局決裂，殘殺相尋，必演成種族之慘痛。

translations.literal: If We go against the heart of the majority and reopen endless war, the great settlement will shatter, slaughter will chase slaughter, and the horror of racial catastrophe will unfold.
translations.idiomatic: Defy the majority and war without end will shatter the settlement, slaughter breed slaughter, and racial catastrophe follow.

sentences.zh: 將至九廟震驚，兆民荼毒，後禍何忍復言。

translations.literal: The ancestral temples will be shaken, the myriad people poisoned—how can later disaster even be spoken of?
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral temples will shake, the myriad people suffer—later disaster beggars words.

sentences.zh: 兩害相形，取其輕者。

translations.literal: When two harms stand side by side, take the lighter.
translations.idiomatic: Between two harms, choose the lighter.

sentences.zh: 此正朝廷審時觀變，恫瘝吾民之苦衷。

translations.literal: This is precisely the court's careful reading of the times, watching change, and heartfelt care for the people's suffering.
translations.idiomatic: This is the court reading the times, watching change, and weighing the people's pain.

sentences.zh: 凡爾京、外臣民，務當善體此意，為全局熟權利害，勿得挾虛矯之意氣，逞偏激之空言，致國與民兩受其害。

translations.literal: All of you, officials and people within and beyond the capital, must deeply grasp this intent, weigh the whole situation's gain and loss, and not indulge empty pride or reckless extremes that would make state and people suffer together.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and people everywhere must grasp this intent, weigh the whole situation, and not let pride or reckless words harm state and people alike.

sentences.zh: 著民政部、步軍統領、姜桂題、馮國璋等嚴密防範，剴切開導。

translations.literal: Let the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the metropolitan garrison commander, Jiang Guiti, Feng Guozhang, and others strictly guard and earnestly instruct.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Civil Affairs, the metropolitan garrison, Jiang Guiti, Feng Guozhang, and others were ordered to guard strictly and instruct earnestly.

sentences.zh: 俾皆曉然於朝廷應天順人，大公無私之意。

translations.literal: So that all may clearly understand the court's response to Heaven and the people's will, its great impartiality and selflessness.
translations.idiomatic: So all would see the court answering Heaven and the people with great impartiality.

sentences.zh: 至國家設官分職，以為民極。

translations.literal: As for the state's establishment of offices and division of duties to serve as the people's pole—
translations.idiomatic: Offices and duties exist to serve as the people's pole—

sentences.zh: 內列閣、府、部、院，外建督、撫、司、道，所以康保群黎，非為一人一家而設。

translations.literal: within are cabinets, offices, ministries, and bureaus; without are governors-general, governors, and circuit commissioners—all to preserve and comfort the multitude, not set up for one man or one house.
translations.idiomatic: cabinets and ministries within, governors and commissioners without—all to comfort the people, not one man or one house.

sentences.zh: 爾京、外大小各官，均宜慨念時艱，慎供職守。

translations.literal: All of you, great and small officials within and beyond the capital, should deeply reflect on the hard times and carefully keep your posts.
translations.idiomatic: Capital and provincial officials alike should feel the hard times and keep their posts carefully.

sentences.zh: 應即責成各長官敦切誡勸，勿曠厥官，用副予夙昔愛撫庶民之至意。

translations.literal: Each superior should at once be charged earnestly to admonish and warn, that none neglect office, fulfilling Our long-standing intent to cherish the common people.
translations.idiomatic: Each chief should admonish his men not to neglect duty, fulfilling Our long intent to cherish the people.

translations.literal: 」It also said: 「Earlier, because the overall situation stood on the brink and the myriad people were in distress, We specially ordered the cabinet to negotiate with the revolutionary army the various conditions for preferential treatment of the imperial house, in hope of a peaceful settlement.
translations.idiomatic: 」It also said: 「Earlier, with the realm on the brink and the people in distress, We ordered the cabinet to negotiate preferential terms for the imperial house with the revolutionaries in hope of peace.

sentences.zh: 茲據覆奏，民軍所開優禮條件，於宗廟陵寢永遠奉祀，先皇陵制如舊妥修各節，均已一律擔承。

translations.literal: Now according to the returned memorial, the courteous terms offered by the revolutionary army—perpetual rites at the ancestral temples and imperial tombs, and maintenance of former imperial tomb regulations as before—have all been accepted in full.
translations.idiomatic: The returned memorial reported that the revolutionaries' courteous terms—perpetual temple and tomb rites and maintenance of former tomb rules—were all accepted.

sentences.zh: 皇帝但卸政權，不廢尊號。

translations.literal: The Emperor only lays down ruling power and does not abolish his honored title.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor yields ruling power but keeps his honored title.

sentences.zh: 並議定優待皇室八條，待遇皇族四條，待遇滿、蒙、回、藏七條。

translations.literal: Eight articles on preferential treatment of the imperial house, four on treatment of the imperial clan, and seven on treatment of Manchus, Mongols, Muslims, and Tibetans were also agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Eight articles on the imperial house, four on the clan, and seven on Manchu, Mongol, Muslim, and Tibetan treatment were also fixed.

sentences.zh: 覽奏尚為周至。

translations.literal: Reading the memorial, it was thorough indeed.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was judged thorough.

sentences.zh: 特行宣示皇族暨滿、蒙、回、藏人等，此後務當化除畛域，共保治安，重睹世界之升平，胥享共和之幸福，予有厚望焉。

translations.literal: This is specially proclaimed to the imperial clan and to the Manchus, Mongols, Muslims, and Tibetans: hereafter you must dissolve boundaries, jointly preserve security, behold the world's peace restored, and all share the happiness of the republic—We place great hope in this.
translations.idiomatic: The throne proclaimed to the clan and to Manchus, Mongols, Muslims, and Tibetans: dissolve old boundaries, keep the peace together, see the world made tranquil, and share republican happiness—on this We set great hope.

translations.literal: 」Thereupon the throne was yielded.
translations.idiomatic: With that, the abdication was carried out.

sentences.zh: 論曰：帝沖齡嗣服，監國攝政，軍國機務，悉由處分，大事並白太后取進止。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: The Emperor succeeded in tender years; a regent ruled the realm; military and state affairs were all disposed by him, and great matters were also reported to the Empress Dowager for decision.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: The emperor came to the throne as a child; a regent ruled; military and civil affairs all passed through him, and great matters were reported to the empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 大變既起，遽謝政權，天下為公，永存優待，遂開千古未有之奇。

translations.literal: When great change broke out, he at once yielded power; all under Heaven was for the public, and preferential treatment was preserved forever—thus opening a wonder without precedent in a thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: When great change broke out he yielded power at once; all under Heaven was for the public and preferential treatment was preserved—a wonder without precedent.

sentences.zh: 虞賓在位，文物猶新。

translations.literal: Like the guest of Yu on the throne, the ritual and cultural forms were still renewed.
translations.idiomatic: Like Yu's guest on the throne, ritual and culture were still renewed.

sentences.zh: 是非論定，修史者每難之。

translations.literal: When right and wrong are finally settled, those who compile history always find it hard.
translations.idiomatic: When judgment is finally rendered, historians always find it hard.

sentences.zh: 然孔子作春秋，筆則筆，削則削。

translations.literal: Yet when Confucius compiled the Spring and Autumn Annals, he wrote what should be written and cut what should be cut.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Confucius compiling the Spring and Autumn Annals wrote what should be written and cut what should be cut.

sentences.zh: 所見之世且詳於所聞，一朝掌故，烏可從闕。

translations.literal: The age he saw is recorded in even greater detail than the age he only heard of; the events of a single court—how can they be left blank?
translations.idiomatic: The age he saw is set down more fully than the age he heard of; how can a single reign's record be left blank?

sentences.zh: 儻亦為天下後世所共鑒歟？

translations.literal: May this also be judged together by later ages under Heaven?
translations.idiomatic: May later ages under Heaven judge it together as well?

translations.idiomatic: Chapter 25
